Bava Kamma 119a:8-17: Rav chisda hava leh hahu arisa, dahava takel veyahev takel veshakel. sallekeh, kera annafsheh: "vetzafun latztzaddik chel chote".
"Ki ma tikvat chanef ki yivtza, ki yeshel eloah nafsho" – rav huna verav chisda; chad amar: nafsho denigzal, vechad amar: nafsho shel gazlan.

Man deamar nafsho shel nigzal – dichtiv: "ken orchot kol botzea batza, et nefesh bealav yikkach". man deamar nafsho shel gazlan – dichtiv: "al tigzol dal ki dal hu, veal tedakke ani vashshaar. ki Adonai yariv rivam, vekava et kovehem nafesh".
Veiddach name, hachtiv: "nefesh bealav yikkach"! may "bealav" – bealav dehashta.
Veiddach name, hachtiv: "vekava et kovehem nafesh"! "ma taam" kaamar – ma taam "vekava et kovehem"? mishshum dekavi nefesh.

Amar rabbi yochanan: kol haggozel et chavero shave peruta – keillu notel nishmato mimmennu, shenneemar: "ken orchot kol botzea batza, et nefesh bealav yikkach"; veomer: "veachal ketzircha velachmecha, banecha uvenotecha".
Veomer: "mechamas bene yehuda, asher shafchu dam naki beartzam"; veomer: "el shaul veel bet haddamim, al asher hemit et haggivonim".
May "veomer"? vechi tema nefesh dideh, aval nefesh banav uvenotav la – ta shema: "besar banav uvenotav".
Vechi tema, hane mille hecha dela yahev deme, aval hecha deyahev deme la – ta shema: "mechamas bene yehuda, asher shafchu dam naki (beartzechem) [beartzam]".

Vechi tema, hane mille hecha dekaaved beyadayim, aval gerama la – ta shema: "el shaul veel bet haddamim, [al] asher hemit et haggivonim"; vechi hechan matzinu sheharag shaul et haggivonim? ella mittoch sheharag nov ir hakkohanim shehayu maspikin lahen mayim umazon, maale alav hakkatuv keillu haragan.
Berakhot 5a:4-8: Amar rabbi yitzchak: kol hakkore keriat shema al mittato, keillu ochez cherev shel shete fiyyot beyado. shenneemar: "rommot el bigronam vecherev pifiyyot beyadam", may mashma? amar mar zutera veittema rav ashe: meresha deinyana, dichtiv: "yalezu chasidim bechavod yerannenu al mishkevotam". uchetiv batreh: "rommot el bigronam vecherev pifiyyot beyadam".

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: kol hakkore keriat shema al mittato — mazzikin bedelin hemennu. shenneemar: "uvene reshef yagbihu uf", veen "uf" ella tora, shenneemar: "hataif enecha bo veenennu". veen "reshef" ella mazzikin, shenneemar: "meze raav ulechume reshef veketev meriri".

Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: kol haosek battora — yissurin bedelin hemennu, shenneemar: "uvene reshef yagbihu uf". veen "uf" ella tora, shenneemar "hataif enecha bo veenennu", veen "reshef" ella yissurin, shenneemar: "meze raav ulechume reshef".

Amar leh rabbi yochanan: ha afillu tinokot shel bet rabban, yodin oto, shenneemar "vayyomer im shamoa tishma lekol Adonai elohecha vehayyashar beenav taase vehaazanta lemitzvotav veshamarta kol chukkav kol hammachala asher samti vemitzrayim lo asim alecha ki ani Adonai rofecha". ella: kol sheefshar lo laasok battora veeno osek — hakkadosh baruch hu mevi alav yissurin mechoarin veochrin oto, shenneemar: "neelamti dumiyya hechesheti mittov ucheevi nekar", veen "tov" ella tora, shenneemar: "ki lekach tov natatti lachem torati al taazovu".

Amar rabbi zera veittema rabbi chanina bar pappa: bo uree shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam. middat basar vadam, adam mocher chefetz lachavero, mocher atzev, velokeach sameach, aval hakkadosh baruch hu eno ken, natan lahem tora leyisrael — vesamach, shenneemar: "ki lekach tov natatti lachem torati al taazovu".

Mishnah Keritot 1:3-6:
Yesh meviot karban veneechol, veyesh meviot veeno neechol, veyesh sheenan meviot. ellu meviot karban veneechol. hammappelet kemin behema chayya vaof, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyehe vo mitztzurat haadam. hammappelet sandal, o shilya, veshafir merukkam, vehayyotze mechuttach. vechen shifcha shehippila, mevia karban veneechol: 
Ellu meviot veeno neechol. hammappelet veen yadua ma hippila, vechen shete nashim shehippilu, achat mimmin petur veachat mimmin chova. amar rabbi yose, ematay, bizman shehalchu zo lemizrach vezo lemaarav. aval im hayu shetehen omdot keachat, meviot karban veneechol: 
Ellu sheenan meviot. hammappelet shafir male mayim, male dam, male geninim, hammappelet kemin dagim vachagavim shekatzim uremasim, hammappelet yom arbaim, veyotze dofen. rabbi shimon mechayyev beyotze dofen: 
Hammappelet or lishmonim veechad, bet shammay potrin min hakkarban, bet hillel mechayyevim. amru vet hillel levet shammay, may shena or lishmonim veechad miyyom shemonim veechad. im shave lo lattuma, lo yishve lo lakkarban. amru lahem bet shammay, lo, im amartem bemappelet yom shemonim veechad, shekken yatza veshaa shehi reuya lehavi vah karban, tomru vemappelet or lishmonim veechad, shello yatza veshaa shehi reuya lehavi vah karban. amru lahen bet hillel, vahare hammappelet yom shemonim veechad shechal lihyot beshabbat tochiach, shello yatza veshaa shehi reuya lehavi vah karban vechayyevet bakkarban. amru lahem bet shammay, lo, im amartem bemappelet yom shemonim veechad shechal lihyot beshabbat, sheaf al pi sheeno rauy lekarban yachid, rauy lekarban tzibbur, tomru vemappelet or lishmonim veechad, sheen hallayla rauy lo lekarban yachid velo lekarban tzibbur. haddamim enan mochichin, shehammappelet betoch melot, dameha temein, ufetura min hakkarban:
Mishnah Keritot 1:7-2:4:
Haishsha sheyyesh aleha sefek chamishsha zivot usefek chamishsha ledot, mevia karban echad, veochelet bazzevachim, veen hashshear aleha chova. chamesh ledot vaddaot, chamesh zivot vaddaot, mevia karban echad, veochelet bazzevachim, vehashshear aleha chova. maase sheamdu kinnim birushalayim bedinre zahav. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, hammaon hazze, lo alin hallayla, ad sheyyehu vedinarin. nichnas levet din velimmed, haishsha sheyyesh aleha chamesh ledot vaddaot, chamesh zivot vaddaot, mevia karban echad, veochelet bazzevachim, veen hashshear aleha chova. veamdu kinnim bo vayyom berivatayim: 
Arbaa mechussere chippurim vearbaa meviin al hazzadon kishgaga. ellu hen mechussere chippurim. hazzav, vehazzava, vehayyoledet, vehametzora. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, ger, mechussar kappara ad sheyyizzarek alav haddam. venazir, leyeno vetiglachto vetumato: 
Ellu meviin al hazzadon kishgaga. habba al hashshifcha, venazir shennitma, veal shevuat haedut, veal shevuat happikkadon: 
Chamishsha meviin karban echad al averot harebe, vachamishsha meviim karban ole veyored. ellu meviin karban echad al averot harebe. habba al hashshifcha biot harebe, venazir shennitma tumot harebe, vehamekanne leishto al yede anashim harebe, umetzora shennitnagga negaim harebe. hevi tzipporav venitnagga, lo alu lo, ad sheyyavi et chattato. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyavi et ashamo: 
Haishsha sheyyalda veladot harebe, hippila vetoch shemonim nekeva vechazra vehippila vetoch shemonim nekeva, vehammappelet teomim, rabbi yehuda omer, mevia al harishon veenah mevia al hashsheni. mevia al hashshelishi veenah mevia al harvii. ellu meviin karban ole veyored. al shemiat hakkol, veal bittuy sefatayim, veal tumat mikdash vekadashav, vehayyoledet, vehametzora. uma ben hashshifcha leven kol haarayot. shello shavta lahen lo vaonesh velo vakkarban, shekkol haarayot bechattat vehashshifcha beasham. kol haarayot binkeva, veshifcha bezachar. kol haarayot, echad haish veechad haishsha shavin bammakkot uvakkarban, uvashshifcha lo hishva et haish laishsha bammakkot velo et haishsha laish bakkarban. kol haarayot, asa vahen et hameare chaggomer, vechayyav al kol bia uvia. ze chomer hechmir bashshifcha, sheasa vah et hammezid kashshogeg:
Mishnah Keritot 2:5-3:2:
Ezo hi shifcha. kol shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin, shenneemar (Vayikra 19), vehafde lo nifdata, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yishmael omer, zo hi shifcha vaddait. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, kol haarayot meforashot, uma shiyyur, en lanu ella shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin: 
Kol haarayot, echad gadol veechad katan, hakkatan patur. echad er veechad yashen, hayyashen patur. echad shogeg veechad mezid, hashshogeg bechattat vehammezid behikkaret: 
Amru lo achalta chelev, mevi chattat. ed omer achal veed omer lo achal, ishsha omeret achal veishsha omeret lo achal, mevi asham taluy. ed omer achal vehu omer lo achalti, patur. shenayim omrim achal vehu omer lo achalti, rabbi meir mechayyev. amar rabbi meir, im heviuhu shenayim lemita chamura, lo yeviuhu lekarban hakkal. amru lo, ma im yirtze lomar mezid hayiti: 
Achal chelev vechelev behelem echad, eno chayyav ella chattat echat. achal chelev vedam venotar ufiggul behelem echad, chayyav al kol echad veechad. ze chomer beminin harebe mimmin echad. vechomer bemin echad mimminin harebe, sheim achal kachatzi zayit vechazar veachal kachatzi zayit mimmin echad, chayyav. mishshene minin, patur:
Mishnah Keritot 3:3-6:
Vechamma yishhe haochlan. keillu achalan kelayot, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyishhe mittechilla vead sof kede achilat peras. achal ochalin temein, veshata mashkin temein, shata reviit yayin venichnas lammikdash, veshaha kede achilat peras. rabbi eliezer omer, im hifsik bah o shennatan letocho mayim kol shehu, patur: 
Yesh ochel achila achat vechayyav aleha arba chattaot veasham echad. tame sheachal et hachelev, vehaya notar, min mukdashim, uveyom hakkippurim. rabbi meir omer, im hayta shabbat vehotzio vefiv, chayyav. amru lo, eno min hashshem: 
Yesh ba via achat vechayyav aleha shesh chattaot. habba al bitto, chayyav aleha mishshum bitto vaachoto veeshet achiv veeshet achi aviv veeshet ish venidda. vehabba al bat bitto, chayyav aleha mishshum bat bitto vechallato vaachot ishto veeshet achiv veeshet achi aviv veeshet ish venidda. rabbi yose omer, im avar hazzaken unesaah, chayyav aleha mishshum eshet av. vechen habba al bat ishto, veal bat bat ishto: 
Habba al chamoto, chayyav aleha mishshum chamoto vechallato vaachot ishto veeshet achiv veeshet achi aviv veeshet ish venidda. vechen habba al em chamoto, veal em chamiv. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, habba al chamoto, chayyav aleha mishshum chamoto veem chamoto veem chamiv. amru lo, shelashtan shem echad hen:
Mishnah Keritot 3:7-4:1:
Amar rabbi akiva, shaalti et rabban gamliel veet rabbi yehoshua baitlis shel emmaom, shehalchu likkach behema lemishte veno shel rabban gamliel, habba al achoto veal achot aviv veal achot immo behelem echad mahu, chayyav achat al kullan, o achat al kol achat veechat, veamru li, lo shamanu. aval shamanu, habba al chamesh nashav niddot behelem echad, shehu chayyav al kol achat veachat. veroin anu shehaddevarim kal vachomer: 
Veod shealan rabbi akiva. evar hameduldal bivhema, mahu. amru lo, lo shamanu. aval shamanu beevar hameduldal beadam, shehu tahor. shekkach hayu mukke shechin shebbirushalayim osin, holech lo erev pesach etzel harofe vechotcho ad shehu manniach bo chisora, vetochavo vesira, vehu nimshach mimmennu, vehalla ose fischo, veharofe ose fischo. veroin anu shehaddevarim kal vachomer: 
Veod shealan rabbi akiva. hashshochet chamishsha zevachim bachutz behelem echad, mahu. chayyav achat al kullam, o achat al kol achat veechat. amru lo, lo shamanu. amar rabbi yehoshua, shamati veochel mizzevach echad bachamishsha tamchuyin behelem echad, shehu chayyav al kol echad veechad mishshum meila, veroe ani shehaddevarim kal vachomer. amar rabbi shimon, lo chach shealan rabbi akiva. ella, beochel notar mechamishsha zevachim behelem echad, mahu. chayyav achat al kullan, o achat al kol achat veechat. amru lo, lo shamanu. amar rabbi yehoshua, shamati veochel mizzevach echad bachamishsha tamchuyim behelem echad, shehu chayyav al kol achat veachat mishshum meila, veroe ani shehaddevarim kal vachomer. amar rabbi akiva, im halacha, nekabbel. veim ladin, yesh teshuva. amar lo, hashev. amar lo, lo, im amarta vimila sheasa vah et hammaachil kaochel veet hamehanne kannehene, tzeraf hammeila lizman merubbe, tomar benotar, sheen bo achad mikkol ellu: 
Amar rabbi akiva, shaalti et rabbi eliezer, haose melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe meen melacha achat, behelem echad, ma hu. chayyav achat al kullan, o achat al kol achat veechat. amar li, chayyav al kol achat veachat, mikkal vachomer, uma im hannidda, sheen bah totzaot harebe vechattaot harebe, chayyav al kol achat veachat, shabbat, sheyyesh bah totzaot harebe vechattaot harebe, eno din sheyyehe chayyav al kol achat veechat. amarti lo, lo, im amarta vannidda, sheyyesh bah shete azharot, shehu muzhar al hannidda vehannidda muzheret alav, tomar bashshabbat, sheen bah ella azhara echat. amar li, habba al hakketannot yochiach, sheen bahen ella azhara achat vechayyav al kol achat veechat. amarti lo, lo, im amarta babba al hakketannot, sheaf al pi sheen bahen achshav, yesh bahen leachar zeman, tomar bashshabbat, sheen bah lo achshav velo leachar zeman. amar li, habba al habbehema yochiach. amarti lo, behema chashshabbat: 
Safek achal chelev, safek lo achal. vaafillu achal, safek yesh bo chashshiur, safek sheen bo. chelev veshumman lefanav, achal et achad mehen veen yadua ezo mehen achal. ishto vaachoto immo vabbayit, shagag beachat mehen veen yadua beezo mehen shagag. shabbat veyom chol, veasa melacha veachat mehen veen yadua beezo mehen asa. mevi asham taluy:
Mishnah Keritot 4:2-5:2:
Keshem sheim achal chelev vechelev behelem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat, kach al lo hoda shellahen eno mevi ella asham echad. im hayta yedia ventayim, keshem shehu mevi chattat al kol achat veachat, kach hu mevi asham taluy al kol achat veechat. keshem sheim achal chelev vedam notar ufiggul behelem echad, chayyav al kol echad veechad, kach al lo hoda shellahen mevi asham taluy al kol echad veechad. chelev venotar lefanav, achal achad mehem veen yadua eze mehem achal. ishto nidda vaachoto immo vabbayit, shagag beachat mehen veen yadua beezo mehen shagag. shabbat veyom hakkippurim veasa melacha ben hashshemashot veen yadua beeze mehem asa. rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter. amar rabbi yose, lo nechleku al haose melacha ben hashshemashot, shehu fatur, sheani omer, miktzat melacha asa mehayyom, umiktzatah lemachar. veal ma nechleku, al haose betoch hayyom veen yadua im beshabbat asa veim beyom hakkippurim asa. o al haose veen yadua meen ezo melacha asa. rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter. amar rabbi yehuda, potro haya rabbi yehoshua af measham taluy: 
Rabbi shimon shezuri verabbi shimon omrim, lo nechleku al davar shehu mishshum shem echad, shehu chayyav. veal ma nechleku. al davar shehu mishshum shene shemot, sherabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter. amar rabbi yehuda, afillu nitkavven lelakket teenim velikket anavim, anavim velikket teenim, shechorot velikket levanot, levanot velikket shechorot, rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter. amar rabbi yehuda, tameah ani im yiftor bah rabbi yehoshua. im ken, lamma neemar (Vayikra 4), asher chata bah. perat lemitassek: 
Dam shechita bivhema, bechayya uveofot, ben temeim uven tehorim, dam nechira, vedam ikkur, vedam hakkaza shehannefesh yotza vo, chayyavim alav. dam hattechol, dam hallev, dam betzim, dam dagim, dam chagavim, dam hattamtzit, en chayyavin alehen. rabbi yehuda mechayyev bedam hattamtzit: 
Rabbi akiva mechayyev al sefek meilot asham taluy, vachachamim potrim. umode rabbi akiva, sheen mevi et meilato ad shettitvadda lo, veyavi immah asham vadday. amar rabbi tarfon, ma laze mevi shete ashamot. ella yavi meila vechumshah, veyavi asham bishne selaim, veyomar, im vadday maalti, zo meilati veze ashami. veim safek, hammaot nedava veasham taluy. shemmimmin shehu mevi al hoda, mevi al lo hoda:
Mishnah Kilayim 7:1-5:
Hammavrich et haggefen baaretz, im en afar al gabbah shelosha tefachim, lo yavi zera aleha, afillu hivrichah bidlaat o vesilon. hivrichah besela, af al pi sheen afar al gabbah ella shalosh etzbaot, muttar lehavi zera aleha. haarkubba shebbaggefen, en moddin lah ella min haikkar hashsheni: 
Hammavrich shalosh gefanim veikkarehem nirim, rabbi eliezer bar tzadok omer, im yesh benehem mearba ammot vead shemone, hare ellu mitztarfot. veim lav, enan mitztarfot. gefen sheyyavsha, asura veenah mekaddeshet. rabbi meir omer, af tzemer gefen asur veeno mekaddesh. rabbi elazar bar tzadok omer mishshemo, af al gabbe haggefen asur veeno mekaddesh: 
Ellu osrin velo mekaddeshin. motar charban hakkerem, motar mechol hakkerem, motar piske aris, motar appifyarot. aval tachat haggefen, vaavodat haggefen, vearba ammot shebbakkerem, hare ellu mitkaddeshot: 
Hamesakkech et gafno al gabbe tevuato shel chavero, hare ze kiddesh, vechayyav beacharayuto. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim, en adam mekaddesh davar sheeno shello: 
Amar rabbi yose, maase beechad shezzara et karmo bashsheviit, uva maase lifne rabbi akiva, veamar, en adam mekaddesh davar sheeno shello:
Mishnah Kilayim 7:6-8:1:
Haannas shezzara et hakkerem veyatza millefanav, kotzro afillu vammoed. ad kamma hu noten lappoalim, ad shelish. yater mikkan, kotzer kedarko veholech afillu leachar hammoed. meematay hu nikra annas, mishsheyyishka: 
Haruach sheilala et haggefanim al gabbe tevua, yigdor miyyad. im ero ones, muttar. tevuato shehayta nota tachat haggefen, vechen beyarak, machazir veeno mekaddesh. meematay tevua mitkaddeshet, mishshettashrish. vaanavim, mishsheyyeasu kefol hallavan. tevua sheyyavsha kol tzarkah, vaanavim shebbashlu kol tzarkan, en mitkaddeshot: 
Atzitz nakuv mekaddesh bakkerem, vesheeno nakuv eno mekaddesh. verabbi shimon omer, ze veze osrin velo mekaddeshin. hammaavir atzitz nakuv bakkerem, im hosif bematayim, asur: 
Kile hakkerem asurin millizroa, umillekayyem, vaasurin bahanaa. kile zeraim, asurim millizroa umillekayyem, umuttarin baachila, vechol shekken bahanaa. kile vegadim muttarin bechol davar, veenan asurin ella millilbosh. kile vehema muttarim legaddel ulekayyem, veenan asurim ella milleharbia. kile vehema asurim ze vaze:
Mishnah Kilayim 8:2-5:
Behema im behema vechayya im chayya, behema im chayya vechayya im behema, temea im temea utehora im tehora, temea im tehora utehora im temea, asurin lacharosh velimshoch ulehanhig: 
Hammanhig sofeg et haarbaim, vehayyoshev bakkaron sofeg et haarbaim. rabbi meir poter. vehashshelishit shehi keshura lartzuot, asura: 
En koshrin et hassus lo letzidde hakkaron velo leachar hakkaron, velo et halluvdekim ligmallim. rabbi yehuda omer, kol hannoladim min hassus, af al pi sheavihen chamor, muttarin ze im ze. vechen hannoladim min hachamor, af al pi sheavihem sus, muttarin ze im ze. aval hannoladim min hassus im hannoladim mechamor, asurim ze im ze: 
Happerutiyyot asurot, veharammach muttar. veadne hassade, chayya. rabbi yose omer, metammeot baohel kaadam. hakkuppad vechuldat hassenayim, chayya. chuldat hassenayim, rabbi yose omer, bet shammay omrim, metamme chazzayit bemassa, vechaadasha bemagga:
Mishnah Kilayim 8:6-9:4:
Shor bar, min behema. verabbi yose omer, min chayya. kelev, min chayya. rabbi meir omer, min behema. chazir, min behema. arod, min chayya. happil vehakkof, min chayya. veadam muttar im kullam limshoch velacharosh ulehanhig: 
En asur mishshum kilayim ella tzemer ufishtim. veeno mittamme vingaim ella tzemer ufishtim. en hakkohanim lovshin leshammesh bevet hammikdash ella tzemer ufishtim. tzemer gemallim vetzemer rechelim shetterafan ze vaze, im rov min haggemallim, muttar, veim rov min harchelim, asur. mechetza lemechetza, asur. vechen happishtan vehakkanbos shetterafan ze vaze: 
Hashshirayim vehakkalach en bahem mishshum kilayim, aval asurim mippene marit haayin. hakkarim vehakkesatot en bahem mishshum kilayim, uvilvad shello yihye vesaro nogea bahen. en aray lechilayim. velo yilbash kilayim afillu al gabbe asara, afillu lignov et hammeches: 
Mitpechot hayyadayim, mitpechot hassefarim, mitpechot hassappag, en bahem mishshum kilayim. rabbi elazar oser. umitpechot hassapparim, asurot mishshum kilayim: 
Tachriche hammet umardaat shel chamor, en bahem mishshum kilayim. lo yitten hammardaat al ketefo, afillu lehotzi aleha zevel:
Mishnah Kilayim 9:5-8:
Mochre chesut mochrin kedarkan, uvilvad shello yitkavvenu bachamma mippene hachamma, uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim. vehatztzenuim mafshilin bemakkel laachorehem: 
Tofre chesut tofrin kedarkan, uvilvad shello yitkavvenu bachamma mippene hachamma, uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim. vehatztzenuim tofrim baaretz: 
Habbarsin vehabbardesin vehaddalmetikyon uminalot happinnon, lo yilbash bahen ad sheyyivdok. rabbi yose omer, habbaim mechof hayyam umimmedinat hayyam enan tzerichin bedika, mippene shechezkatan bakkanbos. uminal shel zered en bo mishshum kilayim: 
En asur mishshum kilayim ella tavuy vearug, shenneemar (Devarim 22) lo tilbash shaatnez, davar shehu shua tavuy vanuz. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, naloz umelliz hu et aviv shebbashshamayim alav:
Mishnah Kilayim 9:9-10:
Hallevadim asurim, mippene shehem shuim. piv shel tzemer beshel pishtan asur, mippene shehem chozrin kaarig. rabbi yose omer, meshichot shel argaman asurot, mippene shehu molel ad shello kosher. lo yikshor seret shel tzemer beshel pishtan lachgor bo et matnav, af al pi shehartzua vaemtza: 
Otot haggardin veotot hakkovsim, asurot mishshum kilayim. hattochef techifa achat, enah chibbur, veen bah mishshum kilayim, vehashshomtah beshabbat, patur. asa shene rasheha letzad echad, chibbur, veyesh bah mishshum kilayim, vehashshomtah beshabbat, chayyav. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyeshallesh. hassak vehakkuppa mitztarfin lechilayim:
Mishnah Nedarim 10:3-6:
Nadra vehi arusa, nitgarsha vo vayyom, nitarsa vo vayyom, afillu lemea, aviha uvalah haacharon meferin nedareha. ze hakkelal, kol shello yatzat lirshut atzmah shaa echat, aviha uvalah haacharon meferin nedareha: 
Derech talmide chachamim, ad shello hayta vitto yotza meetzlo, omer lah, kol nedarim shennadart betoch beti, hare hen mufarin. vechen habbaal ad shello tikkanes lirshuto, omer lah, kol nedarim shennadart ad shello tikkansi lirshuti, hare hen mufarin, shemmishshettikkanes lirshuto eno yachol lehafer: 
Bogeret sheshshahata shenem asar chodesh, vealmana sheloshim yom, rabbi eliezer omer, hoil uvalah chayyav bimzonoteha, yafer. vachachamim omrim, en habbaal mefer, ad shettikkanes lirshuto: 
Shomeret yavam, ben leyavam echad ben lishne yevamin, rabbi eliezer omer, yafer. rabbi yehoshua omer, leechad aval lo lishnayim. rabbi akiva omer, lo leechad velo lishnayim. amar rabbi eliezer, ma im ishsha, shekkana hu leatzmo, hare hu mefer nedareha, ishsha shehiknu lo min hashshamayim, eno din sheyyafer nedareha. amar lo rabbi akiva, lo, im amarta veishsha shekkana hu leatzmo, sheen laacherim bah reshut, tomar beishsha shehiknu lo min hashshamayim, sheyyesh laacherim bah reshut. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, akiva, devarecha vishne yevamin. ma atta meshiv al yavam echad. amar lo, en hayevama gemura layyavam keshem shehaarusa gemura leishah:
Mishnah Nedarim 10:7-11:3:
Haomer leishto, kol hannedarim shettidderi mikkan ad sheavo mimmakom peloni, hare hen kayyamin, lo amar kelum. hare hen mufarin, rabbi eliezer omer, mufar. vachachamim omrim, eno mufar. amar rabbi eliezer, im hefer nedarim shebbau lichlal issur, lo yafer nedarim shello vau lichlal issur. amru lo, hare hu omer, ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu (Bamidbar 30), et shebba lichlal hakem, ba lichlal hafer. lo va lichlal hakem, lo va lichlal hafer: 
Hafarat nedarim, kol hayyom. yesh baddavar lehakel ulehachamir. ketzad. nadra belele shabbat, yafer belele shabbat uveyom hashshabbat ad shettechshach. nadra im chashecha, mefer ad shello techshach. sheim chashcha velo hefer, eno yachol lehafer: 
Veellu nedarim shehu mefer, devarim sheyyesh bahem innuy nefesh, im erchatz veim lo erchatz, im etkashshet veim lo etkashshet. amar rabbi yose, en ellu nidre innuy nafesh: 
Veellu hem nidre innuy nefesh. amra, konam perot haolam alay, hare ze yachol lehafer. perot medina alay, yavi lah mimmedina acheret. perot chenvani ze alay, eno yachol lehafer. veim lo hayta farnasato ella mimmennu, hare ze yafer, divre rabbi yose: 
Konam sheeni nehena labberiyyot, eno yachol lehafer, vichola hi lehanot beleket uveshichcha uvefea. konam kohanim uleviyyim nehenim li, yittelu al karcho. kohanim ellu uleviyyim ellu nehenim li, yittelu acherim:
Mishnah Nedarim 8:3-6:
Ad hakkatzir, ad habbatzir, ad hammasik, eno asur ella ad sheyyaggia. ze hakkelal, kol shezzemanno kavua veamar ad sheyyaggia, asur ad sheyyaggiyya. amar ad sheyyehe, asur ad sheyyetze. vechol sheen zemanno kavua, ben amar ad sheyyehe, ben amar ad sheyyaggia, eno asur ella ad sheyyaggia: 
Ad hakkayitz, ad sheyyehe hakkayitz, ad sheyatchilu haam lehachenis bakkalkallot. ad sheyyaavor hakkayitz, ad sheyyekappelu hammaktzuot. ad hakkatzir, ad sheyyatchil haam liktzor, ketzir chittin aval lo ketzir seorim. hakkol lefi mekom nidro, im haya vahar, bahar, veim haya vabbika, babbika: 
Ad haggeshamim, ad sheyyihyu haggeshamim, ad shettered revia sheniyya. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, ad sheyyaggia zemannah shel revia. ad sheyyippasku geshamim, ad sheyyetze nisan kullo, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyaavor happesach. konam yayin sheeni toem hashshana, nitabbera hashshana, asur bah uveibburah. ad rosh adar, ad rosh adar harishon. ad sof adar, ad sof adar harishon. rabbi yehuda omer, konam yayin sheeni toem ad sheyyehe happesach, eno asur ella ad lel happesach, shello nitkavven ze ella ad shaa shedderech bene adam lishtot yayin: 
Amar konam basar sheeni toem ad sheyyehe hatztzom, eno asur ella ad lele tzom, shello nitkavven ze ella ad shaa shedderech bene adam leechol basar. rabbi yose veno omer, konam shum sheeni toem ad shettehe shabbat, eno asur ella ad lele shabbat, shello nitkavven ze ella ad shaa shedderech bene adam leechol shum:
Mishnah Nedarim 8:7-9:3:
Haomer lachavero konam sheani nehene lecha im en atta va venotel levanecha kor echad shel chittin ushete chaviyyot shel yayin, hare ze yachol lehafer et nidro shello al pi chacham, veyomar lo, kelum amarta ella mippene chevodi, zehu chevodi. vechen haomer lachavero konam sheatta nehene li im en atta va venoten livni kor echad shel chittin ushete chaviyyot shel yayin, rabbi meir omer, asur ad sheyyitten. vachachamim omrim, af ze yachol lehafer et nidro shello al pi chacham, veyomar lo, hare ani cheillu hitkabbalti. hayu mesarvin bo laset bat achoto veamar konam shehi nehenet li leolam, vechen hamegaresh et ishto veamar konam ishti nehenet li leolam, hare ellu muttarot lehanot lo, shello nitkavven ze ella leshum ishut. haya mesarev bachavero sheyyochal etzlo, amar konam levetcha sheeni nichnas, tippat tzonen sheeni toem lach, muttar likkanes leveto velishtot mimmennu tzonen, shello nitkavven ze ella leshum achila ushetiyya: 
Rabbi eliezer omer, potchin laadam bichvod aviv veimmo. vachachamim osrin. amar rabbi tzadok, ad sheppotchin lo vichvod aviv veimmo, yiftechu lo vichvod hammakom, im ken en nedarim. umodim chachamim lerabbi eliezer bedavar shebbeno leven aviv veimmo, sheppotchin lo bichvod aviv veimmo: 
Veod amar rabbi eliezer, potchin benolad. vachachamim osrin. ketzad. amar, konam sheeni nehene leish peloni, venaasa sofer, o shehaya massi et beno vekarov, veamar, illu hayiti yodea shehu naase sofer o shehu massi et beno vekarov, lo hayiti noder. konam levayit ze sheeni nichnas, venaasa vet hakkeneset, veamar, illu hayiti yodea shehu naase vet hakkeneset lo hayiti noder, rabbi eliezer mattir, vachachamim osrin: 
Rabbi meir omer, yesh devarim shehen kenolad veenan kenolad, veen chachamim modim lo. ketzad. amar, konam sheeni nose et pelonit, sheaviha ra. amru lo, met o sheasa teshuva. konam levayit ze sheeni nichnas, shehakkelev ra betocho o shehannachash betocho. amru lo, met hakkelev o shenneherag hannachash, hare hen kenolad veenan kenolad, veen chachamim modim lo:
Mishnah Nedarim 9:4-8:
Veod amar rabbi meir potchin lo min hakkatuv shebbattora veomrim lo, illu hayita yodea sheatta over al lo tikkom veal lo tittor (Vayikra 19), veal lo tisna et achicha bilvavecha (sham), veahavta lereacha kamocha (sham), veche achicha immach (sham 25), shemma yeani veen atta yachol lefarneso. amar, illu hayiti yodea shehu chen, lo hayiti noder, hare ze muttar: 
Potchin laadam bichtubbat ishto. umaase veechad shennadar meishto hanaa vehayta chetubbatah arba meot dinarin, uva lifne rabbi akiva vechiyyevo litten lah ketubbatah. amar lo, rabbi, shemone meot dinarin hinniach abba, venatal achi arba meot vaani arba meot, lo dayyah shettittol hi matayim, vaani matayim. amar lo rabbi akiva, afillu atta mocher sear roshcha, atta noten lah ketubbatah. amar lo, illu hayiti yodea shehu chen, lo hayiti noder, vehittirah rabbi akiva: 
Potchin beyamim tovim uveshabbatot. barishona hayu omrim, otan hayyamim muttarin ushear kol hayyamim asurin, ad shebba rabbi akiva velimmed, shehanneder shehuttar miktzato, huttar kullo: 
Ketzad. amar, konam sheeni nehene lechullechem, huttar echad mehen, hutteru chullan. sheeni nehene laze velaze, huttar harishon, hutteru chullan. huttar haacharon, haacharon muttar, vechullan asurin. huttar haemtzai, hemennu ulematta muttar, hemennu ulemala asur. sheeni nehene laze karban velaze karban, tzerichin petach lechol echad veechad: 
Konam yayin sheeni toem, shehayyayin ra lammeayim, amru lo, vahalo hameyushshan yafe lammeayim, huttar bamyushshan. velo vamyushshan bilvad huttar, ella vechol hayyayin. konam batzal sheeni toem, shehabbatzal ra lallev. amru lo, halo hakkufri yafe lallev, huttar bakkufri. velo vakkufri vilvad huttar, ella vechol habbetzalim. maase haya, vehittiro rabbi meir bechol habbetzalim:
Mishnah Nedarim 9:9-10:2:
Potchin laadam bichvod atzmo uvichvod banav. omrim lo, illu hayita yodea shellemachar omrin alecha kach hi visto shel peloni, megaresh et nashav, veal benotecha yihyu omrin benot gerushot hen, ma raata imman shel ellu lehitgaresh, veamar, illu hayiti yodea shekken, lo hayiti noder, hare ze muttar: 
Konam sheeni nose et pelonit keura, vahare hi naa. shechora, vahare hi levana. ketzara, vahare hi arukka, muttar bah. lo mippene shehi cheura venaaset naa, shechora venaaset levana, ketzara venaaset arukka, ella shehanneder taut. umaase veechad shennadar mibbat achoto hanaya, vehichnisuha levet rabbi yishmael veyippuha. amar lo rabbi yishmael, beni, lazo nadarta. amar lo, lav. vehittiro rabbi yishmael. beotah shaa bacha rabbi yishmael veamar, benot yisrael naot hen, ella shehaaniyyut menavvaltan. ucheshemmet rabbi yishmael, hayu venot yisrael nosot kina veomrot, benot yisrael el rabbi yishmael bechena. vechen hu omer beshaul (Shmuel b 1) benot yisrael el shaul bechena: 
Naara hameorasa, aviha uvalah meferin nedareha. hefer haav velo hefer habbaal, hefer habbaal velo hefer haav, eno mufar, veen tzarich lomar shekkiyyem echad mehen: 
Met haav, lo nitrokna reshut labbaal. met habbaal, nitrokna reshut laav. baze yafe choach haav mikkoach habbaal. bedavar acher yafe choach habbaal mikkoach haav, shehabbaal mefer beveger, vehaav eno mefer bevager:
Mishnah Sheviit 1:1-2:
Ad ematay chorshin bisde hailan erev sheviit. bet shammay omrim, kol zeman shehu yafe lapperi. uvet hillel omrim, ad haatzeret. ukerovin divre ellu lihyot kedivre ellu: 
Ezehu sede hailan, kol shelosha ilanot levet sea, im reuyin laasot kikkar devela shel shishshim mane baitalki, chorshim kol bet sea bishvilan. pachot mikkan, en chorshin lahen ella melo haore vesallo chutza lo:
Mishneh Torah, Foreign Worship and Custo: En megallechin paate harosh kemo shehayu osin ovde kochavim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 27)</small> "lo takkifu peat roshchem". vechayyav al kol pea ufea. lefichach hamegalleach shene tzedaav afillu bevat achat vehateraa achat loke shetayim. echad hamegalleach happeot bilvad umeniach sear kol harosh veechad hamegalleach kol harosh keechad loke hoil vegillach happeot. bamme devarim amurim beish hamegalleach aval ish hammitgalleach eno loke ella im ken siyyea lamgalleach. vehamegalleach et hakkatan loke:

Haishsha sheggillecha peat rosh haish o shennitgallecha petura shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 27)</small> "lo takkifu peat roshchem" <small>(Vayikra 19 27)</small> "velo tashchit peat zekanecha" kol sheyyeshno beval tashchit yeshno beval takkif, veishsha sheenah beval tashchit lefi sheen lah zakan enah beval takkif. lefichach haavadim hoil veyesh lahem zakan asurin behakkafa:

Kol mitzvot lo taase shebbattora echad anashim veechad nashim chayyavim chutz mibbal tashchit" uval takkif" uval yittame kohen lammetim" <small>(mishna kiddushin 1 7)</small>. vechol mitzvat ase shehi mizzeman lizman veenah tedira nashim peturot chutz mikkiddush hayyom vaachilat matztza belele happesach vaachilat happesach ushechitato vehakehel vesimcha shehannashim chayyavot:

Lo taade ishsha adi haish kegon shettasim beroshah mitznefet o kova o tilbash shiryon vechayyotze bo o shettegalleach roshah keish. velo yaade ish adi ishsha kegon sheyyilbash bigde tzivonin vachali zahav bemakom sheen lovshin otan hakkelim veen mesimim oto hachali ella nashim hakkol keminhag hammedina. ish sheada adi ishsha veishsha sheadta adi ish lokin. hamelakket searot levanot mittoch hashshechorot merosho o mizzekano mishsheyyelakket saara achat loke mippene sheada adi ishsha. vechen im tzava searo shachor mishsheyyitzba sear levana achat loke. tumtum veanderoginus eno otef keishsha velo megalleach rosho keish veim asa ken eno loke:

Ketovet kaaka haamura battora hu sheyyisrot al besaro vimalle mekom hasserita kachol o deyo o shear tzivonim haroshmim. veze haya minhag haakkum sheroshmin atzman laavodat kochavim kelomar shehu eved machur lah umursham laavodatah. umeet sheyyirshom beechad middevarim haroshmin achar sheyyisrot bee ze makom min hagguf ben ish ben ishsha loke. katav velo rasham betzeva o sherasham betzeva velo katav bisrita patur ad sheyyichtov vikaakea shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 28)</small> "uchetovet kaaka". bamme devarim amurim bechotev aval ze shekkatvu bivsaro vekikeu bo eno chayyav ella im ken siyyea kede sheyyaase maase. aval im lo asa kelum eno loke:

Hassoret serita achat al hammet loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 28)</small> "veseret lanefesh lo tittenu bivsarchem". echad kohen veechad yisrael. sarat serita achat al chamesh metim o chamesh seritot al met echad loke chamesh. vehu shehitru bo al kol achat veachat:
Tumtum veanderoginus hare hen safek, notnin alehen chumre haish vechumre haishsha bechol makom vechayyavim bakkol. veim avru enam lokin:
Af al pi shehaishsha mutteret legalleach peat roshah hare hi asura legalleach peat rosh haish. vaafillu katan asur lah legalleach lo pea:
Ufea zo shemmannichim batztzedaim lo natnu bo chachamim shiur veshamanu mizzekenenu sheeno manniach pachot mearbaim searot. umuttar lelakket happeot bemisparayim lo neesar ella hashechata betaar:

Derech kohane ovde kochavim haya lehashechit zekanam. lefichach asra tora lehashechit hazzakan. vechamesh peot yesh bo. lechi haelyon ulechi hattachton miyyamin vechen missemol veshibbolet hazzakan. veloke al kol pea ufea. veim netalan kullan keachat loke chamesh. veeno chayyav ad sheyyegallechennu betaar shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 27)</small> "velo tashchit et peat zekanecha" gilluach sheyyesh bo hashechata. lefichach im gilleach zekano bemisparayim patur. veen hammitgalleach loke ad sheyyesayyea. veishsha mutteret lehashechit zekanah im yesh lah sear bazzakan. veim hishchita zekan haish petura:

Hassafa muttar legallecho betaar vehu hassear sheal gav hassafa haelyona vechen hassear hameduldal min hassafa hattachtona. veaf al pi shehu muttar lo nahagu yisrael lehashechito ella yegalleach ketzato ad shello yeakkev achila ushetiyya:

Haavarat hassear mishshear hagguf kegon bet hashshechi uvet haerva eno asur min hattora ella middivre sofrim vehammaaviro makkin oto makkat mardut. bamme devarim amurim bemakom sheen maavirin oto ella nashim kede shello yetakken atzmo tikkun nashim. aval bemakom shemmaavirin hassear hannashim vaanashim im heevir en makkin oto. umuttar lehaavir sear shear evarim bemisparayim bechol makom:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 5:4-6:
Mishshettishka hachamma ad sheyyerau shelosha kochavim benonim hu hazzeman hannikra ben hashshemashot bechol makom. vehu safek min hayyom safek min hallayla vedanin bo lehachamir bechol makom. ulefichach en madlikin bo. vehaose melacha ben hashshemashot beerev shabbat uvemotzae shabbat beshogeg chayyav chattat mikkol makom. vechochavim ellu lo gedolim hannirim bayyom velo ketannim sheen nirin ella ballayla ella benonim. umisheyyerau shelosha kochavim ellu habbenonim hare ze layla vadday: 
Petila shemmadlikin bah leshabbat en osin otah middavar shehaur mesachsechet bo kegon tzemer vesear umeshi vetzemer haerez ufishtan shello nuppatz vesiv shel dekel umine haetz harakkim vechayyotze bahen. ella middavar shehaur nitlet bo. kegon pishta nefutza uvigde shesh vetzemer gefen vechayyotze bahen. vehammadlik tzarich sheyyadlik berov hayyotze min happetila: 
Hakkorech davar shemmadlikin bo al gabbe davar sheen madlikin bo. im lehaavot happetila kede lehosif orah asur. veim lehakeshot happetila kede shettehe omedet velo tishtalshel lematta muttar:
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 6:11-14: Avon gadol hu levazzot et hachachamim o lisnotan. lo charva yerushalayim ad shebbizzu bah talmide chachamim shenneemar <small>(divre hayamim b lo 16)</small> "vayyihyu malivim bemalache haelohim uvozim devarav umittateim binviav". kelomar bozim melammede devarav. vechen ze sheamra tora <small>(Vayikra 26 15)</small> "im bechukkotay timasu", melammede chukkotay timasu. vechol hamevazze et hachachamim en lo chelek laolam habba vahare hu bichlal <small>(Bamidbar 15 lo)</small> "ki devar Adonai baza":

Af al pi shehamevazze et hachachamim en lo chelek laolam habba, im bau edim shebbizzahu afillu bidvarim chayyav nidduy, umenaddin oto bet din barabbim vekonsin oto litra zahav bechol makom venotnin otah lechacham. vehamevazze et hechacham bidvarim afillu leachar mita menaddin oto bet din vehem mattirim oto kesheyyachazor bitshuva. aval im haya hechacham chay en mattirin oto ad sheyyeratztze ze shennidduhu bishvilo. vechen hechacham atzmo menadde lichvodo leam haaretz shehifkir bo veen tzarich lo edim velo hateraa. veen mattirin lo ad sheyyeratztze et hechacham. veim met hechacham bain shelosha umattirin lo. veim ratza hechacham limchol lo velo niddahu harshut beyado:

Harav shennidda lichvodo kol talmidav chayyavin linhog nidduy bamnudde. aval talmid shennidda lichvod atzmo en harav chayyav linhog bo nidduy. aval kol haam chayyavin linhog bo nidduy. vechen menudde lenasi menudde lechol yisrael. menudde lechol yisrael eno menudde lannasi. menudde leiro menudde leir acheret. menudde leir acheret eno menudde leiro:

Bamme devarim amurim bemi shennidduhu al shebbizza talmide chachamim. aval mi shennidduhu al shear devarim shechayyavim alehem nidduy afillu niddahu katan shebbeyisrael chayyav hannasi vechol yisrael linhog bo nidduy ad sheyyachazor bitshuva middavar shennidduhu bishvilo veyattiru lo. al esrim vearbaa devarim menaddin et haadam ben ish ben ishsha. veellu hen: 1) hamevazze et hechacham vaafillu leachar moto. b) hamevazze sheliach bet din. 3) hakkore lachavero eved. 4) mi sheshshalchu lo bet din vekavu lo zeman velo ba. 5) hamezalzel bedavar echad middivre sofrim veen tzarich lomar bedivre tora. 6) mi shello kibbel alav et haddin menaddin oto ad sheyyitten. 7) mi sheyyesh birshuto davar hammazzik kegon kelev ra o sullam raua menaddin oto ad sheyyasir hezzeko. 8) hammocher karka shello leoved kochavim menaddin oto ad sheyyekabbel alav kol ones sheyyavo min haoved kochavim leyisrael chavero baal hammetzar. 9) hammeid al yisrael bearkaot shel ovde kochavim vehotzi mimmennu beeduto mamon shello kedin yisrael, menaddin oto ad sheyyeshallem. 10) tabbach kohen sheeno mafrish hammattanot venotnan lechohen acher menaddin oto ad sheyyitten. 11) hamechallel yom tov sheni shel galuyyot af al pi shehu minhag. 12) haose melacha beerev happesach achar chatzot. 13) hammazkir shem shamayim levattala o lishvua bedivre havay. yad) hammevi et harabbim lide chillul hashshem. 15) hammevi et harabbim lide achilat kadashim bachutz. 16) hamechashshev shanim vekovea chodashim bechutza laaretz. 17) hammachishil et haivver. 18) hameakkev harabbim millaasot mitzva. 19) tabbach sheyyatza terefa mittachat yado. 20) tabbach shello badak sakkino lifne chacham. ka) hammakshe atzmo ledaat. 22) mi sheggeresh et ishto veasa beno uvenah shuttafut o massa umattan hammeviin lahen lehizzakek ze laze kesheyyavou levet din menaddin otam. 23) chacham sheshshemuato raa. kad) hamenadde mi sheeno chayyav nidduy:
Niddah 14a:3-4: Rabbi yehoshua ben levi layet amman degane apparkid. ini? vehaamar rav yosef: perakdan lo yikra "keriyyat shema" — keriyyat shema hu delo yikra, ha migna shappir dame!
Leinyan migna, ki matzle — shappir dame. leinyan keriat shema, ki matzle — asur. veha rabbi yochanan matzle vekare keriat shema! shane rabbi yochanan, devaal basar hava.

Shabbat 95a:3-6: Rav nachman bar gureya ikkela linhardaa. beo minneh: cholev, mishshum may michayyayv? amar lehu: mishshum cholev. mechabbetz, mishshum may michayyayv? amar lehu: mishshum mechabbetz. megabben, mishshum may chayyayv? amar lehu: mishshum megabben. amaru leh: rabbach katel kene beagma hava. ata sheel be midresha. amaru leh: cholev chayyayv — mishshum mefarek. mechabbetz chayyayv — mishshum borer, megabben chayyayv — mishshum bone.

Hamechabbed, hamerabbetz, veharode challot devash, shagag beshabbat — chayyayv chattat, hezid beyom tov — loke arbaim, divre rabbi eliezer. amar rabbi elazar: may tama derabbi eliezer — dichtiv: "vayyitbol otah beyarat haddevash", vechi ma inyan yaar etzel devash? ella lomar lach: ma yaar, hattolesh mimmennu beshabbat — chayyayv chattat, af challot devash, harode mimmennu beshabbat — chayyayv chattat.

Ammemar shera zilcha bemachoza. amar: tama may amur rabbanan — dilma ate leashvoye gummot, hacha lekka gummot. rava tosfaa ashkecheh leravina deka mitztaar mehavela, veamri la mar kashshisha bereh derava ashkecheh larav ashe deka mitztaar mehavela, amar leh: la savar la mar leha detanya: harotze lerabbetz et beto beshabbat, mevi areva melea mayim verochetz panav bezavit zo, yadav bezavit zo, raglav bezavit zo, venimtza habbayit mitrabbetz meelav? amar leh: lav addatay.
Tana: ishsha chachama merabbetzet betah beshabbat. vehaiddana disvira lan kerabbi shimon, shere afillu lechattechilla.
Yevamot 47a:13-47b:4: Tanu rabbanan: ger shebba lehitgayyer bizman hazze, omrim lo: ma raita shebbata lehitgayyer? i atta yodea sheyyisrael bizman hazze devuyim, dechufim, sechufim umetorafin, veyissurin bain alehem? im omer: yodea ani, veeni keday — mekabbelin oto miyyad.

Umodiin oto miktzat mitzvot kallot umiktzat mitzvot chamurot, umodiin oto avon leket shichcha ufea umasar ani. umodiin oto onshan shel mitzvot. omrim lo: heve yodea shead shello bata lemidda zo, achalta chelev — i atta anush karet. chillalta shabbat — i atta anush sekila. veachshav, achalta chelev — anush karet, chillalta shabbat — anush sekila.
Ucheshem shemmodiin oto onshan shel mitzvot, kach modiin oto mattan secharan. omrim lo: heve yodea shehaolam habba eno asuy ella letzaddikim, veyisrael bizman hazze enam yecholim lekabbel
Lo rov tova velo rov pureanut. veen marbin alav, veen medakdekin alav.

Kibbel — malin oto miyyad. nishtayyeyru bo tzitzin hameakkevin et hammila — chozrim umalin oto sheniyya. nitrappe — matbilin oto miyyad. ushene talmide chachamim omdim al gabbav umodiin oto miktzat mitzvot kallot umiktzat mitzvot chamurot. taval veala — hare hu keyisrael lechol devarav.
Ishsha — nashim moshivot otah bemayim ad tzavvarah, ushene talmide chachamim omdim lah mibbachutz, umodiin otah miktzat mitzvot kallot umiktzat mitzvot chamurot.
Echad ger, veechad eved meshucherar. uvimkom shennidda tovelet, sham ger veeved meshucherar tovlin. vechol davar shechotzetz bitvila, chotzetz beger uveeved meshucherar uvenidda.
Zevachim 88b:5-14: Veamar rabbi inyoni bar sason: lamma nismecha parashat korbanot lefarashat bigde chehunna? lomar lach: ma korbanot mechapperin, af bigde chehunna mechapperin.

Ketonet – mechapperet al shefichut (dam) [damim], shenneemar: "vayyishchatu seir izzim vayyitbelu et hakkuttonet baddam". michnasayim – mechapperet al gilluy arayot, shenneemar: "vaase lahem michnese vad [lechassot (et) besar erva]". mitznefet – mechapperet al gasse haruach. minnayin? amar rabbi chanina: yavo davar shebbaggova, vichapper al gova.
Avnet – mechapper al hirhur hallev, hecha deiteh. choshen – mechapper al haddinin, shenneemar: "veasita choshen mishpat". efod – mechapper al avoda zara, shenneemar: "en efod uterafim".

Meil – mechapper al lashon hara. minnayin? amar rabbi chanina: yavo davar shebbakkol, vichapper al kol hara. vetzitz – mechapper al azzut panim; betzitz ketiv: "vehaya al metzach aharon", uveazzut panim ketiv: "umetzach ishsha zona haya lach".
Ini?! veha amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: shene devarim lo matzinu lahen kappara bekorbanot, umatzinu lahen kappara mimmakom acher; veellu hen: shefichut damim velashon hara!
Shefichut damim – meegla arufa, velashon hara – mikketoret. detane rav chananya: minnayin liktoret shemmechapperet? shenneemar: "vayyitten et hakketoret vaychapper al haam".
Vetane deve rabbi yishmael: al ma ketoret mechapperet? al lashon hara. yavo davar shebbachashay, vichapper al maase chashay.
Kashya lashon hara allashon hara, kashya shefichut damim ashshefichut damim!
La kashya; ha didia man katleh, ha dela yedia man katleh. i didia man katleh – bar ketala hu! bemezid vela atro beh.
Velashon hara allashon hara name la kashya – ha betzina, ha befarhesya.
Zohar, Beshalach 7: (Shemot 14:14) Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun. ribbi abba patach (Yeshayahu 58:13) im tashiv mishshabbat raglecha asot chafatzecha beyom kadshi. zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu itrae behon, leitdabbeka behu, mikkol shear ammin dealma, umiggo rechimuta dilhon, kariv lon legabbeh, veyahav lon orayyta, veyahav lon shabbat, deihu kaddisha mikkol shear yomin, venayycha mikkolla, vechedva decholla, veshakil shabbat, lokovel orayyta kella, uman denatir shabbat, keillu natir orayyta kulla.

Vekarata lashshabbat oneg, innuga decholla, innuga denafsha vegufa innuga deillain vetattain. vekarata lashshabbat, may vekarata. deyazmin leh. kema deat amer, (Vayikra 23:2) mikrae kodesh, kelomar, zeminin, kema dimzammin ushepiza leveteh. veal da vekarata lashshabbat oneg, deyazmin leh, kema dimzamnin ushepiza, befatora metakkena, beveta metakkena kedka yeot, bemechla uvemishteya kedka yeot, yattir al shear yomin. vekarata lashshabbat mibbeod yom. (emor 22 amud alef) likdosh Adonai mechubbad: da yom kippurim. tere deinnun chad. vechibbadto measot derachecha, kema deokimna.
Mimmetzo cheftzecha vedabber davar, veha ittemar, begin dehahi milla salleka, veittear milla dechol leella. man dimzammin ushepiza, beh bae leishtaddela, vela baochora.

Ta chaziyi hahu milla denafik mippumeh devar nash, salleka veittear itaruta leella, i letav, i levish. uman deyativ beinnuga deshabbeta, asir leh leitteara milla (43 2) dechol, deha pagim pegimu beyoma kaddisha. man deyativ behillula demalka, la yitchaze lemishbak lemalka, veyitassek beachara.
Uvechol yoma bae leachazaa ovada, uleitara ataruta mimma deitzterich. uveshabbat, bemille dishmayya, uvikdushsha deyoma bae leitteara, vela bemilla achara.

Ta chaze, hacha kad itkeriv paro leaggacha kerava behu beyisrael, behahi zimna, la bae kudesha berich hu, deyittearun yisrael itaruta letatta kelal, deha itaruta leella hu, deha avahan akdimu veattearu itaruta da leella, uzechuta dilhon kaim kameh, (veattearu itaruta da) vela baa kudesha berich hu deyisrael yittearun letatta kelal. (deha beatrah leella hava) hada hu dichtiv Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun. tacharishun vadday, vela titarun milla, dela itzterich lechu, vehacha itkelil shema kaddisha beatvavn reshiman, veha itaru beh chavrayyay.

Ribbi yose veribbi yehuda havo azle bearcha. amar ribbi yose leribbi yehuda, vadday tannina, Adonai, bechol atar rachame, veaf al gav deaggach kerava, veavid dina, hahu dina birchimuta hu. vehacha chamena, dichtiv Adonai yillachem lachem, vela itchaze behahu dina rachame kelal, deha ketiv lo nishar bahem ad echad.

Amar leh, milla da shemana meribbi shimon deamar, deafillu hacha dina berachame hava, dechafa alehon yamma umitu, ulevatar appik lon yamma, vekudesha berich hu baa bikarehon, veitkevaru beara, vela baat ara lekabbela lon, ad deoshit lah kudesha berich hu yemineh, vekabbilat lon, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 15:12) natita yemincha tivlaemo aretz. uvegin da, (hava) hay dina berachame hava.

Veal da, la baa kudesha berich hu deyittearun yisrael milla bealma, dei yitarun yisrael milla, la yitarun shema derachame, vela yitavid dina berachame, hada hu dichtiv Adonai yillachem lachem veattem tacharishun, dela titarun midi. deha shema derachame bae leitteara alayyhu, lemebad dina berachame. veal da bae, dela taavdun pegimu, vetitarun milla achara.

Amar leh, veha ketiv, (zecharya 14:3) veyatza Adonai venilcham baggoyim hahem. i hachi da dina berachame hava. amar leh, hachi hava vadday, dina hu berachame, demota dilhon la ishtechach kemotana dishar bene alma, ella chas alayyhu kudesha berich hu, dela yehon kemotana dishar bene alma, dekatilu lon, ella benachat belo tzaara, ha dina berachame ihu.

Uvechol atar, shema da, dina berachame ihu, bar atar chad, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 42:13) Adonai kagibbor yetze vegomer. vechi kagibbor velo gibbor. ella yeshanne levushoy, veyilbash levushin acharanin. keish milchamot, yeshanne zineh.

Veim kol da, dina hu yattir, aval rachame beh, kema dichtiv, kagibbor, velo gibbor. keish milchamot, velo ish milchamot. devadday af al gav deavid dina, chas al ovadoy, veal da, Adonai yillachem lachem vadday veattem tacharishun. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu barir lon lechulakeh veachasanteh, dichtiv, (Devarim 32:9) ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato.
Zohar, Miketz 12: Vayyiru haanashim ki huveu bet yosef. ribbi yose amar, vavy lon livne nasha, dela yade vela mistakkelin bearche deorayyta. vavy lon beshata dekudesha berich hu yete lemitba lon dina al ovadehon, veyakum gufa venafsha lemehav chushebana mikkol ovadehon, ad la yitparshun nafsha min gufa.

Vehahu yoma, yoma dedina ihu, yoma desifrin petichan, umarehon dedina kayymin. begin dehahu zimna, kayyma nachash bekiyyumeh, lenashcha leh. vechol shayyfe mitraggeshin legabbeh, venishmata itparsha min gufa, veazla veshatya. vela yadat lean archa tehach, ulean atar salkin lah.

Vavy lehahu yoma, yoma derugeza uneitzu hahu yoma, vegin kach ibbae leh levar nash, leargaza yitzreh kol yoma, leadkara kammeh hahu yoma, deyekum bedina demalka, deka alin leh techot ara leitrakkeva, venishmata itparsha minneh.

Utenan, leolam yargiz adam yetzer tov al yetzer hara, veyishtaddel avatreh. i azil minneh, yaot. vei lav, yishtaddal beorayyta. deha let lach milla letavra yetzer hara ella orayyta. i azil, mutav. vei lav, yadkar leh yoma demota, begin letabbera leh.

Hacha it leistakkala, deha da hu (161 b) yetzer hara, veda hu malach hammavet. vechi malach hammavet mitbar mikkamme yoma demota. veha ihu katola divni nasha have, veishtema dechedva hu dileh. uvegin kach aste lon livni nasha tadir, begin leamshacha lon leda.

Ella vadday ma deittemar, deyidkor leh bar nash hahu yoma demota. vadday hachi hu, begin demitbar libba devar nash. deha yetzer hara la sharya ella beatar deishtakkach chedva dechamra, vegassuta derucha. vechad ishtakkach rucha tevira, keden itperash minneh, vela sharya bahadeh. uvegin kach bae leadkara leh yoma demota, veyitbar gufeh, veihu azil leh.

Ta chaze, yetzer tov bae chedva deorayyta, veyetzer ra chedva dechamra, veniufin vegassuta derucha. uvegin kach bae bar nash leargaza (leh) tadir, mehahu yoma rabba, yoma dedina, yoma dechushebna. delet leh levar nash laagana aleh, ella ovadoy dechashran, deihu avid behay alma. begin deyaginu aleh behahi shata.

Ta chaze, vayyiru haanashim ki huveu bet yosef. uma kullehu havu gibbarin, kullehu takkifin, vechad ulema deayyte lon leveta deyosef, dachalu. kad yete kudesha berich hu lemitba leh ledina levar nash, al achat kamma vechamma.

Begin kach bae leh levar nash, leizdahara behay alma. leittakfa beh bekudesha berich hu, veyashve beh rochatzaneh. deaf al gav deihu chate, i yehdar minneh bityuveta shelemata, ha takkif ihu, veyittakkaf beh bekudesha berich hu, keillu la chata.

Deha shivtin, begin dechatu al genevat yosef, havu dachalin. deillemale la chatu, la havu dachalin kelal. begin dechovoy devar nash metabberin libbeh, velet leh chela kelal. may tama, deha hahu yetzer hattov itbar immeh, velet leh chela leittakkefa al hahu yetzer hara. veal da ketiv, (Devarim 20:8) mi haish hayyare verach hallevav, hayyare (dayraah da) mechovin devidoy, deinun tevira delibba devar nash.

Veta chaze, lechamma darin itpera kudesha berich hu, meinun chovin deshivtin, deha la itavid mikkammeh dekudesha berich hu kelum. veitpera middara ledara, vedina kayyma kammeh tadir, ad deitpera, veshare dina beatar deitzterich.

Menalan, mechizkiyyahu. chizkiyyahu chav hahu chova, degale setirin dekudesha berich hu, lishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, dela hava itzterich legallaa. vekudesha berich hu shaddar leh lishayahu, veamar leh, (Yeshayahu 39:6) hinne yamim baim venissa kol asher bevetecha vaasher atzru avotecha ad hayyom hazze vegomer.

Ta chaze, kamma garim hahu chova, begin degalle ma dehava satim. dechevan deitgele, ityeyhiv ducheta leatar ochora dela itzterich, leshalletaa aleh. begin kach lav beracha sharya, ella beatar satim. veukemuha, ma deihu (hava) satim, beracha (dehava) sharya aloy, kevan deitgele ityeyhiv ducheta, leatar ochora leshaltaa aloy.

Ketiv, (Eicha 1:8) kol mechabbedeha hizziluha ki rau ervatah, veukemuha. aval kol mechabbedeha hizziluha, da hu malchut bavel, deha mittamman ishtaddar doron liyrushelem. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 39:1) baet hahi shalach merodach baladan ben baladan melech bavel sefarim umincha el chizkiyyahu.

Uma ketiv behu, shelam lechizkiyahu melech yehuda, ushelam lelaha rabba ushelam liyrushelem. kevan denafak pitkeh minneh, ahadar lelibbeh veamar, la yaot avdit leakdama shelama deavda, lishlama demareh. kam mikkuresye ufasa 3 pesian veahadar pitkeh, vechatav ochoranin techotayyhu, vechatav hachi. shelam lelaha rabba, shelam liyrushala 40, ushelam lechizkiyya, veda hu mechabbedeha.

Ulevatar hizziluha, may tama hizziluha. begin ki rau ervata, deachze lon chizkiyya. deilmale kach, lo hizziluha levatar. miggo dehava zakkaa chizkiyyahu yattir, itakkav milla milleayytaa, vela ata beyomoy. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 39:8) ki yihye shalom veemet beyamay. ulevatar pakkid hahu chova livnoy abbatreh.

Kegavvna da, hahu chova deshivtin, kaim ad levatar. begin dedina dilela, la yachil leshalletaa alayyhu, ad deishtakkach shata leitpara, veitpera minnayyhu. ubbegin kach kol man deit chovin bidoy, dachil tadir. kema deat amer, (Devarim 28:66) ufachadta layla veyomam vegomer. veal da vayyiru haanashim ki huveu vegomer:
Zohar, Miketz 4: Vayyishlach paro vayyikra et yosef vayritzuhu min habbor vegomer. ribbi abba patach veamar, (Tehillim 147:11) rotze Adonai et yereav et hameyachalim lechasdo. kamma kudesha berich hu, itrae behu betzaddikaya, begin detzaddikaya inun avdin (shelama veavde) shelama leela, veavde shelama letatta, veoolin kalla bevaalah. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu itrae behu, beinnun dedachalin leh veavdin reuteh.

Lamyachalim lechasdo, man inun meyachalim lechasdo. hve ema inun demishtaddele beorayyta belelya, veishtattefu bahade shechinta. vechad ate tzafra, inun mechakkan lechasdo. veha ukemuha, bezimna devar nash ishtaddal beorayyta belelya, chuta dechesed itmeshich aleh bimama. kedichtiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo uvalayla shiro immi. may tama yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo, mishshum devallayla shiro immi. ubbegin kach rotze Adonai et yereav ketiv, velo vireav. keman derae biruteh leachara, veitree leh leitpayysa bahadeh. uvegin kach rotze Adonai et yereav, velo bireav.

Kegavvna da, yosef hava atziv baatzivu derucha, baatzivu delibba, dehava asir tamman. kevan deshaddar paro begineh, ma ketiv. vayritzuhu, itpayysu leh veahadaru leh millin dechedva, millin lemechede libba, begin dehava atziv min bera. ta chaze, bekadmita nafal bevera, bevera istallak levatar.

Ribbi shimon amar, ad la era leyosef hahu ovada, la ikre tzaddik. kevan denatar hahu berit kayyayma, ikre tzaddik. vehahu darga divrit kaddisha itattar bahadeh, umay dehava (avid) babbor bekadmita, istallak bahadeh, uchetiv vayritzuhu min habbor. istallak min da, veitattar biver mayim chayyim.

Vayyishlach paro vayyikra et yosef, likro leyosef mibbae leh. ella vayyikra et yosef, da kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Tehillim 105:19) ad et bo devaro imrat Adonai tzerafathu. ad et bo devaro, hada hu dichtiv vayykra et yosef, ketiv hacha vayyikra et yosef, uchetiv hatam vayyikra el moshe: vaygallach vaychallef simlotav, begin yekara demalka, veha ukemuha.

Ribbi elazar patach, (Tehillim 105:23) vayyavo yisrael mitzrayim veyaakov gar beeretz cham. ta chaze, dekudesha berich hu megalgel gilgulin bealma, umekayyem esarin vekiyyumin, begin lekayyma kiyyuma ugezera deihu gazir.

Deha tenan, illemale chavivu urechimu derachim kudesha berich hu laavahan, hava itchaze lenachata yaakov lemitzrayim beshalshele defarzela. uvirchimu dilhon, shalteh leyosef bereh, veavad leh malka deshallita al kol ara, venachatu kullehu shivtin bikara, veyaakov kemalka.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, vayyavo yisrael mitzrayim veyaakov gar beeretz cham, kevan dichtiv vayyavo yisrael mitzrayim, la yedana deyaakov gar beeretz cham, ammay itzterich ha. ella vayyavo yisrael mitzrayim, da kudesha berich hu. veyaakov gar beeretz cham, da yaakov, deha begineh deyaakov uvenoy, ata shechinta lemitzrayim. vekudesha berich hu gilgel gilgulin, veachit leh leyosef bekadmita. devizchuteh itkeyyaym berit bahadeh, veshalteh al kol ara.

Ma ketiv, shalach melech vayyattirehu moshel ammim vayfattechehu. ribbi shimon amar, ketiv, (Tehillim 146:7) Adonai mattir asurim vegomer, (veha) vehacha ketiv, shalach melech vayyattirehu, ammay moshel ammim vayfattechehu. ella, shalach melech, da kudesha berich hu. moshel ammim, da kudesha berich hu. shalach melech, melech illaa shalach vayyattiyirihu, uman ihu deshalach (leh), da malach haggoel, deihu moshel ammim, deihu moshel al tattae. vecholla meim kudesha berich hu ihu.

Vayritzuhu chaser vav, uman ihu, da kudesha berich hu. begin deha let man deasir ufattach, bar kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (iyyov 12:14) yisgor al ish velo yippateach. uchetiv, (iyyov la) vehu yashkit umi yarshia veyaster panim umi yeshurennu veal goy veal adam yachad, deha kolla beh. uchetiv, (Daniel 4:32) uchemitzbeye aved bechel shemaya vedayyre ara vela itay di yemache videh veyemar leh ma avadt. uvegin kach ketiv, vayritzuhu min habbor vegomer.

May vayritzuhu. kema deat amer, (iyyov 33:26) yetar el eloah vayyirtzehu. kegavvna da vayritzuhu min habbor, ulevatar vayyavo el paro. davar acher vayritzuhu, deamshich aleh chuta dechesed, lemehav leh chinna kammeh defaro. (45 ketiv), elohim yaane et shelom paro, begin leakdama leh shalom ulemiftach beshalom.

Ribbi abba amar, ta chaze, behahu rasha defaro. deihu amar, (Shemot Adonai:2) lo yadati et Adonai, ufaro chakkim hava mikkol chorashoy. ella vadday shema deelohim hava yada, deha ketiv, hanimtza chaze ish asher ruach elohim bo. uvegin demoshe la ata legabbeh ella bishma daAdonai velo bishma deelohim. veda hava kashya kameh mikkolla, deihu hava yada deha shema da ihu shallit beara. uvishma daAdonai la hava yada, veal da kashya kammeh shema da.
Veda hu dichtiv (Shemot 9:12) vaychazek Adonai et lev paro, demilla da hava atkif libbeh, veakshe leh. veal da moshe lo oda leh milla dishma ochora, ela shema daAdonai bilchodoy, veukemuha.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 113:5) mi kaAdonai elokenu hammagbihi lashavet vegomer. mi kaAdonai elokenu hammagbihi lashavet, deistallak meal karse yekareh, (sefer acher al karse yekareh leella) vela itgeli letatta. beshata dela ishtakkachu zakkain bealma, ha ihu istallak minnayyhu, vela itgeli lehu. hammashpili lirot, beshata dezakkain inun deishtakkachu bealma. kudesha berich hu nachit bedargoy lekivlehon detattae, leashgacha al alma, leotava lehu.
Deha kad zakkain la ishtakkachu bealma, ihu istallak, veastir anpin minnayyhu, velo ashgach alayyhu. begin detzaddikayyay inun yesoda vekiyyuma dealma, dichtiv, (Mishlei 10:25) vetzaddik yesod olam.

Veal da kudesha berich hu la galle shemeh kaddisha, bar leyisrael bilchodoy, deinun chulak adveh veachsanteh. vealma palig leh kudesha berich hu limmannan terisin, veha ittemar. dichtiv, (Devarim 32:9) behanechel elyon goyim vegomer. uchetiv, ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato.
Ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose havu azle vearcha. amar ribbi yose leribbi chiyyay, tevavhna al hay dekaamar shelomo, kol milloy (milin) setimin vela ityaydun, deha kohelet satim (milin) setimin.

Patach veamar, (Kohelet 1:8) kol haddevarim yegeim lo yuchal ish ledabber lo tisba ayin lirot velo timmale ozen mishmoa. kol haddevarim yegeim, vechi kol haddevarim yegeim inun lemallala, dekaamar lo yuchal ish ledabber. velo tisba ayin lirot velo timmale ozen mishmoa, may tama illen. ella begin ditren minhon, veinun ayynin veudenin, la kayyaymin birshuteh devar nash, ufuma ihu birshuteh. vechol (45) illen telat la yachlin leashlama kolla, uleadbaka kolla.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, hachi hu, dedibbura devar nash la yachil lemallala, veayynin lemecheme, veudenin lemishma, veen kol chadash tachat hashshemesh. veta chaze, afilu biryayn vekastorin, deavad kudesha berich hu tachat hashshemesh, la yachlin lemallala kol millin dealma, veena la yachil lemishlat ulemechome, veudena lemishma. uvegin kach shelomo dehava yada kol milla, hava amar da.

Veta chaze, kol ovadin dealma, bechamma kasterin talyayn, vechol bene alma la yadin, vela mashgichin al ma kayyme bealma, veafillu shelomo malka, dehava chakkim mikkol bene alma, la yachil lekayyma behu.

Patach veamar, (Kohelet 3:11) et hakkol asa yafe beitto gam et haolam natan belibbam mibbeli asher lo yimtza haadam et hammaase asher asa haelohim vegomer. ta chaze, zakkain inun demishtaddele beorayyta veyade leistakkala berucha (sefer acher beraza) dechachmata. et hakkol asa yafe beitto, kol ovadin deavad kudesha berich hu bealma, bechol ovada veovada, it darga memanna al hahu ovada bealma, hen letav hen levish. minnehon dargin limina, uminhon dargin lismala. azil bar nash limina, hahu ovada deavid, hahu darga memanna (sefer acher dimina) lehahu sitra, (avide) veavid leh siyyua, vechamma inun dimsayye leh. azal bar nash lismala, veavid ovadoy, hahu ovada deavid, memanna (sefer acher darga dismala) ihu lehahu sitra, veka mekatreg leh, veovil leh lehahu sitra, veaste leh. ubbegin kach hahu ovada deavid bar nash kedka chaze, hahu memanna distar yemina ka mesayyea leh. veda hu beitto, yafe beitto, dehahu ovada mitkashshera beitto, kedka chaze leh.

Gam et haolam natan belibbam. kol alma, vechol ovadoy dealma, lav inun ella biruta delibba, kad salik biruta (delibba, vechad salik biruta) devar nash. zakkain innun tzaddikayya deamshichu ovadin tavin, leotava lon ulechol alma, veinun yadin leitdabbeka beet shalom. uvechela ditzdaka deavdin letatta, inun mashchin lehahu darga deikre kol, leanhara beitto.
Vavy lon lechayyayvaya dela yadin et dehahu ovada, vela mashgichin lemebad ovadehon bealma al tikkuna deitzterich leh lealma. uleatkana ovada behahu darga deitchaze leh. may tama, begin dela yadin.

Veal da ityeyhiv kolla birutehon divne nasha. dichtiv, mibbeli asher lo yimtza haadam et hammaase asher asa haelohim merosh vead sof. uvegin kach deinun ovadin la itavidu leatkana bedargayyhu kidkachaze, deyitkelil ovada da bedarga da, kolla ketikkuna ella kefum reuta devar nash. ma ketiv batreh yadati ki en tov bam ki im lismoach velaasot tov bechayyav. yadati ki en tov bam, beinun ovadin, dela itavidu kedka yeut. ki im lismoach, bechol ma deyete aloy, ulemehav hodaa lekudesha berich hu. velaasot tov bechayyav, deha i hahu ovada garim leh bisha, begin hahu darga deka memanna aloy, it leh lemechode beh, uleodaa aleh. deihu garim leh lenafsheh, veihu azil bela yedia, ketzifora da bego kusetira.

Vechol da menalan, dichtiv, (kahelatet) ki gam lo yeda haadam et itto, kaddagim shenneechazim bimtzoda raa vechatztzipporim haachuzot bappach kahem yukashim bene haadam leet raa keshettippol alehem pitom. ki gam lo yada haadam et itto. may itto, itto dehahu ovada deka avid. kema deat amer, et hakkol asa yafe beitto, uvegin kach inun katztzipporim haachuzot bappach. uvegin kach zakkain inun demishtaddele beorayyta, veyade orchoy usheviloy deorayyta demalka illaa, lemehach bah beorach keshot.

Veta chaze, leolam al yiftach bar nash pumeh levish, deihu la yada man natil hahi milla. vechad la yada bar nash itkeshal bah. vetzaddikaya kad patche pumayyhu kullehu shelam. ta chaze, yosef kad shara lemallala lefaro. ma ketiv, elohim yaane et shelom paro. amar ribbi yehuda, ha ittemar. dekudesha berich hu chas al shelama demalchuta, kema deat amer, (Shemot 6:13) vaytzavvim el beni yisrael veel paro melech mitzrayim veukemuha.
Zohar, Miketz 5: Ribbi chiyyay amar, paro baa lenassaa leh leyosef, veachlaf leh chelma. veyosef begin dehava yada dargin, istakkal bechol milla umilla. veamar, kach chamita, kol milla umilla kedka chaze.

Hada hu dichtiv vayyomer paro el yosef achare hodia elohim otcha et kol zot en navon vechacham kamocha. achare hodia elohim, acharay havet behahi shata dachalamit chelma, tamman havet shechiach. uvegin kach amar (sefer acher emet et kol zot yadata, veech yadata pishreh) et kol zot yadat chelma hech hava, veyadat pishreh.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, i hachi yosef amar kolla, chelma ufishra. kedaniyyel deamar chelma ufishreh. amar leh, lav hay kehay (15 33 deha). yosef istakkal miggo millula defaro dehava amar bedargin yedian, vechama leh deka taa, veamar leh lav hachi, ella hachi hu. begin dedargin kesidran atyayn. aval daniyyel la istakkal miggo millula dinvuchadnetztzar kelum. (dela) vecholla kaamar leh chelma ufishreh.
Ma ketiv bedaniyyel, (Daniel 2:19) edayin ledaniyyel bechezva di lelya raza gali bechezva di lelya. man chezva di lelya, da gavriel, deihu chezva chezu min chezu.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, (yechezkel 43:2) vehinne kevod eloke yisrael ba midderech hakkadim vekolo kekol mayim rabbim vehaaretz heira mikkevodo. ma ketiv batreh, uchemare hammare asher raiti bevoi leshachet et hair umarot kammare asher raiti el nehar kevar vaeppol el panay. kol illen marot, inun shit, deinun marot vechezu dechezva. chezu it leh, leitchazaa beh gevavnin dilela, veitchazun behahu chezu. veit chezu lechezu, vechezu lechezu, da al da. vechullehu kayymin bedargin yedian veshalte, veikrun chezu delelya, uvehu mitparshin kol chelmin dealma, veillen inun kegavvna dilela alayyhu.

Ubbegin kach daniyyel bechezva delelya raza gali. itgeli la ketiv, ella raza gali, chad meillen dargin, galle leh hahu chelma ufishreh. aval yosef, miggo milloy defaro, istakkal bedargin illain vekaamar.

Uvegin kach pakdeh al kol ara demitzrayim, begin dekudesha berich hu, middileh deyosef ka yahiv leh. puma dela nashak laavera, ketiv veal picha yishshak kol ami. yada dela kariv laavera, ketiv vayyitten otah al yad yosef. tzavvar dela kariv laavera, ketiv vayyasem revid hazzahav al tzavvaro. gufa dela kariv laavera, vayyalbesh oto bigde shesh. regel dela rachiv laavera, ketiv vayyarkev oto bemirkevet hammishne asher lo. hammachashava dela chashav, nikra navon vechacham. lev shello hirher, vayyikreu lefanav avrech. vecholla middileh natal.

Ma ketiv. vayyetze yosef millifni faro vayyaavor bechol eretz mitzrayim. amar ribbi chizkiyya, may tama vayyaavor bechol eretz mitzrayim. begin leshaltaa, demachreze kamme hachi. uvegin lemichnash ibbura bechol atar vaatar. ribbi elazar amar, kanash yosef ibbur bechol atar, begin dela yitrakkav.

Amar ribbi shimon, kol ma deavad kudesha berich hu, kolla ihu legalgela gilgulin, begin devae lekayyma kiyyuma. ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, ayyte kol ma deitzterich alma bekadmita, ulevatar ayyte leh levar nash lealma, veashkach mezona.

(15 33 Ta chaze) kegavvna da, kudesha berich hu amar leavraham, (Bereshit 15:13) yadoa teda ki ger yihye zaracha beeretz lo lahem vegomer, veachare chen yetzu birchush gadol. kad ata yosef leara demitzrayim, la ishtechach bah rechush gadol. gilgel gilgulin, veayyte kafna al alma. vechol alma havu mayytin kaspa vedahava lemitzrayim, veitmele chol ara demitzrayim kaspa vedahava. levatar deittakkan kolla rechush gadol, ayyte yaakov lemitzrayim.

Dehachi arche dekudesha berich hu, bekadmita bare (sefer acher ak1dayyam) asvavta, ulevatar mache. kach bekadmita atkin rechush gadol, ulevatar ayyte lon legaluta. veal da gilgel gilgulin veayyte kafna al kol alma, begin delehvu mayytin kaspa vedahava kol alma lemitzrayim.

Ta chaze, begin (kach) yosef deihu tzaddik, ihi garim utera kaspa vedahava, lenatla yisrael. kedichtiv, (Tehillim 105:37) vayyotziem bechesef vezahav veen bishvatav koshel. umin yeda detzaddik, ata da leyisrael. vecholla lemizke lon lealma deate.

Patach veamar, (Kohelet 9:9) ree chayyim im ishsha asher ahavta vegomer. ta chaze, hay kera beraza illaa ihu, veukemuha. ree chayyim, illen chayyin dealma deate, dezachaa hu bar nash dezache beh kedka yeut.

Im ishsha asher ahavta, da keneset yisrael, begin devah ketiv ahava. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:3) veahavat olam ahavticha, ematay. beshata desitra dimina achid bah. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:3) al ken meshachtich chased.

(Kohelet 9:9) kol yeme chayye hevlecha, begin deihi itkashsherat bachayyim, veihi olam dechayyin sharyayn beh. deha alma da, la sharyayn beh chayyim. begin deinun tachat hashshemesh, vela matan hacha inun nehorin dehahu shimsha, veistallaku mealma miyyoma deitchariv be makdesha. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 13:10) chashach hashshemesh betzeto vegomer. may chashach hashshemesh, desalik nehoreh vela nahir. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 57:1) hatztzaddik avad vegomer.
Ki hu chelkecha bachayyim, da hu shimsha besihara, uveinan lemeal sihara beshimsha veshimsha besihara, dela leafrasha lon. veda hu chulaka devar nash, lemeal behu lealma deate.

Ma ketiv batreh, (Kohelet 9:10) kol asher timtza yadcha laasot bechochacha ase ki en maase vecheshbon vedaat vechachma bashol asher atta holech shamma. hay kera it leistakkala beh. kol asher timtza yadcha laasot, vechi huttera retzua lemebad bar nash kol ma deyachil. ella, laasot bechochacha ketiv, may bechochacha. da nishmateh devar nash, deihi chela devar nash, lemizke vah lealma den ulealma deate.
Davar acher bechochacha, da hi ishsha dekaamaran, deihi chela leittakfa bah, bealma den uvealma deate. uvae bar nash lemizke vah behay alma behay chela, begin deyittakkaf bah behahu alma.

May tama. begin dilvatar deyippuk bar nash mehay alma, let beh chela lemebad middi velomar, hasheta, mikkan ulehala aavid ovadin tavin. devadday en maase vecheshbon vedaat vechachma bashol asher vegomer. i la zache bar nash behay alma, la yizke beh levatar behahu alma. veukemuha, man dela atkin zevavdin lemehach mehay alma, la yechul behahu alma. veit ovadin tavin deavid bar nash behay alma, deyechul minnayyhu hacha. vecholla ishtaar lealma deate uleittezna minnayyhu.

Ta chaze, yosef zacha behay alma vezacha bealma deate, begin devaa leitachada beishsha yirat Adonai. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 39:9) vechatati lelohim. uvegin kach zacha lemishlat behay alma, vezacha lon leyisrael.

Ma ketiv, (Bereshit 47:14) vaylakket yosef et kol hakkesef. vehachi itchaze, deha hahu nahar denagid venafik, ihu lakit kolla, vechol utera beh kayyma. veda hi raza dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:17) vayyitten otam elohim birkia hashshamayim, vecholla ihu kedka yeut, vadday yosef bae lemishlat al malchuta.

Veta chaze, ketiv, vayyarkev oto bemirkevet hammishne. man mirkevet hammishne. kudesha berich hu avid leh latztzaddik shallita, begin deha minneh ittezan alma, veitzterich leittezana. vekudesha berich hu it leh reticha illaa, veit leh reticha tattaa. reticha tattaa ihi mirkevet hammishne, veyosef tzaddik ikre, veleh itchaze lemehve rachiv al mirkevet hammishne asher lo, lekudesha berich hu. vecholla ihu beraza ilaa, lemeheve kegavvna dilela.

Ta chaze, vayyikreu lefanav avrech, may avrech. keshiru deitkkashshar shimsha besihara, vecholla karin lokovel atar da. venaton oto al kol alma, vechullehu odan legabbeh, uvegin da kolla beraza illaa ihu.

Ta chaze, kudesha berich hu avad malchuta deara, keen malchuta dirkia, vecholla da kegavvna da. vechol ma deitavid beara kayyma kamme kudesha berich hu bekadmita. ta chaze, malchuta kaddisha, la kabbil malchuta shelemata, ad deitchabbar baavahan. begin dekudesha berich hu avad lah lemalchu illaa, leitnahara meraza deavahan.

Vechad yosef hatztzaddik nachat lemitzrayim bekadmita, ihu mashich lah lishchinta levatar immeh, deha shechinta la azla ella batra detzaddik. uvegin kach itmeshach yosef lemitzrayim bekadmita, venatil kol utera dealma kedka yeut, ulevatar nachatat shechinta lemitzrayim, vechullehu shivtin bahadah.

Uvegine kach, yosef denatar leh labberit, zacha leitattera beatreh, vezacha lemalchuta dilela, ulemalchuta diltatta. veal da kol man denatar berit kaddisha, keillu kiyyem orayyta kaddisha kola, deha berit shakil kechol orayyta:
Zohar, Miketz 9: Vayyizkor yosef et hachalomot asher chalam lahem vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Mishlei 24:17) binfol oyivcha al tismach uvikkashlo al yagel libbecha. ta chaze, kudesha berich hu avad leh levar nash, deyizke likara dileh, uleshammasha kammeh tedira, uleishtaddela beorayyta yemama velele. begin dekudesha berich hu itrae bah beorayyta tadir.

Vechevan devara kudesha berich hu leadam, yahav kammeh orayyta, veolef leh bah leminda archaha. menalan, dichtiv, (iyyov 28:27-28) az raah vaysapperah hchinah vegam chakarah. ulevatar, vayyomer laadam hen yirat Adonai hi chachma vesur mera bina. kevan deistakkal bah vela natir lah, avar al pikkuda demareh veitpas bechoveh.

Vechol inun deavru al milla chada deorayyta, ittefasu vah. shelomo malka deitchakkam al kol bene alma, avar al milla chada deorayyta, vegarim leh leitavara malchuteh minne, uleitpallega malchuta min benoy. man deaavar al orayyta al achat kamma vechamma.

Veyosef dehava yada orayyta, vaachoy naflu bideh, ammay gilgel alayyhu kol gilgula da. veha ihu yada orayyta deolif leh avoy. ella, chas veshalom deyosef gilgel alayyhu gilgulin lenakma minnayyhu. ella kol da la avad, ella leayytaa laachuha binyamin legabbeh, detiuveteh hava legabbe. veihu la shavak laachoy leminpal, deha ketiv, vaytzav yosef vaymalleu et kelehem bar vegomer, vechol da begin dela yinpelun.

Ribbi yehuda amar, kad bera kudesha berich hu lesihara, hava istakkal bah tadir, kedichtiv, (Devarim 11:12) tamid eni Adonai elohecha bah, ashgachuta dileh bah tadir, uchetiv az raah, deha shimsha beashgachuta dileh bah, itnehir. vaysapperah, may vaysapperah, kema deat amer, (iyyov 28:6) mekom sappir avaneha.

Hechinah, deihi yatva betikkuna, bitresar techumin, mitpallega (Shemot 58 b) beshivin kesirin. atkin lah beshiva samchin illain, leitnahara uleyatva al shelimu. vegam chakarah, leashgacha alah tadir, zimna batar zimna, dela pasik lealmin.

Ulevatar azhar leh levar nash, veamar vayyomer laadam hen yirat Adonai hi chachma vesur mera bina. dehay mitattera al tattay, ledachala uleminda leh lekudesha berich hu beginah. vesur mera bina, beriru mippesaluta, dela lemikrav bahadeh. ucheden ashgachuta (nusach acher ashekachevatea) devina, leminda uleistakkela bikara demalka illaa.

Ribbi yose kam belelya chad leishtaddela beorayyta, vehava tamman immeh chad yuday, deoora beh behahu veta. patach ribbi yose veamar, (Mishlei 10:2-3) lo yoilu otzrot resha utzedaka tatztzil mimmavet. lo yoilu otzrot resha, illen inun dela mishtaddele beorayyta, veazle batar mille dealma, ulemichnash otzrin dechiyyuva. ma ketiv, veavad haosher hahu beinyan ra. begin deinun otzrot resha.

Utzedaka tatztzil mimmavet, illen demishtaddele beorayyta, veyadin orchaha leishtaddela (leistakkela) vah. deha orayyta etz chayyim ikre, veitkeriat tzedaka. dichtiv, utzedaka tihye lanu. davar acher, utzedaka tatztzil mimmavet, da tzedaka mammash, uvitren gevavnin ihu, uvitren sitrin. kare beh orayyta, vekare beh tzedaka, vecholla chad.

Amar hahu yuday, vekare beh shalom. amar ribbi yose, hachi hu vadday deikre shalom. kam hahu yuday, veishtattaf bahadeh, patach hahu yuday veamar, (Mishlei 28:19) oved admato yisba lachem umeraddef rekim yisba resh. hay kera kashya, vechi shelomo malka deihu chakkim mikkol bene alma, hech amar deyishtaddal bar nash lemiflach ara uleishtaddela avatreh, veyishbok chayye alma.

Ella raza ihu. patach veamar, (Bereshit 2:15) vayyikkach Adonai elohim et haadam vayyannichehu vegan eden leavdah uleshamrah, veukemuha beraza dekarbanin ihu. ta chaze, leavdah, da malka illaa. uleshamrah, da malka tattaa. alma illaa, vealma tattaa. leavdah (didchura) beraza dezachor, uleshamrah beraza deshamor.

Ubbegin kach, oved admato, da gan eden. deitzterich lemebad ulemiflach, uleamshacha lah birchan milleela. vechad itbarcha veitmashshecha lah birchan milleela, ihu name itbarech bahadah. ta chaze, dechahana dimvarech, mitbarech. kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 6:27) vaani avarachem. uvegin kach, oved admato yisba lachem, da hu mezona dilela. umeraddef rekim, man deyitdabbak besitra ochora, deihu meraddef rekim. yisba resh vday. amar ribbi yose, zakkaa ant, dezachit lehay milla.

Tu patach veamar kera avatreh, (Mishlei 28:20) ish emunot rav berachot, da hu bar nash dimhemnuta dekudesha berich hu beh, kegon ribbi yesa sava. deaf al gav dehava leh mechla dehahu yoma lemechal, la hava matkin leh ad deshail mezoneh kamme malka kaddisha. levatar detzalle tzeloteh veshail mezoneh kamme malka, keden hava metakkin. vehava amar tadir, la netakkin, ad deyinnatnun mibbe malka.
Veatz lehaashir lo yinnake, begin dela baa leishtaddela beorayyta, deihi chayyin dealma den, vechayyin dealma deate. hasheta deihi shata leishtaddela beorayyta, nishtaddel.

Patach hahu gavra beraza dechelma veamar, vayyizkor yosef et hachalomot asher chalam lahem vegomer. vayyizkor yosef et hachalomot, vechi yosef ammay (nusach acher amar o) adkar lon inun chalomot dechalam lehu. uma sagya leh illu la adkar lehu, deha yosef chakkim hava, uchetiv, kol arum yaase vedaat uchesil yifros ivvelet.

Aval, kevan dechama deinun attu, vesagde leh appin al ara. keden idkar mimma dechalam lehu, kad hava immehon. dichtiv, vehinne kamma alummati vegam nitztzava vehinne tesubbena alummotechem vattishtachavena laalummati. amar yosef beshata dechama decharin achoy kammeh. dichtiv, vayyavou ache yosef vayyishtachavu lo appayim artza, keden vayyizkor yosef et hachalomot asher chalam. deha chama dehavu kayyme (mitkayyeymme).

Tu, vayyizkor yosef et hachalomot asher chalam, adkar lon. begin delet nashyu kamme kudesha berich hu, deha chelma deihu tava, bae var nash leadkara leh dela yitneshe, ucheden itkeyyaym. deha kema deitneshe kammeh devar nash, hachi itneshe aleh.

Ta chaze, chelma dela itpashshar, keiggarta dela mitkarya, veta chaze, begin dela idkar, keman dela yada leh. veal da, man deitneshe minneh chelma vela yada leh, la kayyma aleh leitkayyma. uvegin da yosef hava dachir chelmeh, begin leitkayyeyma. begin dela yitneshe chelma minneh lealam, vehava mechakke leh tadir. vayyomer alehem meraggelim attem, ihu dachir chelma. aval milla la amar lon, ella meraggelim attem.

Patach ribbi yose veamar, (Kohelet Adonai:2) ki va hachalom berov inyan vekol kesil berov devarim. ki va hachalom berov inyan, ha ukemuha. dechamma inun semichin bechelma, umemannan dargin al dargin. ad dechalmin minhon keshot kullehu, uminnehon deit behon keshot uchedivu. aval leinun zakkae keshot, la itgeli lon millin kedivan kelum, ella kullehu keshot.

Ta chaze, daniyyel ma ketiv beh, (Daniel 2:19) edayin ledaniyyel bechezva di lelya raza galle. uchetiv, (Daniel 7:1) daniyyel chelem chaza vechezve reshe al mishkeveh bedayin chelma chetav. vei it beh millin kedivan, ammay ichtiv ben ketuvim. ella inun zakkae keshot, beshata denishmathon salkin. la mitchabberan behu, ella millin kaddishin. deodin leh mille dik shot, millin kayyman dela meshakran lealmin.
