Vei tema, ha tenan dedavid malka la chama chelma tava. ha ishtema dehava chame david millin dela keshot. ella vadday, kol yomoy hava mishtaddel leoshda damin, veaggach keravin, vechol chelmoy la havu ella chelmin bishin. chureva veshommuta vedama veoshidu dedamin, vela chelma dishlam.

Vei tema, levar nash tav achaziu leh chelma bisha, hachi hu vadday. kol inun bishin dezamminin leitdabbeka al inun deavre al pitgame deorayyta, veinun onashin dezamminin leitanasha behahu alma, kullehu chame. begin dechol shata yehe dechilu demareh aleh, veha itaru. dichtiv, (Kohelet 3:14) vehaelohim asa sheyyiru milfanav, ze chalom ra. veal da, lehahu zakkaa, achaziu leh chelma bisha, kema deittemar.

Ta chaze, deha taninan, dehahu bar nash dechame chelma, bae leh lemiftach pumeh beh kamme bene nasha derachame leh. begin deyistallak reuta dilhon legabbeh letav, veyiftechun pumayyhu letav, veyishtakkach reuta umilla kolla letav. reuta deihi machashava, sheruta decholla, umilla deihi siyyuma decholla. veal da ishtakkach deha shelimu ihu beraza illaa. uvegin kach itkeyyaym kolla, uveinan rechimin devar nash (nusach acher rechimin aleh davar nash begin) leitkayyeyma behahu pishra tava, vecholla ihu kedka yeut.

Ubbegin kach kudesha berich hu oda leh levar nash, kol chad vechad, behahu darga dileh, kema deihu. uvehahu gavvna dechol chad vechad, amar dihe chelma. amar hahu yuday, vadday dechelma lav ihu ella levar nash zakkaa, deihu chama chelma kedka chaze.

Veta chaze, dechad bar nash naim al arseh, nishmateh nafka veshatya bealma leela, vealat beatra dealat. vechamma chavile tehirin, kayymin veazlin bealma, ufagin bah behahi nishmata. i zakkaa hi, salka leela vechamat ma dechamat. vei lav, itachadat behahu sitra, umodiin lah millin kedivan, o millin dezamminin lemete lizman kariv. vechad itar hahi nishmata deveh, ihi moda leh ma dechamat.

Veal da, levar nash delav ihu zakkaa, modiin leh chelma tava delav ihu keshot. kolla begin leastaa leh mehahu orach keshot. kevan deihu aste orcheh meorach keshot, mesaavin leh. dechol man deate leitdakkaa, medakkein leh. uman deate leistaava, mesaavin leh. ha vadday ittemar hachi.

Yatvu ad desalik tzafra, amar ribbi yose, vadday la zachar shemeh deyosef beinun degalim. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 2:18) degel machane efrayim, vela ketiv degel machane yosef. begin deitgae al achoy, veha ittemar.
Amar hahu yuday, vadday shemana deyosef ihu bealma didchura, vechullehu shivtin bealma denukeva inun. veal da la itkelil yosef immehon, begin deihu bealma didchura immehon (nusach acher 33 immehon).

Ma ketiv, kullanu bene ish echad nachnu. nachnu, anachnu mibbae leh. ammay chaser 1. ella, begin deraza divrit la ishtakkach immehon, istallak mittamman 1. deha 1 dechura ihu. veal da 2 ihi nukeva, 1 dechura. uvegin da istallak 1 mittamman, veishtaaru inun nukeve legave shechinta.

Ulevatar amru, kenim anachnu, ittosaf 1. amru vela yade ma kaamru. begin deyosef ishtakkach tamman, veashlimu milla, veamru anachnu. menalan, dichtiv vayyomru shenem asar avadecha achim anachnu, veyosef ihu bechushebana, kad al bechushebana, amru anachnu. vechad la al bechushebana, amru nachnu.

Amar ribbi yose, kol hanne millin dekaamaran hacha, kudesha berich hu itrae behu, deha shechinta la aade mehacha. kedichtiv, (Malachi 3:16) az nidberu yire Adonai ish el reehu vayyakshev Adonai vayyishma vayyikkatev sefer zikkarun lefanav leyire Adonai ulechoshve shemo:

rashi: Veyosifu lecha shenot chayyim. shanim shel chayyim hem shel parnasa veosher:
targum: Metul devah nisgeyan yomatach veyosfun lach shenaya dechaye:

rashi: Natatti otcha. manneti yatach, veaappi ken leshon netina hu, kemo uletittecha elyon (Devarim 26); ben ligdulla ben leshiflut nofel leshon netina alav, kemo natatti etchem nivzim ushefalim (Malachi 2):
Izvu fetayim vichyu. et derech happatyut:
Veishru. leshon paam, kemo "baashuro achaza ragli" (Iyov 23:11):
targum: Shevuku minchon chasirut rayonchon vichyu vehalichu vearcha divyuna:

rashi: Habberiot. 670 belaaz:
Vehinne chalom. vehinne nishlam chalom shalem lefanav vehutzrach lefotrim:
ohc: Vayyikatz vegomer vehinne chalom. ulay ki bachalom hashshibbolim lo hikkir bo bachalomo ki haya cholem, vehaya choshev shehaya behakitz lerov behirut haddavar, vehikkiro belo bilbul kederech hacholem, ella achar sheamad mishshenato az hikkir lemafrea ki haya cholem, vehu amro vayyikatz paro vehinne matza atzmo ki chalom hayu haddevarim velo behakitz:

Et asher haelohim vegomer. yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot noah.) shelosha devarim hakkadosh baruch hu machriz alehen, vehem sova veraav ufarnas, vehu amro "et asher haelohim ose" bichvodo shello al yede shaliach, higgid vegomer, sova – ellu shene sova, raav – ellu shene raav, parnas – "yere faro ish" vegomer. vahagam shello amar lo mi ze haish, af al pi chen achar haemet tamach goralo bema shemmana happitron mikkol chachamav vegilla lo et yosef al yede sar hammashkim shessipper lo haover alav, venitgalgelu haddevarim venitgalla lo yosef, vayshitehu al eretz mitzrayim. veamro higgid lefaro perush sheyyesh sippuk beyado laasot tikkun, kemo sheamar levassof (Bereshit 41:33) "yere faro vegomer vechimmesh" vegomer:

rashi: Veyeamnu divrechem. yitammetu veyitkayyemu; kemo amen amen (Bamidbar Adonai), uchemo, yeamen na devarcha (Melachim 1 8):
ohc: Veyeamnu divrechem velo tamutu. perush, sheim lo yaasu ze yaggid ki attem meraggelim, velaze enam yecholin lehanniach echad mehem ki vadday sheyyamut, veen reshut lahem laasot ken ella yehargu kullam vechulei, umeatta yitchayyevu mita al heyotam meraggelim. o yirtze lomar shello yamutu baraav ki yetiv immahem lehametzi lahem parnasa, vehu ma sheamru laavihem (Bereshit 42:34) "veet haaretz tischaru".

rashi: Lule hatemahemanev al yadcha, כּvar hayinוּ שׁvim im שׁmeוֹ50 velo nitztaarתּ כּl haיּmim haלּlוּ:

Veet binyamin. metargeminan udevaru yat binyamin, lefi sheen lekichat hakkesef ulekichat haadam shava velashon arammi; bedavar hannikkach bayyad metargeminan unesiv, vedavar hannikkach behanehagat devarim, metargeminan udevar:
Elohechem. bizchutechem, veim en zechutechem keday, velohe avichem, bizchut avichem natan lachem matmon:
ohc: Shalom lachem vegomer. amar ken haish meatzmo mibbeli daat kavvanato shel yosef ma hi, uledivrehem zichronam livracha (tanchuma) sheamru ki hu menashshe, yafe koach habben mikkoach haav veyada ki yaskim al devarav. veamro al tirau, lefi shehukkar bifnehem hayyira dehayu yereim dichtiv (Bereshit 43:18) "vayyiru haanashim".

Natan lachem matmon. perush, eze adam taman sham hakkesef, vaAdonai netano lachem beyeush habbealim, uvene noach enam metzuvvim al hacherazat aveda. ulechazzek libbam hotzi alehem et shimon lehareot ki shalom lahem.

rashi: Vechol haaretz bau mitzrayma el yosef lishbor, veim tidreshehu chesidro, haya tzarich lichtov: lishbor min yosef:

ohc: Veatta yere vegomer. taam yosef shennaasa yoetz lammelech vehu lo bikkesh mimmennu ella pitron hachalom, ki va latet lo taam asher herahu Adonai et asher hu ose, ki hu kede sheyyafked pekidim vegomer. od leheyot sheheruhu bachalom shebbalu happarot harakkot lapparot habberiot, ze yaggid ki yitparnesu shene raav mishshene sava, velaze amar yere faro vegomer:

Ish navon vechacham. ladaat ofen otzrot hattevua leval terakev, veze mehattevuna. veamro vechacham sheyyodea kelaliyyut hachachmot, ladaat chachmat hattishboret vehahandasa vehammispar. vehikdim "navon" ki hu davar hameakkev yoter kede shettitkayyem hattevua.

rashi: Lechu lachamu velachami ushetu beyayin masachti. beyayin shemmazagti:
targum: Etu achulu lachami veishtu chamra dimzaget:

rashi: Habbechor kivchorato. makke baggavia vekore reuven, shimon, levi, yehuda, yissashchar, uzevulun, bene em achat, hasebbu kasseder hazze, shehi seder toldotechem, vechen kullam. kevan shehiggia levinyamin, amar ze en lo em vaani en li em, yeshev etzli:
Vehaya haochel. hatztzavur kishar pikkadon hagganuz lekiyyum haaretz:
ohc: Lesheva shene haraav asher vegomer. perush, kodem kol davar yihye sippuk eretz mitzrayim lefarnes raavonam, veachar kach lishar aratzot, vehu amro achar sippur raav mitzrayim velo tikkaret haaretz vegomer, kan kalal kol haaretz.

rashi: Vayyiftach haechad. hu levi, shennishar yachid mishshimon ben zugo:
Bammalon. bammakom shellanu ballayla:
Amtachto. hu sak:
Mayim genuvim yimtaku. en taam biat penuya ketaam eshet ish. af leinyan hammitzva, mayim genuvim yimtaku. shehayu yereim laasot begaluy veosin beseter:
targum: Maya genuvaya chalyan velachma detimura basima:

rashi: Hanimtza chaze. hanishkach keden? im nelech unevakshennu, hanimtza chamohu? hanimtza leshon temiha; vechen kol hei hameshammeshet berosh teva unekuda vachataf pattach:
ohc: Hanimtza chaze vegomer. taam shello amar hanimtza ish asher vegomer kaze, ki az haya nishma ki nimtza ish asher bo ruach elohim ella sheeno bedome, velo chen nitkavven lomar, ella shello nimtza min ze sheyyesh bo ruach vegomer, lo mimmennu velo miktzato.

rashi: Veet haaretz tischaru. tesovvu; vechol leshon socharim usechora al shem shemmechazrim vesovvim achar happerakmatya:

Betoch habbaim. matminin atzmam shello yakkirum, lefi shetztzivva lahem avihem shello yitrau kullam befetach 1, ella sheyyikkanes kol 1 befitcho, kede shello tishlot bahem ayin hara, shekkullam naim vechullam gibborim:
ohc: Vayyavou vene yisrael vegomer ki haya haraav vegomer. hutzrach lachzor lomar ki haya haraav vegomer. nitkavven latet taam lehabbaim, shello tomar hechan huzkeru habbaim lomar betocham, laze amar ki haya vegomer veyeshnam labbaim.

Od nitkavven lomar shennitchakkemu lehachebi atzmam, uvau betoch otam shebbaim lishbor, mittaam shehaya haraav beeretz kenaan, shebbaze lo yikkansu bachashad meraggelut shechashadam yosef. veze shiur hakkatuv: vayyavou vene yisrael, vederech biatam hayta betoch habbaim, shebbiatam hi ki haya haraav vegomer:

Vayyishal lahem leshalom. perush, mittechilla shaal bishlomam, ki hu mehammusar lehakedim lishol shalom et asher lefanav, vehu amro lahem leshalom, veachar kach shaal al asher enennu sham "hashalom avichem" vegomer:

Hashalom avichem hazzaken vegomer. kashe ech yutzdak lishol hashalom kodem sheelat haodennu chay? veim hakkavvana bishelat hashshalom hi ma shepperesh beamro "haodennu chay", lamma kafal? gam bitshuvat haachim kashe, sheamru "shalom vegomer odennu chay" – achar sheamru "shalom", ma chiddush beamram "odennu chay"?

Veulay shennitkavven lomar im kechocho az kocho atta o huchlash letzad hazzikna, vehu ma sheddikdek lomar odennu perush kemot shehaya bazzeman hakkodem, velaze nitchakkem gam ken lesadder sheelat shalom kodem sheelat haodennu chay, lehavin kavvanato kemo shepperashnu, uchefi ze sheelat haodennu chay enah nichlelet bishelat hashalom lo, ki gam al adam shehizkin veafsu ketzat kochotav kefi hatteva yeamer alav shalom lo:

Halo ze vegomer. lo hutzrach lehazekiro leheyot haish hallaz hu hannoten haggavia beamtachat binyamin, laze lo haya tzarich lehazekiro umuvan etzlo haddavar sheal haggavia hu medabber, vechavvanat devarav hu lehodaat taam haregashatam baggeneva techef umiyyad, ki ze yaggid shehaddevarim maase yedehem asher konnu, laze amru "halo ze asher yishte adoni bo", perush, bitmidut, umitztzad ze hu davar haragil lehishtammesh bo, umizze yadu techef lignevato. veamro vehu nachesh yenachesh ba latet taam lidvarav bederech ze bifshitut shehem genavuhu velo chashad bezulat, laze amar "nachesh yenachesh" perush nachesh – ma shellefanav, yenachesh – ma sheatid lihyot, uvo nichesh veyada ki hem yignevuhu. veulay ki letaam ze natnu lev alav achar halichatam.
Hareotem asher asitem. kashe, achar sheamar "lamma shillamtem raa tachat tova", ma makom lomar hareotem vegomer? halo en lecha raa baolam kemshallem raa tachat tova.

Veulay shennitkavven listor hochachat hahafkiyyut mimma shehechziru hakkesef hashshachuach beamtachtam, ki ze haish asher elav gillu sheheshivu immahem kesef hannimtza ittam, veim ken yaase kal vachomer "hen kesef vegomer veech nignov" kemo sheheshivuhu achar kach, laze amar hareotem asher asitem ki baze setartem leotah chazaka shehechezakti etchem bechashrut bammaase asher asitem bahashavat hakkesef, vehurea chezkatchem ki lo anshe emet hem, vetole ani hammaase bederech mikre, vehu mehammikrim asher yaasu gam haggannavim velo mimmusar hashekel.

Od yirtze beamro hareotem asher asitem, perush bahashavat hakkesef, ki beemtzaut davar ze gillu addatam ki ma shehechziru hakkesef ze adrabba meharesha asu chen, lehachezik otam baanashim baale emuna, shebbeemtzaut ze yaaminu bahem veyimtzeu makom lignov devarim yekarim vechashuv mikkesef hammushav, ki machzik haggavia likar haerech mehakkesef sheheshivu immahem.

Ulehashiv kaspehem. taam shello dibber hakkatuv bashshiur shehitchil ledabber "vaymalu" vegomer, haya lo gam ken lomar "vayyashivu", o haya lo lomar "lemalleot et" vegomer "ulehashiv". veulay ki hamemalle lo yada hashavat hakkesef vehanneeman beto hu heshiv, o tzivva sheyyihye hammilluy befarhesya vahashavat hakkesef behatzenea. od nitkavven lehakedim lomar lemalleot kelehem bar, veachar shemmilu vegomer hosif lomar "lehashiv" vegomer "velatet lahem tzeda" vegomer, vehakkavvana baze ki lo ratza lomar hakkol yachad kede shello tihye en hamemalle tzara bammilluy.

rashi: Vayyomru shenem asar avadecha vegomer. uvishvil oto 1 sheenennu nitpazzarnu vair levakkesho:
ohc: Vayyomru shenem vegomer. perush, taam shennichnasnu beseder ze ki anachnu shenem asar vehaechad enennu, laze nitparadnu vechol echad nichnas beshaar acher ulay yimtza echad mimmennu et haechad sheenennu. veamro hinne hakkaton et avinu, ze mofet chotech ki tzedek yehge chikkam, ki amru davar sheyyachol libbachen.

rashi: Ki nichmeru rachamav. shealo yesh lecha ach meem? amar lo ach haya li, veeni yodea hechan hu; yesh lecha vanim? amar lo yesh li 10, amar lo ma shemam? amar lo bela vavecher vegomer; amar ma tivan shel shemot hallalu? amar lo kullam al shem achi vehatztzarot asher metzauhu, bela shennivla ben haummot, becher shehaya bechor leimmi, ashbeel sheshshevao el, gera sheggar beachsanya, venaaman shehaya naim beyoter, echi varosh – achi haya veroshi haya, muppim – mippi avi lamad, vechuppim – shello raa chuppati velo raiti ani chuppato, vaard – sheyyarad leven haummot, kidita bemassechet sota, miyyad nichmeru rachamav:

Nichmeru. nitchammemu, uvilshon mishna al hakkomer shel zetim, uvelashon arammi bemichmar bisra; uvammikra orenu ketannur nichmaru (Eicha Adonai), nitchammemu venikmetu kematim kematim mippene zalafot raav; ken derech kol or keshemmechammemin oto nikmat venichvatz:
Ochel sede hair asher sevivoteha natan betochah. shekkol eretz veeretz maamedet peroteha, venotnin battevua meafar hammakom, umaamid et hattevua millirkov:
ohc: Vayyikbotz et kol vegomer. lefi ma shepperashnu beferush (Bereshit 41:34) "vechimmesh et" vegomer sheyyittol hachomesh, yihye perush amro vayyikbotz et kol ochel perush hannogea lechelek hammelech karashum bedivre yosef, velichshennefaresh amro "vechimmesh" – vizarez, efshar lefaresh amro vayyikbotz et kol kifshato, shehaya kone kol hattevua sheasta hashshana beyoter al hashshanim, ki letzad shehu davar yater lezore adama yimkeru hannotar.

rashi: Vayhi mikketz. ketargumo missof, vechol leshon ketz sof hu:

Al hayeor. kol shear neharot enam keruyin yeorim chutz minnilus, mippene shekkol haaretz asuyim yeorim yeorim bide adam venilus ole betocham umashke otam, lefi sheen geshamim yordin bemitzrayim tadir kishar aratzot:
ohc: Vayhi mikketz. taam amro leshon tzaar, ki atta yatchil lesovev sibbat galut mitzrayim. vahagam shehaggalut kevar nigzera gezerato mishshanim kadmoniyyot, halo amru rabbotenu ki lo nigzar sheyyihye bemitzrayim shehu kur habbarzel, uchemo shekkatvu hattosafot bemassechet shabbat (10:) uchemo shekkatav haravad (hilchot teshuva perek 6) ki hammitzrim hosifu letzaer yoter mimma sheamar hakkatuv "vaavadum veinnu" vegomer (Bereshit 15:13).

Od amar leshon tzaar letzad besorat raav, ki hakkadosh baruch hu kivyachol lo tzar betzarat olamo, vetze ulemad mimma sheddarshu zichronam livracha (Megila 10:) befasuk (Shemot 14:20) "velo karav ze el ze" vegomer:

Od yirmoz letzaaro shel oto tzaddik shennitakkev ad sheshshalmu shete shanim achar chalomo shel sar hammashkim, ki az haya lo latzet, keamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 89:2) veze leshonam: bishvil sheamar "ki im zechartani vehizkartani" nittosfu shete shanim", hare shehosifu lo shete shanim betzaar. vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 89:2): "vayhi mikketz" – "ketz sam lachoshech". ulefi ze yechavven al ze hadderech: "vayhi" missibbat "ketz" shehu yetzer hara shennikra "ketz kol basar", vehu sibba letzaaro shel tzaddik shenatayim yamim. uvaze hirvachnu gam ken techillat ze hacheshbon shel shenatayim shehu lachalomo shel sar hammashkim shehaya zeman zechirat yosef letova. vetaam shete shanim bishvil sheamar "zechartani vehizkartani", keneged kol zechira mana Adonai zichrono berosh hashshana shehu zeman hazzikkaron.
Od yirmoz beamro mikketz shenatayim lomar shehaya bazzeman atzmo shechalmu sar hammashkim vesar haofim, shehu zeman shehachalom yaggid davar tzodek velo yedabber shav.

Ufaro cholem. hinne letzad shehi techillat hahodaa haya tzarich lomar "chalam paro" o "vayyachalom paro". achen hakkatuv musav el inyan rishon shessipper bapparasha shekkadma chalomo shel sar hammashkim leinyano, hosif lomar ufaro gam ken cholem. vehakkavvana baze ki im sar hammashkim lo ratza lezachro al yede chalomo, asa Adonai sheggam paro yachlom uvaze nitchayyev beal karcho lezachro. veshiur hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: "velo zachar sar hammashkim vayhi mikketz vegomer ufaro gam hu cholem vegomer vaydabber sar hammashkim beal karcho lemor vegomer vesham ittanu vegomer vayyiftar lanu" vegomer.
Od efshar sheyyechavven lomar ki shenatayim yamim ufaro cholem bitmidut chalom ze, ella shello haya yodea shechalam, ulesof shenatayim chalam velo shachach.

Yirtze beamro ufaro cholem lomar sheggam paro atzmo hirgish bachalomo ki haya cholem chalom. letzad reoto devarim muflaim kaasher avaer, hirgish ki en ze mehaddevarim hahovim baolam veen ze ella chalom. vechavvanat hakkatuv behodaa zo hi lehaggid simane hachalom asher yitztaddek, vehu kaasher yargish haadam bachalom ki hu shalem bedato lehavechin davar ad sheyyaskil ladaat devarim shello yittachen heyot behakitz, veyargish ki hu cholem. ze yaggid ki en chalomo bilbul haddaat veirbuv hassechel veruchot yitallelu bo, ella modiim oto elyonim lemala atidot.

rashi: Haed haed. leshon hateraa shessetam hateraa matre vo bifne edim, vechen haidoti baavotechem (Yirmeyahu 11); red haed baam (Shemot 19):
Lo tiru fanay bilti achichem ittechem. lo tiruni velo achichem ittechem; veunkelos tirgem ellahen kad achuchon immechon, yishshev haddavar al afno velo dikdek letargem achar leshon hammikra:
ohc: Vayyomer elav yehuda lemor. amro tevat lemor, perush, sheamar elav yehuda hatztzaat devarim lemor elav hatteshuva, vehahatztzaa hi "haed heid" vegomer, vehaamira hi "im yeshcha" vegomer. venitkavven hakkatuv baze lishlol teshuva meofen acher hannishmaat mehahatztzaa hannizkar, vehu ki letzad sheheid vegomer behechreach sheyyikchu binyamin veyelchu ben leratzon ben shello leratzon, laze amar "lemor" perush hodaa zo gezeratah hi ma sheyyomar achar kach.

O yirtze al ze hadderech: lemor haed vegomer, perush amar lanu ze veheid alenu edim behateraato. od yirtze lomar: hashiveni al taana zo im yesh lecha teshuva lehashiv laadone haaretz. od yirtze sheyyesh od lomar taam acher millevad ze, vehu sakkanat shimon hannatun bevet kele learev hochachat davar ki lo meraggelim.

Lo tiru fanay vegomer. nitkavven baze lishlol taana ki yomar yaakov sheyyaase hochachot ureayot hammaspikim lifne melachim veyoatze eretz lehakkir ki enam begeder safek meraggelim, uvaze tamma taanat haish hachoshed bahem. laze amar heid banu lemor lo tiru, perush sheeno mitratztze lirot panenu zulat beviat binyamin, umeatta enam yecholim laamod lefanav beshum ofen, veech yelchu liknot hattevua mimmennu. veulay ki laze kafal yehuda davar ze shete peamim, ki tenay ze shel binyamin meakkev hagam sheyyusar chashad hameraggelut.

rashi: Al kol pene haaretz. mi hem pene haaretz ellu haashirim:
Et kol asher bahem. ketargumo di vehon ivura:

Vayyishbor lemitzrayim. shever leshon mecher uleshon kinyan hu; kan meshammesh leshon mecher; shivru lanu meat ochel, leshon kinyan. veal tomar eno ki im bitvua, sheaf beyayin vechalav matzinu ulechu shivru belo chesef uvelo mechir yayin vechalav (Yeshayahu 55):
ohc: Vayyiftach yosef et kol. taam sheppatach kol haotzarot velo hispik batztzarich, nitkavven livdok bechullan ladaat et asher yakdim limkor veet asher yuchal lehitakkev yoter velo yippased.

Od leheyot sheochel sede hair [asher] (natan) sevivoteha [natan betochah], laze nitchakkem ufatach kol haotzarot shebbechol makom umakom, kede shekkol ir vair tihye semucha al ma shellefaneha, veeno dome mi sheyyesh lo pat besallo. gam lo yitztarchu litroach lehavi kullan mimmakom echad.

Gam ulay shennitkavven liftoach kullan, kede kesheyyiru anshe hair kol haribbuy lo yiravu, ki haravon yikkanes belev adam kesheyyire sheyyesh machsor, uchesheyyiru kol otzarot hanniftachot yitkarer chom haraav shebbelibbam boer, veaf al pi chen modia hakkatuv "vayyechezak haraav" velo hoil bahem letzad chozek haraav.

rashi: Vayyerdu ache yosef. velo chatav bene yaakov, melammed shehayu mitchartim bimchirato venatnu libbam lehitnaheg immo beachva velifdoto bechol mamon sheyyifseku alehem:

Asara. ma talmud lomar, vahalo chetiv veet binyamin achi yosef lo shalach? ella leinyan haachva hayu chalukin ley shello hayta ahavat kullam vesinat kullam shava lo; aval leinyan lishbor bar kullam lev echad lahem (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Ache yosef. perush, natnu datam al haachva lifdoto.

Asara. ulay halchu kullan lachashash haragil bishne raav, ki tera en adam bereehu veal pat lechem yifsheu ligzol velaharog ish achihu, laze halchu kullam kede sheish et achihu yaazoru, vegam binyamin hayu rotzim leholicho immam ella sheyyaakov lo ratza, vehu amro veet binyamin lo shalach vegomer, ha lamadta shezzulat taam ze gam oto haya sholeach immahem:

Od nire shello haya mocher yosef ella davar katzuv lechol echad, venitchakkem baze lishne devarim, echad nigle veechad nistar. hannigle – kede shello yittagger adam battevua, veyesh baze shevach lo veshevach lakkonim: shevach lo kede sheyyistakker hu bechol aliyyat hashshearim, veshevach lakkonim ki hu lo yaale hashshaar beyoter, veechad nistar – kede sheyyavou kol haachim etzlo, kemo shekken haya ki bau kullan liknot kol echad hakkatzuv.

rashi: Vedakkot basar. 371 belaaz, leshon dak:
ohc: Olot acharehen min hayeor. perush al ofen shekkatavnu shekkol metziutam min hayeor haya. vahagam shello amar "min hayeor olot" kemo sheamar barishonot, samach al amro tevat "acharehen" shehu kasseder harishon shemmehayor hu hatechalat havayatan.

rashi: Asher chalam lahem. alehem; veyada shennitkayyemu shehare hishtachavu lo:

Ervat haaretz. gilluy haaretz – mehechan hi nocha likkavesh, kemo et mekorah heera (Vayikra 20), uchemo erom veerya (Yechezkel 16) vechen kol erva shebbammikra l gilluy, vetau bidka deara, kemo bedek habbayit (Melachim 2 12), reua habbayit, aval lo dikdek lefarsho achar leshon hammikra:
ohc: Vayyizkor yosef vegomer vayyomer alehem meraggelim vegomer. perush, letzad shezzachar hachalomot asher chalam lahem kefi haemet, vehem chashaduhu ki sheker befiv veomer ma shehu mekavve lehitgaddel alehem, gam hu nitkavven lechapper avonam vayyomer lahem meraggelim attem lirot vegomer veen befichem nechona.

rashi: Rash ose chaf remiyya. mi sheani battora, more horaot sheker:
Kaf remiyya. moznayim shel remiyya. lefi peshuto mashma battaggarim:
Veyad charutzim. yesharim, shechortzim davar baamitto umishpato belo avla:
targum: Miskenuta memachcha legavra ramya vida dechashera meattera lehon:

rashi: Nachon. mezumman:
ohc: Veal hishshanot vegomer. remez lishne devarim: al hakkefel veal hashshinnuy, shello ba hachalom sheni kachalom rishon "sheva parot" vegomer, sheaz yachshov ki dimyon harishon asa roshem bedato veala al mishkavo shete peamim, velachen ba hachalom beseder chadash "sheva shibbolim" vegomer. hare ze ba lelammed ki nachon haddavar umeim haelohim ba elav hachalom velo dimyon kozev.
Veamro umemaher haelohim vegomer. perush, ma shebba hachalom kaful belayla echat velo ba bishne zemannim meruchakim, lomar elav shehazzeman karov hu velo lizmannim rechokim yaggid.

rashi: Tzeror kaspo. kesher kaspo:
Vayyakker yosef vegomer. lefi shehinnicham chatume zakan:
Vehem lo hikkiruhu. sheyyatza meetzlam belo chatimat zakan, veachshav ba vachatimat zakan (ketuvot 27):
Umia vayyakker yosef et echav keshennimseru veyado hikkir shehem echav verichem alehem, vehem lo hikkiruhu keshennafal beyadam linhog bo achva:
ohc: Vayyakker yosef vegomer. perush, hagam shehu hikkiram letzad shehinnicham bachatimat zakan, umitteva enoshi keshettivvaled hayyedia belev echad mehashshenayim gam belev hashsheni yitorer bechinat hazzikkaron, ki hallevavot yaggidu sodot neelamim, keamram (Mishlei 27:19) "kammayim happanim lappanim ken lev haadam laadam", vidakdeku baenayim, bammetzach, baddibbur, vehayyedia holechet vegadelet ad sheyyashlim habbachun, af al pi chen modia hakkatuv shehem lo hikkiruhu. vehattaam, letzad reoto berum hammaalot hechlitu habbechina vehirchiku millibbam mechashov davar ze:

rashi: Ki ervat haaretz batem lirot. shehare nichnastem bey shaare hair, lamma lo nichnastem beshaar 1? (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayyomer alehem lo ki vegomer. perush, lo yeamnu divrechem, ki maasechem mochichim shebbatem lirot ervat haaretz. vehattaam, shennichnesu kol echad beshaar echad keamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 91:6) shekkol echad mehashshevatim nichnas beshaar echad, veze yaggid ki ervat haaretz batem vegomer:

rashi: Vayyikkedu vayyishtachavu. al sheilat shalom kida – kefifat kadkod; hishtachavaa – mishtatteach laaretz:
Kaasher killu leechol. yehuda amar lahem hametinu lazzaken ad shettichle fat min habbayit (Bereshit Rabba):

Kaasher killu. kad shetziu, vehametargem kad sappiku toe; kaasher killu haggemallim lishtot meturgam kad sappiku – kesheshshatu de sippukam hu gemar shetiyyatam; aval ze kaasher killu leechol, kaasher tam haochel hu, umetargeminan kad shetziu:
ohc: Kaasher killu. ulay shehakkavvana hi shello nishar ella shiur hammaspik lizman halichatam uviatam, veyomar gam al ze "killu" ki tzerichin lehavi od. o lefi ma sheamru zichronam livracha (taanit 10.) ki yaakov hechin tevua lishne raav, hayu ochlim bemeshech halichatam vachazaratam mehamezuman etzlo, velaze dikdek hakkatuv lomar "killu hashshever asher heviu mimmitzrayim" lomar oto hashshever killu velo kol hashshever shehaya lahem.

rashi: Baggadol hechel. shello yargishu shehaya yodea hechan hu:
Tzenumot. tzunema bilshon arammi sela, hare hen keetz beli lichluach vekashot kesela, vetargumo natzan lakyan, natzan – en bahem ella hannetz, lefi shennitroknu min hazzera:
Bevet mishmarchem. sheattem asurim bo achshav:
Veattem lechu haviu. levet avichem:
Shever raavon battechem. ma shekkenitem leraavon anshe vattechem:
ohc: Im kenim attem vegomer. yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha bayyerushalmi perek 8 ditrumot (4:11) veze leshono: tanya siat bene adam hamehallechim badderech ufagu bahem goyim veamru lahem tenu lanu echad mikkem venaharog oto veim lav naharog kullechem, afillu kullam neheragin lo yimseru nefesh achat miyyisrael. yichadu lahem vechulei yimseru vechulei, ad kan. vehu amro im kenim attem, perush attem yodim beatzmechem im haemet ittechem, achichem echad, perush echad mikkem velo yichadahu lahem, yeaser ki en yirat mavet lomar yehargu kullam velo yimseruhu. uledayyek haddavar nitkavven lomar sheim enam kenim en lahem reshut bammishpat lehanniach echad mehem, ki keshello yuvechanu divrehem, mishpat meraggel yesh lo uven mavet hu, vahare hem keillu meyachadim oto meachshav lamut veen haddin ken, ella yehargu kullam velo yimseru nefesh echad mehem. velo takshe, halo matzinu ki hu lakach shimon, veim ken have keyichaduhu, ze eno ki ulay shehem yichadu ze mehem.
O efshar sheachar shehiskimu yachad lakachat echad mehem, kadam hu uvachar shimon, letaam ki hu zugo shel levi uferad chavilatam.

rashi: Ten lechacham veyechkam od. letalmid hagun shene. umidrash aggada (Shemot Rabba 50:2): neemar lenoach "mikkol habbehema hattehora vegomer" (Bereshit 7:2), uchesheyyatza "vayyikkach mikkol habbehema vegomer" (Bereshit 8:20). amar: ma raa hakkadosh baruch hu leharebot beellu? ella sheratza sheakriv lo mehen:
Hoda letzaddik. chachma vehu yosef lekach. middato veal shemuato:
targum: Alef lechakkima veyitchakkem tuv oda letzadika veyosef mandea:

rashi: Lo yered beni immachem. lo kibbel devarav shel reuven, amar bechor shote hu ze, hu omer lehamit banav, vechi vanav hem velo banay? (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Ki achiv vegomer vehu levaddo. perush, ba latet taam ech hu chash al sefeko shel binyamin mivvaddao shel shimon haasur bemishmar mitzrayim beeravon, ucheshello yaviu binyamin hinne hu mechuyyav mavet. laze amar ki laze yesh lehakepid ki achiv met, ma shello era ken leechad mishshear achim, veod en chesrono kechesron shimon ki hu levaddo nishar yachid leimmo, ma sheen ken shimon ki chamishsha achim yesh lo. veod safek ze safek muchra hu, vehu amro ukeraahu ason, velo amar "im yikraehu ason" vegomer, vedikdek lomar badderech asher telchu vah, ramaz ki yosef achiv halach badderech shehem regilim lalechet bah bitmidut mechevron lishchem, veaf al pi chen tarof toraf, uchemo chen ze yesh lachush lo leason afillu badderech asher attem holchim bo bitmidut belo shum chashash.

rashi: Mi feti yasur henna. veyilmad oti veyechkam:
targum: Man dishvar nete levati vachasir raayana amarat leh:

rashi: Che faro. im yichye paro. keshehaya nishba lashsheker, haya nishba bechayye faro:
Im tetzu mizze. min hammakom hazze:
ohc: Bezot tibbachenu. perush, mitratztze behavechana zo, hagam sheenah maspeket lema shehochiach middivrehem sheamru shebbau lehotzi yosef kemo shekkatavti:
O yirtze sheyyutzdeku shebbederech ratzon bau lehotzi yosef miyyad hakkone, im yavo achihem hakkaton ulevavo yavin et asher yechavven.
Vayyaavor bechol eretz mitzrayim. perush, ladaat sedoteha, ladaat et asher yachin asot, vegam otzroteha lehachin mekomot hatztzerichin leetzor vehahachanot kefi tevunotav.

rashi: Ki toeva hiv. davar sanuy hiv lammitzrim leechol et haivrim, veunkelos natan taam laddavar:
Haemet ittechem. im emet ittechem, lefichach hei nakud pattach, shehu chemo vilshon tema veim lo teviuhu, che faro, ki meraggelim attem:
ohc: Shilchu mikkem echad vegomer. vehem lo asu chen, ki chashshu letzarat avihem al kullan.

Veod sheyyadu neemana shello yishlach binyamin, vetze ulemad kamma hishtaddelut asu kullam yachad ad sheshshelacho betaanat ki yehuda arev vehu yeviennu, veim yehuda vechol echav bevet kele ma yihye bitchono shel yaakov sheyyishlach binyamin vearev tzarich lehotzio mibbet mishmar?

O leolam lo haya bedatam lehippared beshum ofen, ki hayu yereim al happerud leval yihye ashem leheyoto levaddo, velo nitratztzu levassof lehanniach echad mehem ella letzad shettala lahem hannissayon baze kaasher avaer befasuk (Bereshit 42:19) "im kenim vegomer velo tamutu", az huchrechu bemaasehem.

rashi: Chasar lev, veamra lo. haddevarim hallalu, ma amra lo:
targum: Metul man dishvar nete levatah vachasir raayana veamra leh:

rashi: Bi adoni. leshon baya vetachanunim hu, velashon arammi bayya bayya (yevamot 97:, sanhedrin 64.):
Yarod yaradnu. yerida hi lanu, regilim hayinu lefarnes acherim, achshav anu tzerichim lecha (Bereshit Rabba):
Oti shikkaltem. melammed shechashadan shemma haraguhu o mecharuhu cheyosef:
Shikkaltem. kol mi shebbanav avudim karuy shakkul:
Vechimmesh. ketargumo vizarzun; vechen vachamushim (Shemot 13):
ohc: Yaase faro. kavvanat haddevarim hem ki hiskil yosef shettaam hachalom hu letzad ki Adonai mevi sheva shene sava beshefa yoter al shear hashshanim, kede shettihye hattevua lesheva shene raav. vezulat hodaat hachalom, keshettavo tevuat shana rishona meruvvachat, az keshettavo shana sheniyya yitrashshelu zore tevua, ki yomru: "hare asta tevua shana rishona leshalosh shanim". vegam letzad haribbuy tizzol hattevua veyitatztzelu mitteroach bacharisha uzeria umachshireha, vegam hazzorim beshana sheniyya kesheyyitbarech yosifu od lehitatztzel millizroa od, uma gam baavor shalosh o arba shanim hen lo yaase avoda bassade lizroa velacharosh. asher al ken hodia elohim ki ma shehu noten beyoter beshanim ellu hu limzon sheva shene haraav, velaze amar lefaro yaase faro veyafked vegomer, perush sheyyishtaddel hu bemaase ze vegam yeasse laacherim, kede shello yitatztzel adam bedavar ze bahachanat sheva shene hassava lizroa bechol hayyecholet.

Vechimmesh – perush, yezarzem levilti hitrashshel mittaam reot haddavar merubbe beyoter. o yomar vechimmesh sheyyikkach hu mikkullan chamishit lefaro, hagam shehammishpat hu maaser (Shmuel 1 8:17) yikkach beshanim ellu chamishit bischar hodaat haddavar mimmennu, vegam sheyyaase immahem chesed shekkol hattevua shettihye lefaro lo nishlach bah yad ella tihye omedet lefarnasatam lemachrah lahem bishne haraav, keamro "vehaya haochel lefikkadon". baze ramaz lema shekkatavnu ki lo yishlach yad bah, gam shello yimkor mehattevua lezulat bishne raav ad sheyyikdemu hem liknot tzarkam, uchemo sheafaresh bappasuk sheachar ze.

rashi: Vayyitappak. nitammetz; vehu leshon afike maginnim (Iyov 41), chozek, vechen umeziach afikim rippa (sham 12):
Masot. manot:
Chamesh yadot. chelko im echav, umasat yosef veasnat umenashshe veefrayim:
Vayyishkeru immo. umiyyom shemmecharuhu lo shatu yayin velo hu shata yayin, veoto hayyom shatu (Bereshit Rabba):
Yefot mare. siman hu lime sova, shehabberiyyot nirot yafot zo lazo, sheen en beriyya tzara vachavertah:
Baachu. baagam, 650 belaaz, kemo yisge achu (Iyov 8):
ohc: Min hayeor olot vegomer. haya lo lomar olot sheva parot min hayeor, ki min harauy yizkor haole veachar kach makom sheole mishsham. veulay sheyyechavven lomar ki chol havayatan hayta min hayeor, velaze hikdim hamehavve veachar kach hammithavve mimmennu. velaze im haya omer "vehinne sheva parot olot min hayeor" yihye hannishma ki happarot avru derech hayeor vealu mimmennu, velo mehayeor nimtzeu. laze amar "min hayeor olot sheva parot" lomar shemmimmennu nimtzeu. umizze hirgish gam ken ki hu cholem chalom uchemo shepperashti befasuk "ufaro cholem" (Bereshit 41:1). vetaam sheheruhu mare ze lehaggid ki mehayeor atzmo yithauu shene haddimyonot, vehu sheppatar yosef shehem sheva shene sava vesheva shene raav, ushenehem hem mithavvim mehayeor atzmo im yaale o lo yaale, velaze raa bachalom ki happarot havayatan hayta mehayeor.

Vaydabber sar vegomer lemor vegomer. taam amro lemor, gam amro et velo amar el. veulay shello dibber elav lenocheach ella lechachme mitzrayim lemor lefaro, velaze timtza shekkol devarav hem derech nistar lo lenocheach, "paro katzaf vayyitten" leshon nistar.

Od yirtze beamro lemor et chataay al ze hadderech: shello tachshov sheani zocher et asher avar alay miyyissure hammelech, ella adrabba ani omer pechituti vegeroni ki ani hu hachote, vehu amro lemor et chataay vegomer. vedikdek lomar hayyom ki hu et hatztzorech, ki zulat ze haya maalim zichron maasav happechutim. gam baze natan taam lema shello hodia haddavar mikkodem, kachiyyuv hammutal al kerove hammelech lehodia davar chadash kaze, ki lo haya lehazekir od shigyono. veamar chataay leshon rabbim, lomar ki chashuv beenav et asher kevar asuhu lachataim rabbim. o ulay shennitkavven lirmoz gam lechet ze shemmana hahodaa ad atta, laze amar leshon rabbim "chataay".

rashi: Et kol ochel. shem davar hu, lefichach taamo beAlef venakud befattach katan, veochel shehu poal, kegon ki kol ochel chelev, taamo lematta bakkaf, venakud kamatz katan:
Tachat yad paro. birshuto uveotzrotav:
Dallot. kechushot, kemo maddua atta kacha dal, deamnon (Shmuel 2 13):
Verakkot basar. kol leshon rakkot shebbammikra chasre vasar, uvelaaz 339:

Gam atta chedivrechem. af zo min haddin emet kedivrechem ken hu, shekkullechem chayyavin baddavar – 10 shennimtzet geneva beyad 1 mehem kullam nitpasim, aval ani eese lachem lifnim mishshurat haddin, asher yimmatze itto yihye li aved:
ohc: Vayyomer gam atta vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro gam ma nitchaddesh atta leinyan haddin. veod kashe amro kedivrechem ken hu, veroani shehu hefech divrehem, ki hem amru "asher yimmatze itto vamet", vehu amar "yihye aved".

Veulay shennitkavven lehashiv al ma sheamru "hen kesef asher matzanu" vegomer, veamar: "gam atta achar shennechshedu baddavar, ani matzdik divrechem shello genavtem veomdim attem bechezkat emuna rishona, aval enchem yecholin lehatzedik kol echad veechad mikkem, ki efshar sheyyimmatze bahem ach lo leemuna asa veoto natal haggavia, veen taanati ella al echad mikkem, umishpato hu yihye li aved". vahagam shechayyav mita, haddavar taluy beyadi leshabedo ad et asher echpotz lahamito.
O yirtze shettaan sheen befihem nechona sheamru "vamet", ki en chiyyuv mita ella im yesh edut al haggeneva sherauhu shennetalo, aval metziut ze eno ella umdena, lo yitchayyev ella middina demalchuta.
Veamro veattem tihyu nekiyyim, ki bechezkat kashrut omdim, velo yittafsu middin asara shennimtzet beyad echad mehem haggeneva, kevan sheen edut alehem shennoadu yachad veganvu.

rashi: Lo yariv Adonai nefesh tzaddik, vehavvat reshaim yehdof. yidchof otam vetippol:
targum: La machfen elaha nafsheh detzadika vekinyana derashie nischof:

rashi: Tishma chalom liftor oto. taazin vetavin chalom liftor oto:
Tishma. leshon havana vehaazana, kemo shomea yosef, asher lo tishma leshono, anetaynaderaa belaaz:
ohc: Ufoter en oto. perush, shehayu lo potrim, ella shello haya tzodek hachalom al pi happotrim, vehu amro ufoter en oto, vehakkavvana baze sheyyiftor pitron sheyyitztaddek im hachalom.
Vaani shamati vegomer – tzarich ladaat amro lemor. od amro tishma, peshita shello yiftor kodem sheyyishma, vehaya lo lomar "shamati alecha poter chalom".

Achen hakkavvana hi shennitchakkem paro lechayyev yosef liftor hachalom mibbeli tet amatlaot, uva betaana lomar ki hu yosef piv heido ki hu poter chalomot, umeatta lo yimmana mechalukka, o yiftor chalomo shel paro, o yitchayyev al asher rimma bene adam shehu poter veen befihu nechona. vehu amro vaani shamati alecha lemor perush sheatta omer tishma chalom liftor oto, kemo shekken haya achar haemet sheamar lesar hammashkim vesar haofim (Bereshit 40:7) "sapperu na li" vegomer, umin hassetam sar hammashkim hodia haddevarim kemot shehem lefaro, o paro bachan ki lo yaggidu sarav chalomot lenaar ivri eved im lo sheshshaal hu lehaggido. umeatta yitchayyev liftor chalomo shel paro letzaddek devarav.

rashi: Vayyissov mealehem. nitrachek mealehem shello yiruhu boche:
Vayyevk. lefi sheshshama shehayu mitchartin:
Et shimon. hu hishlicho labbor, hu sheamar lelevi hinne baal hachalomot hallaze ba (Bereshit Rabba). davar acher nitkavven yosef lehaferido millevi, shemma yityaatzu shenehem laharog oto:
Vayyeesor oto leenehem. lo asaro ella leenehem, vechevan sheyyatzu hotzio veheechilo vehishkahu (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayyikkach meittam et shimon. perush, hem yichadu oto velakchu, o hu berer leatzmo, uchemo shekkatavti befasuk (Bereshit 42:19) "im kenim".

rashi: Ad ki chadal lispor. ad ki chadal lo hassofer lispor, vahare ze mikra katzar:
Ki en mispar. lefi sheen mispar, vahare chi meshammesh belshon deha:
ohc: Ad ki chadal vegomer. perush: chadlu lispor otzre hattevua asher leyosef, letzad ki en mispar mehammeviim, shello hayu sofrim letzad torach shavat madheva velo maddu et asher yaviu. vahagam shehayu meviin chomesh, lema shepperashnu beamro "vechimmesh", af al pi chen hayu mechallekim hattevua lachamishsha chalakim venotnim chelek echad, velo hayu yodim kamma ole lacheshbon hammuva. veze hu shiur hakkatuv: "ad ki chadal sofro shel yosef lispor ki en mispar" lattevua mehammeviim, veyitztarech lispor happerat uletzaref hacheshbon, laze chadal lispor.

rashi: Odennu sham. shehaya mamtin lahem:
Techillat chachma yirat Adonai, vedaat kedoshim. hi ikkar habbina:
targum: Sheruy dechachmeta dechalteh deelaha vidiata dekadishe veyuna:

rashi: Vayyishtachavu lo appayim. nishtattechu lo al penehem, vechen kol hishtachavaa pishshut yadayim veraglayim hu:
ohc: Hu hashshallit hu vegomer. perush, hagam shehu hashshallit veen derech shilton lehittappel bimchirat hattevua, uma gam bechol kach torach hammufla, af al pi chen hu hammashbir lechol am haaretz, vetamo kamus immo lehakkir beredet echav.

rashi: Velo yivvada hassava. hu pitron "velo noda ki bau el karbanah":
Biladay. en hachachma mishshelli, ella elohim yaane – yitten aniyya befi – lishlom paro:
ohc: Vayyaan yosef lemor vegomer. perush, heshivo lema shettaan betevat lemor ki hu omer lishmoa chalom liftor, biladay lo hayu chen haddevarim, uma sheamar hu ki elohim yamtzi pitronim lachalomot al yad bene adam, kemo shemmatzinu shekken amar yosef lesar hammashkim vesar haofim (Bereshit 40:8) "halo lelohim pitronim", perush, lo yechseru happitronim, veamar "sapperu li" ulay yimmatze pitron, uleolam eno meyached atzmo lomar ki hu mefashsher chalomot, uchemo chen hu omer lo elohim yaane vegomer. vehutzrach lomar "yaane shelom", nitkavven lomar lo shello yakpid im yihye pitron hachalom maggid raato, ki meAdonai maane davar, velo yakpid lomar ki hachalomot holchim achar happe. venatan taam beamro "shelom paro" ki hammelech yishtanne bedavar ze, velaze im yaggid ra lo mimmennu yetzu haddevarim, uchemo chen hu amro atta elohim yaane et shelom paro.

Od yirtze beamro elohim yaane, ki en seder ofen pitrono keseder pitron bar hedya (berachot 56.) vechayyotze bo, sheyyatte hachalom laasher yachpotz, ella amittut mashmaut haddevarim, velaze amar "elohim" vegomer:
Asher yimmatze vegomer. perush, kemishpat ben noach shenneherag al haggeneva (sanhedrin 57.), vegam anachnu mechayyeyvin atzmenu lihyot avadim.

rashi: Vayyasar paro et tabbato. netinat tabbaat hammelech hi ot lemi shennotnah lo lihyot sheni lo ligdulla:
Bigde shesh. devar chashivut hu bemitzrayim:

Revid. anak, veal shehu ratzuf betabbaot karuy revid vechen marvaddim ravadti arsi (Mishlei 7) – ritztzafti arsi martzafot, bilshon mishna mukkaf rovdin shel even, al haroved shebbaazara, vehi ritzpa:
Ushedufot. 356 belaaz, shekifan kiddum, chavutot, leshon mashkof hechavut tamid al yede haddelet hammakka alav:
Kadim. ruach mizrachit, shekkorin besa belaaz:

Sheva shanim vesheva shanim. kullan enan ella sheva, vaasher nishna hachalom paamayim, lefi shehaddavar mezumman kemo shepperesh lo bassof veal hishshanot hachalom vegomer besheva shanim hattovot neemar higgid lefaro lefi shehaya samuch uvesheva shene raav neemar hera et paro, lefi shehaya haddavar muflag verachok, nofel bo leshon mare:
Bemirkevet hammishne. hashsheniyya lemerkavto, hamehallechet etzel shello:

Avrech. ketargumo "den abba lemalka", rech bilshon arammi (nusach acher romi) melech; behashshuttafin la recha velo bar recha, uvedivre aggada darash rabbi yehuda avrech ze yosef shehu av bechachma verach bashshanim, amar lo Rabbi yose ben durmaskit ad matay atta meavvet alenu et hakketuvim? en avrech ella leshon birkayim, shehakkol hayu nichnasin veyotzin tachat yado, kainyan shenneemar, venaton oto vegomer:
ohc: Avrech venaton vegomer. perush, shene devarim ellu hayu korin lefanav, lehodia ulehashmia ki hu hashshallit beeretz mitzrayim kemelech.

rashi: Redu shamma. velo amar lechu, remez lematayim veeser shanim shennishtabedu lemitzrayim keminyan 210:
ohc: Venichye velo namut. taam hakkefel, nitkavven lomar ki im lo yaasu chen yitchayyevu benafsham baddin haelyon, venimtzaim metim baolam hazze veniddonim laolam habba, uvehishtaddelutam baddavar yichyu baolam hazze velo yamutu laolam habba:

O yirtze al ze hadderech: venichye o lefachot velo namut, vehakkavvana hi sheim yassigu lishbor beribbuy veshofea yichyu kederech hachayyim, veim lo yassigu hammaspik yassigu lefachot hatztzalat nafsham mimmavet baraav.

rashi: Utevoach tevach vehachen. kemo velitboach tevach ulehachin, veen tevoach leshon tziuuy, shehaya lo lomar utevach:

Batztzohorayim. ze meturgam besheruta, shehu leshon seuda rishona velashon arammi uvelaaz 271, veyesh harebe battalmud, shada lechalba sherute; batza akkulla sheruta, aval kol targum shel tzohorayim tihara:
Gevii. kos aroch, vekorin lo madeyrenash belaaz:
Vayyachinu. hizminu, itteruha bechelim naim:
Vegam damo. etin vegammin ribbuyin – damo vegam dam hazzaken:
ohc: Vayyaan reuven otam vegomer. tzarich ladaat ech yutzdak lomar maane al ze, gam amro lemor shete peamim, gam amro vegam damo vegomer:

Achen hakkavvana hi shebba lehashiv lema sheamru shehatztzara baa al asher lo richamu al achihem behitchanno vegomer, uletaam ze yikkanes gam reuven, laze ana veamar, vehu amro vayyaan reuven otam lemor ki hu lo yachshevu lo avon al ze, ki "halo amarti alechem al techetu vayyeled" vegomer, vahagam shello amar lahem ken beferush ella "veyad al tishlechu vo hashelichu oto" (Bereshit 37:22) vegomer, im kol ze kavvanati hayta lemor lachem al techetu vayyeled, vehu amro "lemor al techetu", uchemo sheheid hakkatuv beamro "lahashivo el aviv":

Veim tomar: veal mi samach reuven sheyyakkiru echav kavvanato shekken hayta, veadrabba ledatam asu yoter rachmanut bimchirato mehannicho babbor, kemo shekken amar hakkatuv (Bereshit 37:27) sheamar lahem yehuda "lechu venimkerennu vegomer veyadenu al tehi vo", uma taromet mitraem reuven beamro "halo amarti" vegomer kevan shekkidvarav asu vehosifu lerachem kannizkar?

Da ki ikkar taanat reuven hayta beamro "veyad al tishlechu vo", kemo shepperashti sham, shennitkavven lehatztzilo mide adam shehu baal bechira veratzon, ze hu ikkar hakkavvana. vetaana zo tzodeket gam ken leval yimkeruhu lenachrim shemmaasehem maase bechiri, vehammecher gam ken machniso begeder sakkanat mavet mehannachrim, vegam sheyyeshno bisfek davar ra. vetze ulemad ma sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 86:3) shekkana oto potifar lemishkav zachur veal ze nistares, vehu amro al techetu attem vayyeled laasot bo davar ella hashelichuhu el habbor, umimma nafshach, im hu chayyav mita chayyot hannimtzaot sham yaharguhu, veim lav yihye leot hachayyim, ma sheen davar ze bishlichut yede adam. velo shematem perush, lo havinotem devaray.

Uma sheamru shehatztzara baa al haachzariyyut veshello kibbelu hitchannenuto, uleolam beguf hammaase lo asu avla – lo chen hu, ella gam damo hinne nidrash ki chayyavim hem bishlichut yadam bo unetunim hayu besakkanat meraggelim shehu mishpat mavet. uletzad ze gam ken lo yikkanes reuven baasham immahem, ki hu lo haya bammecher, umeatta reuven nilkad lihyot immahem levad, uvigmar hadderisha yitchayyev hamechuyyav veyippater hazzakkay bedino. vegam lema shepperashti beamro "aval ashemim" shehitorrutam hayta letzad tefisat shimon levad, yihye perush hakkatuv gam ken kederech ze.

rashi: Vayyave haish. havaa achar havaa, lefi shehayu dochafim oto lachutz ad sheddibberu elav petach habbayit; umishsheamar lahem shalom lachem, nimshechu uvau acharav:
ohc: Vayyave haish et haanashim vegomer. amar ken paam sheniyya leheyot ki befaam rishona nifseka hakkenisa, ki nitakkevu veamdu petach habbayit, perush kodem sheyyikkansu labbayit. vahagam sheamar "vayyave haish vegomer beta yosef" hu al derech amro (Bereshit 28:10) "vayyelech charana" shehakkavvana hi lalechet lecharan, uleolam adayin lo nichnesu. vetaam sheratzu ledabber immo kodem al hakkesef, ladaat biatam lema, im letov im lera, ladaat ma yaase yisrael. veachar teshuvato alehem hutzrach paam sheniyya lomar "vayyave haish beta yosef", perush bayit hameshubbach shello.

Hinne sheva shanim vegomer. dikdek lomar bechol eretz mitzrayim shete peamim velo amar baaretz setam kemo sheamar besamuch, lomar ki hassava eno ella beeretz mitzrayim aval haraav hu bechol haolam, velaze kesheamar "vechilla haraav" lo amar eretz mitzrayim bilvad ella "et haaretz", ben eretz mitzrayim ben shear haaratzot, uchemo shekken haya, dichtiv (Bereshit 41:56) "veharaav haya al kol pene haaretz", uvassava amar hakkatuv (Bereshit 41:53) "vattichlena sheva shene hassava asher haya beeretz mitzrayim", hare ze maggid ki lo haya sava ella beeretz mitzrayim, sheim lo chen lo haya tzarich lomar "asher haya beeretz mitzrayim". vehodaat davar ze leyosef hayta mimma sheraa ki happarot hayu kol kach dakkot veraot, mizze dan sheim haya hassova baolam lo hayu bemitzrayim kol kach besheva shene haraav, ki yaviu lechem mishshear haaratzot, ella vadday sheharaav hu bechol haolam uvaze en miflat lahem, vehassava en lo mimma lehochiach ki yihye bechol haaratzot.

rashi: Beterem tavo shenat haraav. mikkan sheadam asur leshammesh mittato bishne reavon (taanit 11):
ohc: Uleyosef yullad vegomer. kesher hakkatuv im shellemala mimmennu, lomar hassagat hattov shel yosef besheva shene sava, ki millevad ki tzavar bar harebe vehitzliach, gam ki nizkar letova babbanim, ukeriat shem banav ken yaggid ki hu seva ratzon ki nishshahu Adonai kol amalo vehifrahu Adonai, uferiyya zo kolelet banim veosher vechavod:

Beterem tavo shenat vegomer. bemassechet taanit (taanit 11.) darshu zichronam livracha mikkan sheasur leshammesh mittato bishne raav. uvehechreach lomar shedderashatam hi beim eno inyan leyosef, shehare hu adayin lo kiyyem pirya verivyya, veamru sham bashshas beferush shechasuche vanim meshammeshin mittotehen bishne raav, velo matzinu shehayu leyosef banim kodem efrayim umenashshe, uchefi haddin afillu besheva shene raav haya lo leshammesh, ella shehakkatuv nidrash beim eno inyan.

Umeatta lo kashe ma shehikshu hattosafot sham miyyocheved shennolda ben hachomot, sheshshimmesh levi bishne raav, ki kesheyyardu avotenu mitzrayma hayta shana sheniyya lishne raav, venidchaku lomar shemmiddat chasidut shanu velevi lo haya chasid bedavar ze. veen nirin divrehem, lo bema sheamru middat chasidut, ki mikkatuv darshu lah, velo bema sheyyatza middivrehem ki levi lo haya chasid. heida alav hattora (Devarim 33:8) "leish chasidecha" ki hu haya chasid shebbashshevatim, vahagam sheal zaro hu omer, haanafim yaggidu al hashshoresh. vekushyat hattosafot eno kushya, ki derashat chachamim hi beim eno inyan, velevi letzad shehaya chaser nekeva lo nimna milleshammesh mittato kahalacha (yevamot 61:, even haezer siman 1).

Veod lo amru issur davar ze ella letzad tzaar yisrael velo letzad tzaar haummot ki yiravu, ki lo maalin velo moridin. veaz levi en chiyyuv limnoa atzmo letzad tzarat haummot, ki yaakov hayta lo tevua keamram zichronam livracha (taanit 10.) velo haya sholeach banav lishbor bar ella letzad marit haayin, dichtiv (Bereshit 42:1) "lamma titrau". vahagam sheamru (Bereshit Rabba 91) sheshshalmu seare mikkadda, ze haya achar shana rishona. aval shana rishona vadday shehaya lahem tevua, velaze haya muttar lo leshammesh. uvishvil yosef en lahem limnoa atzman bishvil chashash raav yachid. veyosef im lo haya taam shehaya chasuch banim, efshar shehaya nimna letzad chashash aviv veechav ki yiravu vehem rabbim.

rashi: Vayyiru haanashim. katuv hu bishne yodin, vetargumo udechilu:
Ki huveu bet yosef. veen derech shear habbaim lishbor bar lalun bevet yosef, ki im befundekaot shebbair: vayyiru. sheen ze ella leasfam el mishmar:
Anachnu muvaim. el toch habbayit hazze:

Lehitgolel. lihyot mitgalgelet alenu alilat hakkesef velihyotah nofelet alenu; veunkelos shettirgem uleistakkafa alana hu leshon lehitolel, kedimtargeminan alilat devarim – taskufe millin, velo tirgemo achar leshon hammikra ulehitgolel shettirgem leitravrava, hu leshon gullat hazzahav (Kohelet 12), vehutztzav gulleta hoalata (Nachum 2), shehu leshon malchut:

ohc: Vayyisu et vegomer vayyelchu. perush, shello nitakkevu ella shiur shennasu shivram vetechef halchu, sheim lo chen lo haya tzarich lehodienu shennasu shivram vegomer:

rashi: Yishshak. yittezan, yitparnes – kol tzarche ammi yihyu naasim al yadcha, kemo nashsheku var (Tehillim 2), garenayshaven belaaz:
Rak hakkisse. sheyyihyu korin li melech:
Kisse. leshon shem hammelucha, kemo vigaddel et kiso mikkisse adoni hammelech (Melachim 1 1):
Vehitztzagtiv lefanecha. shello aviennu elecha met, ki im chay:
Vechatati lecha kol hayyamim. laolam habba:
ohc: Anochi eervennu vegomer vechatati vegomer kol hayyamim. taam amro "kol hayyamim", rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 91:10) amru: olam habba shekkullo yamim.

Uveferek haggolin (makkot 11:) amar rav yehuda: nidduy al tenay tzarich hattara. menalan? mihuda, dichtiv "im lo haviotiv" vegomer. veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv "yechi reuven" vegomer? kol otam arbaim shana shehayu yisrael bammidbar hayu atzmotav shel yehuda mitgalgelin ad sheamad moshe vechulei, ad kan. veim tomar dilma ansho shel yehuda haya shello kafal hattenay kitnae bene gad vechulei (kiddushin 61:), shehammaase kayyam al kol panim.

Laze raiti lehaggaon rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi shetteretz ki bedavar ze lo haya toe yehuda vegam aviv, aval nidduy sheal tenay shetztzarich hattara efshar sheyyite yehuda vegam aviv, lefi shello noda din ze ella mimmikre shekkara lihuda vechulei, ma sheen ken kefel hattenay shemmevoar battora. devarav nifleu mimmenni, mimma nafshach: im lo hayta hattora kichtavah yedua laavot, im ken minnayin hayu yodim ki bene gad uvene reuven shaalu ever hayyarden vehitna moshe immahem tenay kaful? veim hayu yodim kol hahalachot hannishmaim mittorat moshe, lamma tiggara halacha zo shello yadu otah? vetimtza sheamru bemassechet chullin shekkol hahalachot neemru besinay, ella shennishnet kol achat bimkomah, kemo gid hannashe shehagam shenneemra befarashat vayyishlach beinyan yaakov, besinay nitztauu alav ella shennichtav bimkomo, uchemo chen kol hahalachot. veim ken din ze hannilmad mihuda kemo chen neemar besinay, umeatta en hefresh ben hahalachot leheyotam nilmadim beseder ze o beseder ze, velichshennomar sheyyaakov yada hakkol, kemo sheyyada ze yada ze.

Veod gedola mizzo ani roe, ki din ze ditnay kaful bemachloket shanu leh, ki rabbi chanina ben gamliel sover sheen tzarich lichpol hattenay, vetaam bene gad uvene reuven latteamim haamurim sham baggemara, ma sheen ken din nidduy al tenay halacha muskemet hi veen cholek aleha. veim ken adrabba, yoter yesh litlot ansho shel yehuda letzad shello kafal hattenay, leheyoto sover kedaat rabbi chanina ben gamliel, uchemo chen savar yaakov. uletzad sheen halacha ken, hayu atzmotav mitgalgelim baaron, mimma shenneemar ki nidduy al tenay tzarich hattara – halacha peshuta, vetau bah yaakov uvanav.

Vehannachon hu ki kavvanat divre rav yehuda sheamar: nidduy al tenay tzarich hattara – hu al ze hadderech: im nidda al tenay velo kafal lomar "veim lo – lo ehye benidduy", ze hu shetztzarich hattara, aval im kafal veshalal – eno tzarich hattara. vechayyotze bah gam ken amar sham bashshas (makkot 11:) amar rabbi abbahu: killat chacham afillu al tenay hi baa, menalan? meeli vechulei.

Veim tomar: ma tzarich lehashemienu rav yehuda baze? mishna (kiddushin 83 44) arucha hi: kol tenay sheeno kitnae vechulei hammaase kayyam". ze eno, ki bindarim ushevuot haikkar hu hallev, kemaamar rabbi akiva sheddarash (shavuot 26) "haadam bishvua" – shetztzarich sheyyihyu libbo ufiv shavim, vezulat ze eno shevua, vehu haddin nedarim venidduyim. umeatta yomar adam ki benidduy, hagam shello hitna tenay kaful, kevan shellibbo lo gamar lenaddot ella im yihye ken, lamma yitchayyev bedavar shello haya chen belibbo? vehattora amra "haadam bishvua". laze hodia rav yehuda sheim lo kafal, hagam sheasao nidduy al tenay, tzarich hattara. veen hochacha ledin ze ella mihuda. vetaam din ze ketaam din ze killat chacham haamura besamuch, veen lanu ella ma sheggilla lanu hakkatuv bemaase yehuda uvemaase eli, gam maase yaakov shekkillel (Bereshit 31:32) "im asher vegomer lo yichye", vechullan lo haya setirat haddavar bechefel hattenay.
Uma shekkatav harav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi ki neemar hakkefel velo nichtav, kevar dachinu haddevarim veen tzorech lehosif lidchotam.

Shuv raiti lehattosafot shekkatvu beferush divre rav yehuda, shettaam nidduy yehuda shechal, hagam shehu al tenay, hu letzad shello haya beyado lekayyemo, ulechach chal gam al hattenay vechulei, aval shear tenaim shebbeyado lekayyeman, kegon shemmenaddin et haadam shello yaase davar, vadday lo chal hannidduy kelal, ad kan.

Vehinne ledivre hattosafot, hagam shekkafal hamenadde hattenay, af al pi chen chal alav letzad sheen beyado lekayyemo, veze hefech ma shekkatavnu. velo yadati ma yefarshu bememrat rabbi abbahu hassemucha lah sheamar: killat chacham afillu al tenay, umochiach meeli sheamar lishmuel "ko yaase lecha vegomer im techached", vehaddavar haya beyado lomar lo techef umiyyad uveyado shel shemuel lomar lo. veyesh leyashshev. veal takshe, vahalo divre rav yehuda setam neemru: nidduy al tenay, velo chillek bedavar sheyyachol laasoto ledavar vechulei, ki samach al hahochacha dun mimmenna kamoha vechimtziutah. gam lema shepperashti shekkavvanat rav yehuda hu al hakkefel, lo chash alecha rav yehuda letaut ki samach al hamelammed daat mimmennu uvo lo haya kefel.

Gam hitztzatzti bedivre hattosafot veraiti ki sovrim kannizkar leel, shemmenadde al davar shehu beyado laasoto, hagam shello hitna tenay kaful – en tzarich hattara. veim ken, im lo haya mittaam shechal hannidduy al yehuda sheen beyado lekayyemo, hagam shello kafal hattenay – en hammaase kayyam veen tzarich tenay kaful, udela kedivre harav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi. nimtzenu omrim shene teamim bedin hamenadde al tenay: haechad letzad shello kafal hu shetztzarich hattara umiddin tenay kaful, vehashsheni letzad shennidda al davar sheeno birshuto, vehu daat hattosafot. venishar lanu ladaat lamma lo hittir yehuda nidduyo.

Veraiti leharavad zichrono livracha behassagotav al rambam beferek 7 mehilchot talmud tora, hissig al ma shekkatav rambam sham: talmid chacham shennidda leatzmo, vaafilu nidda al daat chavero, vaafilu al davar shechayyav alav nidduy – hare ze mattir leatzmo, ad kan. hissigo ki lamma lo hittir yehuda leatzmo, veal kol ze kashe li: yaakov lamma lo hittiro, ad kan.

Veraiti leharashba shekkatav ki ma sheyyachol chacham lehattir nidduyo, davka bidla mechuyyav nidduy, uchehahi demar zutera vechulei. uledarko shel rashba lo kashe ella kushyat yaakov lamma lo hittiro, aval yehuda eno yachol. aval al kol panim kashe haya lo lihuda lekabbetz shelosha hedyotot ulehattir lo, veen baze din "al daat chavero" shetztzarich middato, shehare nistallek chiyyuvo sheshshibed atzmo lahavio lefanav. veod haya lo lehodio, ufeshita ki lo yachpotz letzaer et yehuda beno lelo davar. vehaddevarim peshutim etzli ki al kol panim en kushya al yaakov, ki lichshennomar sheyyada haddin shetztzarich hattara, samach ki yehuda yattir al yede acherim, echav vechayyotze bahem, veen kushya al yaakov, zulat al yehuda yesh lanu lefakkeach ladaat tamo.

Vehinne lefi ma sheheeleti beferush divre rav yehuda shettaam hahattara hi shello kafal hattenay, kefi ze tamo shel yehuda hu shehaya sover kerabbi chanina ben gamliel sheeno tzarich kefel hattenay, uvaze taa. ella tikshe, velamma lo hochichu lerabbi chanina ben gamliel mihuda shenneenash, ki divre rabbi yehuda lema sheheemadnu bedin kefel hattenay hem delo kerabbi chanina ben gamliel. velisvarat hattosafot sheppershu divre rav yehuda ki taam shetztzarich hattarat hannidduy hu letzad sheasao al davar sheeno birshuto, behechreach lomar shennelam meene yehuda din ze, veyaakov hagam shennomar sheyyedao tala ki yehuda yattir meatzmo.

rashi: En navon vechacham kamocha. levakkesh ish navon vechacham sheamarta, lo nimtza chamocha:
ohc: En navon vegomer. perush, en navon vechacham sheyyihye rauy laasot davar ze kemotcha, sheatta yesh becha ruach elohim kemo sheamar lemala, shehu yoter minnavon vechacham:

rashi: Habbayta. mipperozdor litraklin:
ohc: Vayyaviu lo vegomer habbayta vegomer. perush, lecheder hameyuchad lo, vehem hayu becheder acher babbayit atzmo, vehodia hakkatuv shennichnesu etzlo lammakom shehaya bo lehachenis hammincha.

rashi: Elohim yochnecha beni. bishar shevatim shamanu chanina asher chanan elohim et avdecha (Bereshit 33), uvinyamin adayin lo nolad, lechach bercho yosef bachanina:
Tavcha tivchah mascha yenah. mezagam bemayim, kemo yayin chazak sheeno rauy lishtot chay:
Af archa shulchanah. kol yetzirat lach veyavesh:
targum: Unechisat nichsata umezagat chamrah vesadrat patortah:

rashi: Veel shadday. meatta enchem chaserim kelum ella tefilla, hareni mitpallel alechem:

El shadday. shedday bintinat rachamav ucheday hayecholet beyado litten, yitten lachem rachamim, zehu feshuto. umidrasho mi sheamar laolam day, yomar day letzarotay, shello shakatti minneuray, tzarat lavan, tzarat esav, tzarat rachel, tzarat dina, tzarat yosef, tzarat shimon, tzarat binyamin:
Veshillach lachem. veyiftar lechon ketargumo – yifterennu meesurav, leshon lachafshi yeshallechennu (Shemot 21), veeno nofel battargum leshon vayyishlach, shehare lesham hem holchim etzlo:
Et achichem. ze shimon:
Acher. ruach hakkodesh nizreka vo, lerabbot yosef (Bereshit Rabba):
Vaani. ad shuvechem ehye shakkul missafek:
Kaasher shacholti. miyyosef umishshimon:
Shacholti. mibbinyamin:
Hen kesef asher matzanu. ze echad measara kal vachomer haamurim battora, vechullan menuyin bivra:
Lo adoni. lo tomar ken, shehare avadecha bau lishbar ochel:
ohc: Vayyomru lo adoni vegomer. perush, davar ze en makom lechashdenu bo, hagam shehayinu baim belo sibba. veod, avadecha bau vegomer – perush, sibbat biatenu halo hi yedua ugeluya.

rashi: Pen yikraennu ason. uvabbayit lo yikraennu? amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov, mikkan shehassatan mekatreg bishat hassakkana (Bereshit Rabba):
Lo yoilu otzrot resha. shehaya mishtabbeach beashro, shenneemar: "vayyomer efrayim ach asharti vegomer" (Hoshea 12:9):
Utzedaka tatztzil mimmavet. veim tomar: tzaddik sheyyevazbez nechasav litzdaka, mehechan yitparnes?
targum: La mevatterin otzre derashia vetzidketa mefatzya min mota bisha:

rashi: Ish kefitron chalomo. chalom harauy lappitron shenniftar lanu vedome lo:

Heshiv al kanni. paro, hannizkar lemala, kemo sheamar paro katzaf al avadav; hare mikra ketzar lashon, velo peresh mi heshiv, lefi sheen tzarich lefaresh; mi heshiv? mi shebbeyado lehashiv, vehu paro; vechen derech kol mikraot ketzarim, al mi shealav laasot hem sotmim et haddavar:
Mishmar. bet haasurim:
Vechesef mishne. pi shenayim karishon:
Kechu veyedchem. lishbor ochel, shemma hukar hashshaar:
Ulay mishge hu. shemma hamemunne al habbayit shechacho shogeg:
Vayyitnakker alehem. naasa lahem kenachri bidvarim ledabber kashot:
ohc: Vayyar yosef et echav. perush, raa otam biriyyat achim vehikkir achva lahem, ella shealehem haya mitnakker, vehu amro vayyitnakker alehem – perush, lema shehem enam makkirim oto lo yakpidu al dabbero alehem kashot, ki hu lahem ish nachri. veasa chen lehavi binyamin kemo sheggilla levassof, gam livchon bahem beemtzaut hammitgalgel leda machshevotam elav beoto matztzav, venitgalla lo ki mitchartim hem al asher kevar asuhu ulechet yachshevuhu.

rashi: Vattaas haaretz. ketargumo, veen hallashon neekar milleshon asiyya:
Likmatzim. kometz al kometz, yad al yad, hayu otzrim:
Aval. ketargumo bekusheta, veraiti bivra lishna deromaa hu aval – beram:
Baa elenu. taamo babbet, lefi shehu bilshon avar, shekkevar baa, vetargumo atat lana:
ohc: Vayyomru vegomer aval. tevat aval en lah mashmaut kan, vehametargem amar "bekusheta". vegam aleha dan anochi lamma hutzrechu lomar "bekusheta". od lamma heerichu lashon lomar asher rainu vegomer, velo amru setam, veod haya lahem lomar asher mecharnuhu shehu tachlit heavon.

Veulay shennitkavvenu lomar, leheyot shetziddedu betaam tzara zo im hu bishvil mecher yosef, vedachu taam ze kefi ma shekkatavti (Bereshit 37:20) shekkefi haddin danuhu lahariga, veim ken hammecher sheasu lo hu adrabba middat hachesed. veim al sheggarmu tzarat avihem, adrabba davar ze yosif lo machov, velo yaase Adonai yissure avon tzaar avihem bedavar sheyyigdal od tzaar al tzaaro. vaasher al ken lo matzu avon veamru aval ashemim vegomer asher rainu vegomer, perush sheal kol panim haya lahem lerachem alav birot achihem mitchannen al sakkanat nafsho venitachzeru alav, vedavar ze megunne latztzaddikim laasoto, al ken baa vegomer.

O yirtze al ze hadderech: leheyot sherau kullam yachad bau lemishmar, chashvu bedatam beshel mi haraa. veleheyot shemmecher yosef haya leot ben enehem, keshebbau litlot bo matzu setira laddavar mitztzad reuven shennitpas immahem vehu lo haya betoch hammochrim. laze hichrichu veamru aval ashemim vegomer, perush, hen emet im nomar shehatztzara baa bead hammecher yikshe lanu reuven lo machar, aval ashemim vegomer asher rainu tzarat nafsho vegomer kesheratzu lishloach yad bo. uvedavar ze haya reuven shave immahem, hahu amar (Bereshit 37:22) "hashelichu oto el habbor". ufeshita ki yitchannen yosef alehem beyoter behashelicho el habbor, lefachad hannefila vehevel habbor vehannechashim veakrabbim, gam lamut shamma baraav uvatztzama, veen lecha mita meshunna kazo. vaychannen kolo lahem velo shamu lekol techinnato, uvaze yad reuven immahem. vehu amro al ken baa elenu, perush, yachad, hatztzara. vechol ze keshennomar ki divrehem ellu hayu keshehichnisum bammishmar, vetaam shessidder hakkatuv divrehem baacharona hu letzad shello ratza lehafesik toch kol divre yosef.
Aval, im nomar sheddivrehem ellu hayu achar shehiskimu leesor echad mehem vehem yaalu leshalom keseder hakkatuv, tzarich latet taam lamma lo nitorru lachush leashmat achihem ad atta.

Veulay ki kodem lo hirgishu, vechashvu ki adam baal bechira veratzon lehara, velo avon yosef gorem, ki ledatam mechuyyav haya lahem kemo shepperashnu bimkomo (Bereshit 37:20). ma sheen ken kesheamar lahem "achichem echad yeaser" vegomer, "vayyaasu chen" – perush: yichadu hem echad mehem. baze nitorru mehannidme ki hu avon yosef, kemo shehem nitachzeru al achihem, laze ba lahem hatztzaar bederech ze sheasru echad mehem beyad ish nachri. uchevar rashamti bechamma mekomot ki heavon yolid bidmuto betzalmo, besod amro (tehillim 62:13) "teshallem leish kemaasehu", uchemo chen haddevarim kan, shehichiv lahem libbam betzarat achihem. vehu amro aval – perush, im haya hammikre ze bederech acher lo hayinu matzdikim sheal sibbat yosef baa elenu, aval atta vadday ashemim anachnu asher rainu tzarat nafsho behitchanno.

Veod haya lahem leot, kevan shennityached shimon, dichtiv (Bereshit 42:24) "vayyikkach meittam et shimon", mizze yadu ki devar yosef hu hassovev, ki ze hu hayyoetz etza raa al yosef, dichtiv (Bereshit 37:19) "vayyomru ish el achiv", veamru zichronam livracha (tanchuma vaychi) shehem shimon velevi.

rashi: Vegam hinne veamtachti. gam hakkesef bo im hattevua:
Ma zot asa elohim lanu. lahavienu lide alila zo, shello hushav ella lehitolel alenu:
Chachmot banta vetah. bechachma bana hakkadosh baruch hu et haolam:
Chatzva ammudeha shiva. shivat yeme vereshit. davar acher: shiva sefarim sheyyesh battora – "vayhi binsoa haaron" (Bamidbar 10:35) sefer leatzmo; bemassechet shabbat (shabbat 116.):
targum: Chachmeta benat betah veattedat beh shava amudin:

rashi: Bekane achat. 49 belaaz:
Beriot. 670 belaaz:
Min habbor. min bet hassohar shehu asuy kemin gumma, vechen kol bor shebbammikra leshon gumma hu, veaf im en bo mayim karuy bor, 387 belaaz:
Vaygallach. mippene chevod hammalchut (Bereshit Rabba):
Shalcha naaroteha. adam vechavva (sanhedrin lach.), davar acher: moshe veaharon (Vayikra Rabba 1,4):
targum: Veshadrat talyetaha detikreyan al giv ramata ashinata dintziran:

rashi: Tzafnat paneach. mefaresh hatztzefunot; veen lefaneach dimyon bammikra:
Potifera. hu potifar, venikra potifera al shennistares meelav, lefi shechamad et yosef lemishkav zachar (sota 13):
Chalila laavadecha. chullin hu lanu, leshon genay, vetargum chas leavdaych – chas meet hakkadosh baruch hu yehi alenu measot zot, veharebe yesh battalmud "chas veshalom":
ohc: Lamma yedabber vegomer kaddevarim vegomer. perush, ma makom yesh lo laddevarim? lo mibbaya haddevarim atzmam, ella afillu haddome lahem en rauy lo ledabber, kol dedome lechiur ze chalila laavadecha laasot afillu dome laze, vehu amro kaddevarim haelle. veamro hen kesef vegomer, vehu kevar satar kal vachomer ze kemo shepperashti, nitkavvenu listor taanato ben ma shepperashnu ki kavvanato lomar ki satru lechezkat hashava ki enah letzad emunatam ella devar mikre, amru ki hen emet ki yihye davar ze derech mikre beish gazlan laasot kaddevarim haelle, aval lo beseder ze sheachar shezzacha bo veholicho lemakom rachok yamim rabbim, afillu leish neeman kashe hu etzlo lehashiv gazel hanneechol, vaanu hashivonuhu elecha meeretz kenaan achar shezzachinu bo lemerachok, metziut ze lo yimmatze ella bivchinat hanneeman gamur. ucheneged ma shennitchakkamta lomar ki lemirma nitkavvannu bahashavat hakkesef, hen emet ki devarav yutzdeku im haya haggavia nechshav etzlam lifullato lenachesh, yihyu haddevarim ketaanato, aval kefi haemet hu etzlam kishar kesef bealma ki lo yenachashu vegam lo yadu lenachesh bo, veeno etzlam ella kishar kesef, vehu amro ech nignov vegomer kesef vegomer, perush, eno etzlenu haggavia ella begeder kesef. uma sheamru o zahav nitkavvenu lomar sheenam yodim haggavia shehu toen alav im hu kesef o zahav, veze yaggid sheen lahem yedia bo kol ikkar.

rashi: Vattippaem rucho. umittarpa rucheh, mekashkeshet betocho kefaamon; uvinvuchadnetztzar omer, vattitpaem rucho (Daniel 2), lefi shehayu sham shete feimot, shichchat hachalom vehaalamat pitrono (Bereshit Rabba):
Chartumme. hannecharim betime metim, sheshshoalin baatzamot. time hen atzamot bilshon arammi, uvammishna bayit shehu male timayya (ohalot 97), male atzamot:

Veen poter otam lefaro. potrim hayu otam, aval lo lefaro, shello haya kolan nichnas beaznav, velo haya lo korat ruach befitronam, shehayu omrim sheva banot atta molid vesheva banot atta kover (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Veen poter otam vegomer. amar otam letzad shehayu shene chalomot, vahagam sheamar hakkatuv leshon yachid "et chalomo", keshebba lehodia ki lo matza poter, dikdek lomar "otam" shekkol shene hachalomot en poter lahem.

Veamro lefaro lelo tzorech, nire lomar sheyyechavven hakkatuv beamro "lefaro" ki davar yadua hu ki shem paro eno shem haetzem ella shem hammalchut, velaze timtza sheddibber elav sar hammashkim "paro katzaf" vegomer, veen mehammusar sheyyazkir shem hammelech befanav keseder ze, ella vadday shehu shem hammelucha. vechen amru zichronam livracha (Rashi tehillim 34:1), umeatta ba latet taam lamma lo nitkabbel pitronam etzlo, ki letzad shehachalom haya lammelech, veamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 89) ki chalomot hammelachim yaggidu devarim hannogim lichlalut hammalchut, vehaddaat ken notenet, vehem lo hayu potrim pitron shennogea lammalchut ella pitronim shel hedyotot. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 89) amru "lefaro" – shello haya mitkabbel pitronam lo, vedivrehem hayu nishmaim im haya omer "veen poter vegomer lo".

rashi: Mishle shelomo ben chacham yesammach av. ze hakkadosh baruch hu (midrash Mishlei 10:1). davar acher: aviv mammash:
Uven kesil tugat immo. tamid hu im immo babbayit, veroa et shetuto umetzera. ulefi hammashal: ben kesil kemo yaravam ben nevat (berachot la:):
Tugat immo. tugat kenisiyyoto:
targum: Matloy dishlomo bar chakkima nechede avuy uvera sachla mechametz leimeh:

rashi: Efo. leshon yeter hu, letakken milla velashon ivri, im ken ezdakkek laasot, sheeshlachennu immachem, tzarich ani lachazor ulevakkesh ayye fo takkana veetza lehassiachem, veomer ani zot asu:
Mizzimrat haaretz. middimshabbach beara – shehakkol mezammerim alav keshehu va laolam:
Nechot. shaava:
Botnim. lo yadati ma hem, uveferushe 3 shel rabbi machir raiti pashetatzeyas vedome li shehem afarsekin:
Venichye. nitznetza vo ruach hakkodesh, al yede halicha zo techi ruchacha, shenneemar vattechi ruach yaakov avihem (Bereshit 45):
Velo namut. baraav; binyamin safek yittafes safek lo yittafes, veanu kullanu metim baraav im lo nelech, mutav shettanniach et hassafek vetitpos et havvadday:
ohc: Venichye velo namut. perush nichye chayyim belo tzaar, veamro velo namut perush, ulefachot lo namut hagam sheyyichyu chayye tzaar.
O yirtze beamro velo namut ledayyek ba, aval im lo yelchu lo tomar sheyyechsar lahem chayyut hammaspik levad, ella afillu chayye tzaar lo yichyu, ella hem meuttadim lamut.
O yirtze, sheim lo yelchu, atidim lamut baolam haelyon, ki yomar Adonai lahem: lamma lo tarchu lechayye nafsham?

Gam anachnu. amro gam perush, millevad binyamin sheatta yare alav bahalicha zo yichye vegam hemma, vezulat ze hinne hu vehem metim vadday, veeno min harauy sheyyamutu kullam vegam binyamin mishshum sefek binyamin. lu yehi shessefek sakkanat binyamin muchera kaamur betaanat yaakov kemo shepperashti befasuk (Bereshit 42:38) "ki achiv met".

Veamro gam atta icharu hazekarat chayyut avihem lechayyutam, efshar shennitkavvenu ledabber kefi haddin (yore dea 251) shechayye adam kodmin afillu lechayye aviv. o efshar shennitkavvenu ledabber bederech lo zo af zo, vehu haelyon. o yomar al ze hadderech: lo hem levad bahalichatam yichyu, ella gam atta tzarich laddavar, ki en lechem bechol haaretz zulat bemitzrayim vehu mesukkan im lo yelchu.
Veamro gam tappenu baacharona, ki banav shel adam chavivin alav miggufo. vetze ulemad middavid sheamar al avshalom, hagam shehaya rodef aviv (Shmuel 2 19:1): "mi yitten muti" vegomer.

rashi: Haelohim matza. yodim anu shello sarachnu, aval meet hammakom nihyeta lehavi lanu zot, matza baal chov makom ligbot shetar chovo:

Ma nitztaddak. leshon tzedek, vechen kol teva shettechillat yesodah tzadi vehi baa ledabber bilshon mitpael o nitpael, noten tet bimkom tav, veeno notnah lifne ot rishona shel yesod hatteva ella veemtza otiyyot haikkar, kegon nitztaddak miggizrat tzedek, veyitztabba miggizrat tzeva, vayyitztayyaru miggizrat vetzir emunim, hitztayyadnu miggizrat tzeda ladderech. veteva shettechillatah samech o shin, keshehi mitpaelet, hattav mafredet et otiyyot haikkar, kegon veyistabbel hechagav (Kohelet 12), miggizrat saval; mistakkal havet bekarnayya (Daniel 7), veyishtammer chukkot amri (Micha 6) miggizrat shomer; vesar mera mishtolel (Yeshayahu 59), miggizrat molich yoatzim sholal (Iyov 12), mistolel beammi (Shemot 15), miggizrat derech lo selula (Yirmeyahu 18):
ohc: Ma nomar ladoni. perush: amira bederech ritztzuy. ma nedabber. perush, dibbur koshi bederech milchama, ma nitztaddak. perush, bemishpat im navo lifne dayyanim, ki en miflat lahem bechullan, veen ze ella maase elohim hemma lehippara mehem avonam keshemmatza ligbot chovo, uletzad ki heavon shebbeyadam hu lechullam yachad, "hinnennu avadim ladoni" vegomer:

Od yirtze beamro ma nitztaddak, ki meatta keshennimtzet haggavia beamtachat binyamin en od makom lakkal vachomer haamur bedivrehem "hen kesef" vegomer, ki binyamin lo haya mehammachzirim kesef hashshav.

Gam anachnu. perush, hagam shello nimtza beyadenu haggeneva. veamro gam asher vegomer, perush, letzad sheheavon shehukkar etzlam en binyamin bichlal heavon, laze amru "gam asher nimtza" vegomer, al derech amram (sanhedrin 93.) shene etzim yeveshim vechad ratov vechulei, vechevan shekkullam nilkedu baavonam vehu haya immahem, nilkad bishchitotam.

O yirtze shello yavin sheodam bedaat rishon sheamru "asher yimmatze itto vamet vegam anachnu", laze gamru omer ki en hasekamat mavet benehem, ella gam asher nimtza mishpat avdut yesh lo velo mishpat mavet, umittaam sheen edim al haggeneva veyuchal lomar "lo yadati mi sam" vegomer.

Yihyu sheva shene raav. taam shello amar ken al sheva shene sava, letzad sheggam bayyamim hahem hayu shene sava veen davar chadash kol kach, ella sheyyitrabbe hassava keamro (Bereshit 41:29) "sava gadol" shehachiddush hu heyot hassava gadol, laze lo amar ella davar chadash mufla shehu shene raav.

Od nire ki letzad shehassava eno ella letzorech tikkun shene raav, kemo sheggilla levassof shetztzivva lilkot tevuot shene sava lishne raav, laze lo hizkir ella shene haraav ki hu ikkar hodaat hachalom elav.

rashi: Vayyar yaakov ki yesh shever bemitzrayim. umehechan raa? vahalo lo raa ella shama, shenneemar hinne shamati vegomer umahu vayyar? raa veaspaklarya shel kodesh sheadayin yesh lo shever bemitzrayim; velo hayta nevua mammash lehodio beferush shezze yosef:

Lamma titrau. lamma taru atzmechem bifne vene yishmael uvene esav keillu attem seveim? beotah shaa adayin haya lahem tevua (taanit 10). veli nire peshuto lamma titrau, lamma yehyu hakkol mistakkelin bachem umatmihim bachem, sheen attem mevakkeshim lachem ochel beterem sheyyichle ma shebbeyedchem. umippi acherim shamati, shehu leshon kechisha, lamma tihyu kechushim baraav, vedome lo umarve gam hu yore (Mishlei 11):

ohc: Malle vegomer veet gevii vegomer. tzarich ladaat taam yosef beinyanim ellu. veim letzaaram, halo maasav mochichim ki gamar belibbo hashshalom veachal veshata immahem vehera lahem shalom. veulay ki nitkavven lishlosha devarim: haechad kede sheyyechuppar lahem avon haggeneva sheggenavuhu, haya ose lahem divre chashad kede sheyyihye habboshet al min heavon atzmo shel yosef vichuppar avonam. vehashsheni lirot im yittenu nafsham al binyamin, uveemtzaut ze yakkir ki moddin medidat achva im achiv vichapper lahem avonam. hashshelishi lirmoz lahem inyan haggeneva ulay yatchilu leharegish ki yesh mi shemmakkir maasehem babbayit hallaz. vechen matzinu lo shehaya romez lahem haddavar bifratim acherim, dichtiv (Bereshit 43:33) "vayyeshvu lefanav habbechor kivchorato" vegomer vechaelle rabbot.

rashi: Vattirav kol eretz mitzrayim. shehirkiva tevuatam sheatzru chutz mishshel yosef:

Asher yomar lachem taasu. lefi shehaya yosef omer lahem sheyyimmolu, ucheshebbau etzel paro veomrim: kach hu omer lanu, amar lahem: velamma lo tzevartem bar, vahalo hichriz lachem sheshshene haraav baim? amru lo: asafnu harebe vehirkiva, amar lahem: im ken, kol asher yomar lachem taasu; hare gazar al hattevua vehirkiva, ma im yigzor alenu venamut!
Kullanu bene ish echad nachnu. nitznetza vahem ruach hakkodesh uchelaluhu immahem, sheaf hu ben avihem:
Kenim. amittiyyim, kemo ken dibbarta (Shemot 10), ken benot tzelafchad dovrot (Bamidbar 27), veevrato lo chen baddav (Yeshayahu 16):
ohc: Kullanu bene ish vegomer. perush: uvaze en makom lachashad riggul, ki hameraggelim yibbacharu lihyot meanafim rabbim, uchemo chen timtza bamraggelim sheshshalach moshe (Bamidbar 13:2), vegam shenayim sheshshalach yehoshua (Yehoshua 2:1) lo hayu bene ish echad, ki chen derech habbochen beinyan ze. veamro kenim anachnu, perush: achar shemmodiim atzmam yutzdak ki hem kenim, ki hu hefech mishpat hameraggelim shello yodiu atzmam meatzmam.

Lo hayu avadecha vegomer. amru leshon avar, perush beviatam laaretz. ki atta achar shehirgish bahem enam tzerichin lomar sheenam meraggelim, ki vadday shello yeraggelu od. o yechavvenu lomar sheachar sheamru taanotehem lishlol hariggul bahem, en metziut listor taanotam ulechashdam bimraggelim, ella im kevar hayu meraggelim kodem, velaze amru lo hayu avadecha meraggelim kodem, velaze lo yikkansu atta bachashad.

rashi: Vehem lo yadu ki shomea yosef. mevin leshonam, uvefanav hayu medabberim ken:

Ki hammelitz benotam. ki keshehayu medabberim immo haya hammelitz benehem hayyodea lashon ivri velashon mitzri, vehaya melitz divrehem leyosef vedivre yosef lahem, lechach hayu sevurim sheen yosef makkir belashon ivri:
Hammelitz. ze menashshe:
ohc: Vehem lo yadu vegomer ki hammelitz benotam. perush, letzad sherau hammelitz benotam bishar devarim, chashvu ki eno shomea leshonam.
O yomar ki hammelitz benotam, veaz lo haya lehaggid lo.

rashi: Halo yedatem ki nachesh yenachesh vegomer. halo yedatem ki ish chashuv kamoni yodea lenachesh veladaat middaat umissevara uvina, ki attem genavtem haggavia:
ohc: Halo yedatem ki nachesh vegomer. baze nitkavven listor gam ken taanatam sheyyomru: mi gilla lachem sod ze ki anu haggannavim, zulat im nomar ki maase yedehem hemma vehu asa haddavar, laze amar: "halo yedatem ki nachesh" vegomer, umizze yada.

Veamro ish asher kamoni. perush, min hassetam kol adam gadol kamoni yenachesh ladaat nistarot asher yuchal lehassig, veim ken yitgalle haddavar elay, vehaya lachem lachush al haddavar shello yippale mimmenni.
