rashi: Hu asher dibbarti. haddavar asher dibbarti sheattem meraggelim, hu haemet vehannachon, zehu lefi feshuto. umidrasho amar lahem veillu metzatem oto veyifseku alechem mamon harebe, tifduhu? amru lo hen, amar lahem veim yomru lachem shello yachaziruhu veshum mamon, ma taasu? amru lo lechach banu, laharog o lehareg, amar lahem hu asher dibbarti alechem, laharog bene hair batem, menachesh ani begavia shelli sheshshenayim mikkem hecherivu kerach gadol shel shechem:
ohc: Hu asher dibbarti. perush, sheen ani chozer middibburi harishon, vaadayin haddibbur harishon bimkomo omed. veamro lemor – perush, odenni omer ken.

O yomar al ze hadderech: taam atzmo sheattem omrim ki batem lechappes achar ach haavud, hu haddavar shennitkavvanti bidvaray sheamarti lachem "meraggelim". kavvanati hi kederech sheamartem befichem shebbatem levakkesh davar bair, vehu al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 91:7) sheamar lahem "veim lo yittenuhu lachem ma taasu" vegomer, yeuyyan sham divrehem. vegeder ze hu nichlal begeder hariggul, kol shehem yoatzim neged yoshve hair, ulederech ze yeduyyak al nachon amro tevat lemor vehaven:

rashi: Umochiach lerasha mumo. mum hu lammochiach, shezze mecharfo veeno shomea lo. zo hi azhara sheasur ledabber im hammesitim midderech hayeshara, afillu lehochicham ulekarvam:
targum: Derade memikna nasev leh tzaara umachsenuta lerashia muma hu leh:

rashi: Venishkach kol hassava. hu fitron habbelia:
Vayyaamos ish al chamoro. baale zeroa hayu, velo hutzrechu lesayyea ze et ze liton:
Vayyashuvu haira. metroppolin hayta, vehu omer haira, hair kol shehu ella shello hayta chashuva veenehem ella cheir benonit shel 10 bene adam leinyan hammilchama:

ohc: Chalila li vegomer. perush: im Adonai matza lachem avon, ani lo adun al haddavar ella al ma shennitgalla li mehammishpat hatztzedek, veal chet ze ani shofet "haish asher nimtza vegomer yihye li aved vegomer veattem alu leshalom". uvaze nacha dati bema sheroani sheddibber yehuda kaddevarim haelle, shezze yaggid ki kalu lo divre piyyus vekibbel hammishpat, veech toch kede dibbur "vayyiggash elav" vedibber devarim attikim. uledivrenu tzadku haddevarim, ki mikkodem chashav ki meAdonai yatza haddavar ki matza haelohim avonam, uchesherau shello kibbel yosef ella binyamin levad, amar, hare ze lecha leot ki lo al avon nitpesu, umeatta amad haddavar letzad bechirat habbechiri, laze "vayyiggash elav yehuda".
Chassalat parashat mikketz

rashi: Ani paro. sheyyesh yecholet beyadi ligzor gezera al malchuti, vaani gozer shello yarim ish yado viladecha, – shello birshutecha. davar acher ani faro, ani ehye melech, uviladecha vegomer vezehu dugmat rak hakkisse:
Et yado veet raglo. ketargumo:
ohc: Ani faro uviladecha vegomer. perush, hammalchut hi shelli, ki 'paro shem malchut yaggid. uviladecha lo yarim vegomer, perush, acharav tihye maalato shebbiladav lo vegomer, velaze amar betosefet vav leheyot shekkadam hazekarat maalato beamro "ani faro" kemo shepperashti:

rashi: Vattochalna. siman shettehe chol simchat hassava nishkachat bime haraav:
Naar ivri eved. arurim harshaim, sheen tovatam shelema, mazkiro bilshon bizzayon:
Naar. shote veen rauy ligdulla:
Ivri. afillu leshonenu eno makkir:
Eved. vechatuv benimmuse mitzrayim sheen eved molech velo lovesh bigde sarim:
Ish kachalomo. lefi hachalom vekarov leinyano:

ohc: Lemor et shene vanay vegomer. taam amro lemor bemakom ze, nitkavven lomar ki lo hotzi mippiv davar ze beferush mishshum killat chacham (makkot 11.), ella amar dibbur shehammuvan mimmennu hu ze, velo hotzi mippiv beferush mitat banav.
Veamro et shene perush, shenayim mehannimtzaim, ki arbaa hayu lo.

Veamro tamit. taanish, umatzinu onesh kaze keamram zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 7:1) befasuk "uveaharon hitannaf" vegomer (Devarim 9:20). vetaam shello ratza reuven lechayyev atzmo ella bishnayim, letzad ki hu onesh elyon sheyyihye chaser mitzvat periyya verivyya, laze lo shibed ella davar sheeno mazziko laolam habba, velaze nitchakkem yehuda kesheraa shello nitratztza aviv ledivre reuven veamar (Bereshit 43:9) "vechatati leavi kol hayyamim", sikken atzmo gam beolam elyon.

Tena oto al yadi. ulay ki batuach haya leheyoto naki uvar meavon yosef ki lo yeera lo davar bilti hagun, laze dikdek lomar tena oto al yadi vaani ashivennu, ma sheen ken shear achim ki hem ashemim bimchirat yosef.

Vattechillena vegomer kaasher amar yosef. hutzrach lomar kaasher amar yosef, shebbaze nitammetu devarav befitron hachalom yoter, ki mikkodem yomar haomer ki mikre haya shebbau shene hassava, aval kaasher shalmu sheva shene sava vehitchilu shene raav az tzadku divre yosef.

O yirtze al ze hadderech: vattechillena sheva vegomer, vetomar ech yargishu behekker haraav bitchillat shenat reavon achar kol hassava vechol echad otzrotav meleot bar, lo yukkar haraav techef? laze peresh hakkatuv: kaasher amar yosef, perush sheamar lahem (Bereshit 41:31) "velo yivvada hassava baaretz", perush yochlu velo yisbau, vedavar ze hukkar behatechalat hashshana.

rashi: Lanu ulemoladtenu. lemishpechotenu. umidrasho afillu atze arisotenu gilla lanu:
Vannagged lo. sheyyesh lanu av veach:
Al pi haddevarim haelle. al pi sheelotav asher shaal, huzkaknu lehaggid:

Ki yomar. asher yomar, ki meshammesh bilshon im veim meshammesh bilshon asher; hare ze shimmush echad mearba leshonotav shemmeshammesh ki, vehu im, shehare ki ze chemo im, kemo ad im dibbarti devaray (Bereshit 24:33):

targum: La techus limmikna dela nisneyach aches lechakkima denirchamach:
Baana bar achilud taanach umegido vechol bet shean di vistar tzartana milra leyizreel mibbet shean ad meshar mechola ad meibbar leyakmeam:
In chakkemta lenafshach chakkemta veim teheve memik bilchodayich titan:
Itteta sachleta uferidta shivrata vela yada tavta:
Veyatva al tera vetah al kurisaya rama vaashina:
Bar chesed baarubbot dileh socho vechol ara chefer:
Umit bar itteta hada belelya dishchivat alohi:
Bechen ataa tarten neshin punedkan lemedan kodam malka vekama kodamohi:
Vaamarat itteta chada bevau ribboni ana veitteta hada yatvan beveta chada viledat imah beveta:
Ushemau chol yisrael yat dina dedan malka udechilu min kodam malka are chazo are chuchemta min kodam Adonai bimohi lemebad dina:
Vaamarat itteta di vera chaya lemalka are itgelalu rachamaha al berah vaamarat bevau ribboni havu lah yat ravya chaya umiktal la tikteluneh veda amara af dili af dilach la yehe pesuku:
Vaakimat betzafra leonaka yat beri veha mit veistakkelit beh betzafra veha la hava veri diledit:
Vaamarat itteta ocharanta la chen beri chaya uverich meta veda leda amara la chen berich meta uveri chaya vedaynan kodam malka:
Bar avinadav kol pilche dor tafat bat shelomo havat leh leittu:
Elichoref vaachiya bene shisha safraya yehoshafat bar achilud memana al dachranaya:
Vaamar malka ayto li charba veaytiu charba lokodam malka:
Velishlomo tere asar istartigaya memanan al kol yisrael umesovrin yat malka veyat enash beteh yarcha beshatta mate lechad lesovara:
Vaazaryahu var natan memana al istartigaya vezavud bar natan rabba shoshvina demalka:
Vaatev malka vaamar havu lah yat ravya chaya umiktal la tikteluneh hi imeh:
Bar deker bemakatz uveshaalavim uvet shamesh veelon demibbet chanan:
Vaamar malka pesuku yat ravya chaya litren gizrin vehavu falga lachada ufalga lachada:
Veilen ravrevaya di leh azaryahu var tzadok kahana:
Veitar shelomo veha chelma vaata lirushelem vekam kodam arona keyama dayya veasek alavan unechis nichsat kudeshin vaavad mishtaya lechol avdohi:
Vaamar malka da amara den beri chaya uverich meta veda amara la ken berich meta uveri chaya:
Vaachishar memana al beta vaadoniram bar avra memana al maske misin:
Uvenayahu var yehoyada memana al chela vetzadok veevyatar kahanaya:
Vahava beyoma telitaa lemeldi vilidat af itteta hada vaanachna kachada zakkain let nuchera imana beveta elahen tarten anachna beveta:
Vahava malka shelomo malka al kol yisrael:
Vekarya leavre archa ditritze orchathon:
Veilen shemahathon bar chur betura devet efrayim:
Vekamat bego lela unesivat yat beri milvati veamtach damcha veashkevteh levata veyat berah meta ashkevat levati:

bart: Hammavrich et haggefen baaretz. veoveret hahavracha chutz leshishsha tefachim, divtoch shishsha tefachim afillu yesh afar al gabbah shelosha tefachim asur, mishshum avodat gefen yechidit:

Lo yavi zera aleha. aval min hatztzad muttar, dizraim latztzedadim lo mishtarshe, ella sheosin heafar tichoach umalkin yesodot hakkotel keshennizraim etzlo, aval en hashsharashim shellahen mehallechin min hatztzad. vetaama delo yavi zera al haggefen hammuvrechet afillu chutz laavodatah, lefi shehaggefen rach venichnasim sharshe hazzeraim baggefen vahave harekavat yarak beilan. aval shear ilanot sheenan rakkin share:

Afillu hivrichah bidlaat o vesilon. shettachav haggefen betoch haddelaat o betoch hassilon asur, mishshum desharshe hazzeraim nokvim umefalleshin ad haggefen kesheen al gabbah shelosha tefachim afar. umishshum zeraim baddelaat lo mittesar, kegon shehaddelaat yevesha:
Silon. tzinnor umarzev vesilon echad hu. uvesilon shel cheres davka mayre, divsilon shel mattechet en tzarich afar shelosha tefachim:
Hivrichah besela. kashe. desela rach [mitpallesh] veniftach min hashsharashim:

Haarkubba shebbaggefen. gefen akuma venichpefet al gabbe karka vechozeret venizkefet kemin arkubba akuma, keshebbaim limdod shishsha tefachim shehen avodat gefen yechidit moddin min haikkar hashsheni, mimmakom shehu chozer vezokef. vehanne mile kesheen haikkar harishon nire ella dome keillu hi netua bimkom kefifatah, aval im haikkar harishon nire venikkar shehu shoresh haggefen haakuma en moddin ella min haikkar harishon:
Haannas. sheggazal kerem uzerao:
Veyatza millefanav. shechazar hakkerem livalav keshehu zarua:

Kotzro afillu bammoed. veaf al pi sheeno davar haaved, sheen adam oser davar sheeno shello, af al pi chen mippene marit haayin hittiru liktzor bammoed shello yehe nire kimkayyem kilayim bakkerem. i nammi im hu yare shemma yosif matayim bammoed az have davar haaved, deaf al gav dehaannas lo asaran deen adam oser davar sheeno shello, mikkol makom im hosifu matayim leachar shechazra labbealim kiddesh, delo gara millichsheechezor alakketennu o siarattu haruach lefanav ditnan leel shekkiddesh:

Ad shelish. it dimfarshe ad shelish bischar happoalim, sheim lo matza poalim ella bishlish yoter al secharan harauy yitten kede sheyyaakor hakkilayim miyyad, yoter al ze lo yitten ella kotzer kedarkan af al pi shehakkilayim mishtahin bakkerem. veit dimfarshe ad shelish mimma sheshshavin perot hakkerem utevuat hassade yitten lappoalim kede laakor hakkilayim miyyad, yoter mishshelish shovi perot hakkerem utevuat hazzera lo yitten, ella yamtin ad sheyyiktzor kedarko:
Meematay nikra annas. kelomar meematay nikra hakkerem al shem haannas lehechashev keshello leasro bizria:
Mishsheyyishka. shem habbealim min hakkerem veyikkare al shem haggazlan, meotah shaa tihye hakkerem chashuva keshello vikaddesh kol ma sheyyizra bah:

Arba chattaot. chad mishshum chelev, vechad mishshum ochel kodesh betuma, vechad mishshum notar, vechad mishshum yom hakkippurim. veha dekayma lan bechol hattora kullah deen issur chal al issur, hane mile beissur gereda, kegon haochel nevelat behema temea eno chayyav mishshum nevela lefi shehu issur gereda sheeno lo kolel velo mosif. aval hacha, adam shehaya mittechilla tahor, haya asur bachelev umuttar bishar basar shel kadashim. naasa tame, miggo deneesar bishar chatichot shel besar kadashim mishshum tuma, ittesar nammi bachelev af al pi shehayta asura mittechilla, vehayenu issur kolel, shehaissur haacharon kolel veoser devarim acherim al haadam shehayu muttarim lo mittechilla. umihu lo ittosaf issura acheftza, ella aggavra ittosaf issura legabbe acharine vegarer vechayel nammi lehay beissureh. naasa ze hachelev notar, hayenu issur mosif, demeikkara lehedyot asur ulegavoah share, kevan shennaasa notar nosaf issur al hachaticha atzmah leaser afillu legavoah. umittoch shechal aleha shem issur notar leasrah legavoah, chal aleha nammi shem notar legabbe hedyot lehitchayyev aleha mishshum notar, af al gav divlav hachi hayta asura lehedyot. chal aleha yom hakkippurim, miggo deittosaf issura legabbe gavra leasro bechullin shehayu muttarim lo kodem yom hakkippurim, gorer vecholel nammi lehay chelev shel mukdashim bahadeh lehitchayyev alav mishshum yom hakkippurim:

Veasham echad. asham meilot al shennehena min hekdesh beshogeg. veaf ze issur mosif, deittosaf issura al cheftza, dekodem dehikdishah haya chelev ze asur baachila umuttar bahanaa, akdesha, neesra afillu bahanaa, umittoch shechal shem hekdesh al hachelev leasro bahanaa, chal alav nammi lehitchayyev baachilato mishshum nehene min hahekdesh:
Im haya beshabbat vehotzio vefiv. keshehaya ochlo:

Chayyav. gam al hahotzaa. uvaggemara mefaresh dehachi kaamar, im haya yom hakkippurim shechal lihyot beshabbat vehotzio, chayyav shetayim al hahotzaa, mishshum shabbat umishshum yom hakkippurim, sheshshenehem baim keechad, shebbeshaa shekkadash hayyom leshabbat kadash nammi leyom hakkippurim, ucheshem sheeruv vehotzaa leshabbat kach eruv vehotzaa leyom hakkippurim. veissur chal al issur beissur bat achat:
Eno min hashshem. kelomar tanna lo kachashiv ella chattaot habbaot mippene achila, vehay mippene hotzaa hu:
Melachot harebe meen melacha achat. toladot harebe shel av echad:

Uveshabbatot harebe. otan sheasa beshabbat zo asa beshabbatot acherot, vechullan behelem echad. uvaggemara parech may kamibbaya leh denakat shabbatot harebe vetoladot harebe, veammay nakat toladot velo avot. umeshane, derabbi akiva tarte bea minneh, chada haose melacha achat beshabbatot harebe veyodea shehu shabbat ella shessavur shemmelacha zo mutteret hi, dehaynu zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot, vehachi ka mibbaya leh, hay deavad melacha achat bishte shabbatot mi amrinan kevan devishne yamim hem, af al gav dehelem echad hu, legabbe melacha havyan hanach shabbatot kegufin mechullakim shel melacha sheen domim ze laze, kegon zara vekatzar behelem echad bizdon shabbat veshiggat melachot dechayyav al kol achat veachat, o lav kegufim mechullakim damyan, vehave keillu asa behelem echad melacha achat eser peamim deeno chayyav ella achat, delekka lememar hacha yamim shebbentayim havyan yedia lechallek, dedavka leinyan shiggat shabbat havyan yedia leda sheshshabbat haya, aval leinyan shiggat melachot lekka yedia ad sheyyilmad. veod kamibbaya leh, im asa toladot harebe meav echad chayyav achat, o al kol achat veachat, ulehachi nakat toladot:

Amar li chayyav al kol achat veachat. pashat leh attarvayhu lechumra, deose melacha achat beshabbatot harebe bizdon shabbat veshiggat melachot chayyav al kol shabbat veshabbat, dehanach shabbatot kegufim mechullakim damyan, vetoladot shel melachot kammelachot damyan, vechayyav al kol tolada vetolada, veaf al pi shehen meav echad, keillu asa avot harebe:
Uma nidda. baggemara amrinan tane niddot, habba al chamesh nashim niddot chayyav al kol achat veachat, degufin mechullakim ninhu:
Totzaot harebe. inyanin harebe, kegon shabbat deikka avot melachot vetoldotehen. aval nidda en bah chiyyuva ella bia:
Vehannidda muzheret alav. dichtiv (Vayikra 20) venichretu shenehem mikkerev ammam:
Habba al hakketannot. habba al chamesh ketannot niddot chayyav al kol achat veachat, veaf al pi shehakketanna enah muzheret:
Habba al habbehema yochiach. shechayyav al kol bia uvia:

Behema chashshabbat. kelomar ki hechi demibbaya li bashshabbat hachi nammi mibbaya li babbehema. velo kabbeleh minneh rabbi akiva merabbi eliezer, lo leinyan deamar ose melacha achat beshabbatot harebe kegufin chalukin damyan, velo leinyan toldot melachot kammelachot damyan. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Tofrin kedarkan. mannichin hakkilayim al habbirkayim veal hashshokayim keshehen tofrim:

Hallevadim. tzemer taruf belo teviyya vaariga veosin mimmennu beged. veim taraf tzemer ufishtim yachad veasa mehen beged asurim midderabbanan, dedavka min hattora hu matzrich shelashtan shua tavuy vanuz, aval midderabbanan bechad minnayhu saggi o shua o tavuy o nuz, vehanach kevan shehem shuin asurim middivrehem:

Piv shel tzemer beshel pishtan. haorgim achar shemmashlimim habbeged regilim laasot al sefato [shelosha] vearbaa chutin av kede sheyyitkayyem habbeged, vehu karuy piv, veim habbeged shel pishtan asur laasot piv shel tzemer:
Mippene shechozrin laarig. mesabbevin et haarig. perush acher domin laarig:
Meshichot shel argaman. yetarim vachavalim shel tzemer tzavua argaman:
Asurot. lachgor al gabbe chaluk shel pishtan:
Mippene shehu molel ad shello kosher. sheddarkan lechabber bimlila hachagor shel tzemer im hechaluk shel pishtan kodem sheyyikshor bah matnav:
Lo yikshor seret shel tzemer beshel pishtan. shello yaase adam chagorot shel tzemer vachagorot shel pishtan veyiksherem ze vaze:

Af al pi shehartzua vaemtza. kegon retzua shel or shemmeshichot shel pishtan beroshah echad umeshichot shel tzemer beroshah haacher, ucheshehu choger bah kosher shene rasheha shel tzemer veshel pishtan ze vaze. dei lav hachi peshita deshare, shehare maasim bechol yom divgadim shel tzemer mesimim tachtehem orot telaim shehem tefurim befishtan:
Ad shello hayta vitto yotza meetzlo. kodem shettavo lirshut habbaal. vechen haarus omer lah ken:

Ad shello tikkanes lirshuto. shemmishshennichnesa lirshuto eno yachol lehafer, sheen habbaal mefer bakkodmin. veshaminan mimmatnitin shehabbaal yachol lehafer nidre ishto afillu belo shemia, middekatane vechen habbaal ad shello tikkanes lirshuto omer vechulei‏:
Beochel mizzevach echad bachamishsha tamchuyim. bachamishsha tavshilin chalukin ze mizze. chayyav mishshum meila im achalan kodem zerikat daman:
Shehaddevarim kal vachomer. ma mizzevach echad sheen gufim mechullakim chayyav al kol echad veechad mishshum tamchuyin mechullakim, chamishsha zevachim degufim mechullakim lo kol shekken:

Lo chach shealan rabbi akiva. deim beshochet shealan ma reaya heviu lo meochel, ha ikka lemifrach ma leochel shekken nehene. ella al karchach lo shaal rabbi akiva ella beochel notar mechamishsha zevachim, veheviu lo reaya nammi meochel:
Im halacha. shekkach kibbalta merabbecha, chayyav al kol echad mehazzevachim, nekabbelenna mimmecha:
Veim ladin. sheatta lomed otah mikkal vachomer mimmeila, yesh teshuva:
Et hammaachil kaochel. sheim natan ochel hekdesh lachavero, chayyav keillu achal hu atzmo, dekayma lan hammotzi hekdesh lechullin maal, velo mi shennittan lo:
Vehamehanne kannehene. bemidi delav bar achila:

Tzeraf et hammeila lizman merubbe. kelomar veod chumra acheret yesh bimila, sheim nehene hayyom bachatzi peruta umikkan ad shana bachatzi peruta, mitztarefet lifruta, kedimrabbinan mittimol maal, ribba:

Tomar baachilat notar. sheanu danim alav sheen bo achat mikkol hachumrot hallalu. velo itberira milleta i kabbeleh minneh rabbi yehoshua lehaich teshuva o lo kabbeleh minneh. ufesak hahalacha shehaochel notar mechamishsha zevachim behelem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat, vetamchuyin enan mechallekin ben lehakel ben lehachemir:
Geninim. gevanim. vaani shamati kemin tolaim:
Hammappelet yom arbaim. dead sheyyaavru arbaim yom leheryonah have mayya bealma:

Rabbi shimon mechayyev beyotze dofen. dichtiv (sham 12) veim nekeva teled, vahava leh lemichtav veim nekeva hi, ella ribba lah leda acheret, umay hi, yotze dofen. vetanna kamma savar, amar kera (sham) ishsha ki tazria veyalda, ad shetteled mimmakom shemmazraat:
Hashshirayim vehakkalach. minim shel meshi hen, vehakkalach gadel bichrakke hayyam vetavnito ketavnit hazzahav, vehu rach beyoter vedome letzemer:

Aval asurim. deate leachlofe betzemer ufishtim. umippene shello hayu metzuyin benehem lo hayu makkirim bahen veate leachlofe, hilkach asurim mippene marit haayin. aval haidna shehammeshi matzuy benenu vehakkol yodim umakkirim bo en asur shum min shel meshi betzemer o befishtim, vechen hakkanbos share ben betzemer ben befishtim, shehakkol makkirim bo:

Hakkarim vehakkesatot en bahem mishshum kilayim. lefi shehen asuyin lishchiva, vehattora amra (Vayikra 19) lo yaale alecha, aval atta muttar lehatztzio tachtecha. vehanne mile keshehen kashim verekanim unetunim al gabbe itztabba, az hen muttarin kesheen besaro [nogea] bahem, aval im hem rakkim o meleim o afillu rekanim umunnachim al gabbe mitta, afillu eser matztzaot zo al gabbe zo vechilayim tachtehem asur lishon aleha, lefi shennichpafim tachtav venichrachim al besaro:
En aray lechilayim. dilvishat aray levisha hi:
Afillu al gabbe asara. veaf al pi sheeno nehene min hakkilayim:

Et hammeches. raiti liktzat merabbotay sheppershu kegon bemakom shehayyehudim porim meches lammoches haomed meelav, velovesh kilayim kede shello yakkir shehu yehudi. veli nire lignov et hammeches lefi sheen adam noten meches mibbegadim shehu lovesh. usetam mishna zo [savra] davar sheen mitkavven asur, ufeliga aidach setama ditnan (lekamman mishna 5) mochre chesut mochrin kedarkan:
Bashshemitta. en lo vahem kinyan gamur shehakkol hefker veeno chashuv keshello:

En asur mishshum kilayim ella tzemer ufishtim. dichtiv (Devarim 22) lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer ufishtim. shaatnez kelal, tzemer ufishtim perat, kelal uferat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat, tzemer ufishtim in, mide acharina lo. vetzemer hu tzemer rechelim veelim bilvad, dichtiv (Melachim 2 3) umesha melech moav haya noked veheshiv lemelech yisrael mea elef karim umea elef elim tzamer, en lecha karuy tzemer setam ella tzemer elim, aval shear tzemer tzarich litten shem levay, tzemer gemallim tzemer arnavim tzemer izzim:
Veeno metamme vingaim ella tzemer ufishtim. dichtiv (Vayikra 13) vehabbeged ki yihye vo nega tzaraat beveged tzemer o beveged pishtim:

En hakkohanim lovshim leshammesh bammikdash ella tzemer ufishtim. divvigde chohanim ketiv shesh uvad, vehu pishtan sheole bad bevad, kelomar kane yechidi mikkol garin veen shene kanim olim miggarin echad. uvaavnet ketiv techelet veargaman vetolaat shani. utechelet, tzemer tzavua bedam chillazon. veargaman, tzemer tzavua betzeva adom sheshshemo argaman vehu 52 belaaz. vetolaat shani, hu tzemer tzavua betzeva adom shekkorin 277:
Shetterafan. sheervan:
Muttar. learev immahen pishtan lefi shetztzemer rechelim nitbattel berov shel gemallim:
Vechen pishtan vekanbos. shennitarvu veharov min hakkanbos muttar lehavi tzemer ulearev immahem:
Chelev vechelev. shene zete chelev:
Behelem echad. aval bishne helemot chayyav al kol echad veechad, dekayma lan helemot mechallekin:

Mimmin echad chayyav. ha kamashma lan deaf al gav deen hashshene chatzae zetim mittamchuy echad dehaynu mittavshil echad, ella hem mittavshilin chalukin, afillu hachi mitztaref, lefi sheen tamchuyin mechallekin:
Veod amar rabbi eliezer. kulla acheret bindarim:
Potchin. bindarim benolad, kegon davar sheeno matzuy venolad venitchaddesh achar shennadar, veillu yada bishat hanneder sheyyitchaddesh davar ze lo haya noder:

Vachachamim osrim. detama dacharata, mishshum sheal yede charata neekar hanneder meikkaro, uvedavar sheeno matzuy eno naase neder akur meikkaro, ki bishvil ze lo haya manniach milliddor ki haya savur shello yavo leolam:
Venaasa sofer. talmid chacham vehakkol tzerichim lo:
O shehaya massi et beno vekarov lo hayiti noder. uchegon shennadar lizman velo haya savur sheyyassi et beno betoch oto zeman veyitztarech lelech lechuppat beno. vahalacha kachachamim:
Vehayyoshev bakkaron. chayyav hoil veazle mechamateh chashev keillu manhigan:
Rabbi meir poter. hayyoshev bakkaron delav mide kaavid. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Vehashshelishit shehi keshura lartzuot. im shene susim keshurim bakkaron vekashar sham chamor, af al gav divlo chamor kaazle asur, velo chazinan lachamor keman deleteh:

Mishshum chamoto vechallato vaachot ishto. haav shebba al bitto veholid mimmenna bat, nasa reuven zot habbat, hare immah asura alav mishshum chamoto vaachot ishto. nisset livno shel reuven, nosaf aleha issur mishshum kallato. met beno shel reuven o gershah venisset leachiv, nosaf aleha issur eshet achiv. met achiv o gershah venisset laachi aviv, nosaf aleha issur eshet achi aviv. nisset lealma vehi eshet ish ufersa nidda uva aleha reuven beodah eshet ish venidda, hare chayyav aleha mishshum kol hashshemot hallalu:

Vechen habba al em chamoto. lavan ba al dina bat lea bitto veholid mimmenna bat ushemah serach, hannose serach, neesra alav lea mishshum em chamoto umishshum achot ishto, shehare serach ishto velea shetehen benot lavan. nisset lea leven balah shel serach venaaset kallato, veachar kach leachiv, veachar kach laachi aviv, uva aleha balah shel serach beodah eshet ish venidda, chayyav aleha mishshum kol hashshemot hallalu:

Veem chamiv. reuven ba al zekento eshet lavan, em lea immo, veholid mimmenna bat ushemah dina, hannose et dina neesra alav lea immo shel reuven mishshum em chamiv umishshum achot ishto, shehare dina ishto velea em chamiv shetehen benot eshet lavan. naaset kallato veachar kach eshet achiv veachar kach eshet achi aviv veeshet ish venidda, chayyav aleha mishshum kol hashshemot hallalu:

Habba al chamoto chayyav aleha kulei. leeshet lavan shete banot lea verachel, uven echad ushemo asher, veshem bat asher sarach, uva echad min hashshuk venasa et rachel veyocheved bat lea veserach bat asher, veachar kach ba hannose shalosh nashim hallalu al eshet lavan, chayyav aleha mishshum chamoto veem chamoto veem chamiv. mishshum chamoto, shehare hi em rachel ishto. umishshum em chamoto, shehare hi em lea chamoto. umishshum em chamiv, lefi shehi immo shel asher chamiv:
Shelashtan shem echad hem. bechad kera ketive uvechad lav. hilkach en chilluk chattaot benehen. vechen halacha:

Ad hakkayitz ad sheyyehe hakkayitz. ben amar ad hakkayitz ben amar ad sheyyehe hakkayitz eno asur ella ad sheyyatchilu haam lehachenis bakkalkallot, kelomar shekkotztzim teenim harebe umachnisim otam bassallim:
Ad sheyyekappelu hammaktzuot. hammachtzelaot shemmeyabbeshim alehem hatteenim, leachar shennityabbeshu mekappelin otan machtzelaot umannichin otan lashshana habbaa:

Hakkol lefi mekom nidro. im rov tevuot hammakom chittin, ad ketzir chittim. veim seorim, ad ketzir seorim. vechen im haya bahar bishat hanneder, ad sheyyaggia zeman hakkatzir vehabbatzir bahar. veim babbika, ad sheyyaggia zeman hakkatzir vehabbatzir shel bika:
Evar hameduldal bivhema. talush rubbo umeore bemiktzato:
Mahu. sheyyetamme mishshum evar min hachay keillu nitlash legamre. vekayma lan behaor veharotev, deevar min hachay metamme kinvela. veevar hannitlash min haadam legamre metamme kammet:
Beevar hameduldal beadam. shemmeore ketzat, tahor:
Mukke shechin. sheevarehen noflin:
Vechotchah. lo mishshum tohora, shekkodem lachen nammi tahor. ella shello yehe maus baregel beevar hameduldal:
Shemmanniach bo kesaara. veeno chotcho legamre, shello yetamme et hachotcho shennogea bo bishat perisha:
Vetochavo. laevar:
Besira. bekotz hamechubbar lakkarka:
Vehu. hachole:
Nimshach. venitlash haevar meelav. vehachole eno tame lefi shemmoshech atzmo bechoach bevat achat vehaevar nitlash mimmennu bechoach velekka negia bishat perisha:
Shehaddevarim kal vachomer. uma adam shemmekabbel tuma mechayyim, haevar hameduldal mimmennu tahor, behema sheenah mekabbelet tuma mechayyim eno din sheyyehe haevar hameduldal mimmenna tahor:
Mitpechot hayyadayim. shemmenaggevim bahem keshennotlim et hayyadayim:
Mitpechot hassefarim. shennotnim al gabbe sefer tora:
Umitpechot hassappag. shemmenaggev bahem kol gufo achar sherachatz:

Rabbi elazar oser. mitpechot yadayim lefi sheppeamim mechammem bah yadav, umitpechot sefarim peamim shemmesimah becheko umitchammem, umitpechot hassappag peamim sheroe et rabbo umitattef bah. vahalacha kerabbi elazar:
Mitpechot sapparim. hamegallechim bene adam, uforsim alehem mitpachat kede shello yitlachlechu vigdehem:
Asurim mishshum kilayim. uveha mode tanna kamma, lefi sheyyesh lahen bet rosh velovshim otan derech malbush, vehachi muchach bayrushalmi:
Shor habbar. shor haggadel bammidbar:
Min behema. vechelbo asur, veeno taun kissuy, desavre rabbanan ikkaro min hayyishshuv haya ella shebbarach lammidbar venaasa shor bar:

Min chayya. vetaun kissuy, vechelbo muttar, kasavar ikkaro min hammidbar haya. vesimanim shemmanu chachamim lehakkir ben behema lechayya bishar chayyot neemru chutz mishshor habbar. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Kelev min chayya. nafka minna lechotev kol chayya shebbirshuto leacher, o lemakdish kol chayya shebbirshuto:
Rabbi meir omer min behema. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Arod. chamor habbar:
Veadam muttar im kullam. dichtiv (Devarim 22) lo tacharosh beshor uvachamor, aval atta choresh beadam veshor, beadam vachamor:

Kile hakkerem asurin millizroa. aval eno loke mishshum kile hakkerem ad sheyyizra shene mine zera shehen kilayim ze vaze veyizreem bakkerem, dehachi mashma kera (Devarim 22) lo tizra karmecha kilayim, lo tizra shene mine zeraim shehen kilayim betoch karmecha, veim zerao bakkerem loke shetayim mishshum kile zeraim vechile hakkerem:
Umillekayyem. im roe otam umityaesh milleakram asur, ella sheeno loke ella im ken ose maase:
Vaasurim bahanaa. dichtiv (sham) pen tikdash, tukad esh, melammed shehen teunim serefa vaasurim bahanaa:
Ella lilbosh. vehu haddin lehaalot alav, dichtiv (Vayikra 19) lo yaale alecha:
Ella leharebia. lehachenis kemichchol bishfoferet, aval muttar lehachenis laddir ulehaamid ze etzel ze shene minim zachar mimmin ze unekeva mimmin acher:

Kile vehema asurim ze im ze. kegon hannoladim min hassus sheavihen chamor im hannoladim min hachamor sheavihen sus. umatnitin atya keman deamar en choshshin lezera haav, dilman deamar choshshin kol mine peradot achat hen umuttarim ze vaze. uvayrushalmi ratzu lehochiach sheasur lirkov al pirda mikkal vachomer, uma im bivgadim sheatta muttar lilbosh ze al gabbe ze atta asur betaaruvtan, behema sheatta asur lehanehig zo im zo lo kol shekken sheatta asur betaaruvtah, umakshinan vehachtiv (Shmuel 2 13) vayyirkevu ish al pirdo vayyanusu, etzel bene david keshenneherag amnon, umeshaninan en lemedin min hammalchut. tu makshinan veha ketiv (Melachim 1 1) vehirkavtem et shelomo veni al happirda asher li, umeshaninan hahi beriyya mishsheshet yeme vereshit haveya. umihu chazena lehu lerabbanan keshishe kammae dekamman sherochvin lifnehem al peradot veen moche baddavar, ella shemmazhirim shello lehanehig yachad shete peradot deshemma achat mehen nolda mechamor veaviha sus, vehaacheret missus veaviha chamor:
Kamma yishhe haochlan. lishne chatzae zetim deamrinan mitztarfin:

Keillu ochlan kelayot. roin otan keillu nitpardu leferurin [dakkin] kiklayot veochlan achat achat besamuch zo achar zo, uvehahi meshaarinan, im achal chatzi zayit vehifsik uleachar shaa achal chatzi zayit acher, im shaha mittechilla vead sof kede achilat kelayot besamuch zo lezo, mitztarfin. aval im lo hifsik meachila ella sheshshaha bilisatan uveliatan afillu kol hayyom kullo, mitztarfin ledivre rabbi meir:

Vachachamim omrim ad sheyyishhe mittechilla vead sof kede achilat peras. kelomar afillu lo hifsik ben achilat chatzi zayit laachilat chatzi haacher, ella sheshshaha bilisat shene chatzae zetim kede achilat peras mittechillat haachila ad sof beliatan, mitztarfin. beyoter mikkede achilat peras, en mitztarfin. vahalacha kachachamim:

Peras. leshon perusa. vehu chatzi kikkar shel eruv, mishshalosh kikkarot lekav, shekkol kikkar shemone betzim, nimtza chatzi kikkar arba betzim. kach pershu rabbotay. verambam omer shehu shalosh betzim:

Achal ochalim temeim. haochel ochalim temeim kachatzi peras shehu shene betzim leferush rabbotay, uledivre rambam betza umechetza, nifsela geviyyato milleechol batteruma. vechen hashshote mashkin temeim kirviit, nifsela geviyyato milleechol batteruma ad sheyyitbol. vehashshote reviit yayin venichnas lammikdash, chayyav karet. vehasheta kaamar, sheim shaha baachilat chatzi peras shel ochalim temeim, o bishtiyyat reviit shel mashkin temein, kede achilat peras, mitztarfin lichshiur venifsela geviyyato milleechol batteruma. veim shaha yoter mishshiur ze, en mitztarfin. vehu haddin leshiur reviit yayin shel kenisat mikdash, sheim shaha bishtiyyato kede achilat peras o pachot, chayyav. yoter al ken, patur:

Im hifsik bah. shello shata kol harviit bevat achat, venichnas lammikdash, patur, dichtiv (Vayikra 10) yayin veshechar al tesht, yayin derech shichruto. veim eno shotehu bevat achat, en ze derech shichruto. vechen im natan bo mayim. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer. vehane mile beshote reviit mammash, aval shata yoter merviit, mode rabbi eliezer dechayyav afillu lo shata kullo bevat achat:
Mishshum shem echad. kegon shete nashim niddot immo babbayit veshagag beachat mehen:
Shehu chayyav. shehare yada bamme chata:
Al davar shehu mishshum shene shemot. kegon safek katzar safek tachan:

Afillu nitkavven lelakket teenim velikket anavim. baggemara mefaresh milleteh derabbi yehuda bemitkavven lelakket teenim techilla veachar kach anavim, vehalcha yado al haacharonim velikket anavim techilla veachar kach teenim. vechen im haya mitkavven lilkot shechorot veachar kach levanot venehefach haddavar velikket levanot techilla veachar kach shechorot:
Rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat. dehoil velishnehem nitkavven lo ichpat lan bemukdam umeuchar:
Verabbi yehoshua poter. hoil uvishat lekitat kol echad veechad lo laze nitkavven, have leh kemitassek ufatur:

Hachi garsinan amar rabbi shimon temehanni im patar baze rabbi yehoshua. im ken lamma neemar asher chata bah. setam matnitin ka mittama al temihato shel rabbi shimon, im ken delo patar baze rabbi yehoshua, lamma neemar asher chata bah. umeshane, perat lemitassek, laafoke mi shello haya mitkavven lilkot kelal, o shehaya mitkavven lilkot teenim levad velikket anavim levad, shello naaset machashavto kol ikkar. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua, uchemo sheppershah lemilleteh rabbi yehuda:

Kol haarayot. im haechad gadol, haish o haishsha, vehaacher katan, hakkatan patur vegadol chayyav. uvashshifcha eno ken, deim haechad katan, gadol nammi patur, deha ittakkush lahadade, bikkoret tihye vehevi et ashamo, bizman shehi loka hu mevi karban, en haishsha loka en haish mevi karban:
Echad er veechad yashen hayyashen patur. veer chayyav. uveshifcha charufa er nammi patur, deha ittakkush lahadade kedaamaran:
Shogeg bechattat umezid behikkaret. veshifcha charufa, im hu mezid vehi shogeget, shenehen peturin, dehoil veen haishsha loka en haish mevi asham. veim hu shogeg vehi mezida, hi loka vehu beasham:

Hammavrich shalosh gefanim. derech hammavrich kesheyyotzin shete zemorot miggefen achat chofer baaretz umashkiv hazzemora tachat hakkarka beotah gumma umotzi roshah mitztzad acher venaaset gefen, nimtza mishshalosh gefanim osim shishsha. vehu haddin dahave matze lemitne (hammarkiv) [hammavrich] shete gefanim mishshalosh, divhachi havu kerem deha ikka shetayim keneged shetayim veachat yotzet zanav:
Veikkarehen nirin. shello hishkiv kol haggefen bakkarka (deim ken) [deim lo chen] lo hayu shalosh osim shesh gefanim, ella shehinniach haikkar veasa miggefen achat shete gefanim:
Im yesh. ben gefen legefen lo fachot mearba velo yoter mishshemone, mitztarfim, veaf al pi sheshshetayim yonkot mishshoresh echad chashvinan kishte gefanim:

Gefen sheyyavsha asura. asur lizroa betoch avodatah mishshum marit haayin, veim zara enah mekaddeshet. velo mibbaya bachoref sheasur lizroa tachteha deikka lemechash lemarit haayin, shekkol haggefanim nirim kiveshim, ella afillu bakkayitz denikkar shehi yevesha asur, mishshum degam bakkayitz ikka gefanim shennoshrin alehen venirin kiveshim vehen enan yeveshim:
Tzemer gefen. moch shekkorin kuton veilan shello dome legefen, asur veeno mekaddesh lefi sheeno min zeraim:

Af al gabbe haggefen. im zerao al gabbe gefen hammuvrechet bakkarka veen al gabbah afar shelosha tefachim, asur veeno mekaddesh. veen halacha kerabbi meir velo cherabbi elazar berabbi tzadok sheamar mishshemo:
Potchin lo bichtubbat ishto. beferaon ketubbatah im nadar legarshah:
Habbarsin vehabbardesin. shenehem asuyin mitztzemer umechassim bah et hammittot ella sheellu dakkin veellu avin:
Dalmetikyon. batte shokayim, 531 belaaz:
Minal happinnon. minal sheosot mippesolet hatztzemer:
Ad sheyyivdok. shemma yesh pishtan meorav bahen:
Habbaim mechof hayyam umimmedinat hayyam. mechof hayyam shehu mimmedinat hayyam:

Shechezkato min hakkanbos. mishna zo nishnet barishona bizman shello haya happishtan matzuy bechol makom, aval bazzeman hazze shehappishtan matzuy bechol makom kullam tzerichim bedika, hilkach hallokeach begadim tefurim min hannachri bazzeman hazze lo yilbash ad sheyyivdok yafe:

Uminal shel zerev. minalim shel or umechuppim bifnim bilvadim o vetzemer av umaggiin ad hayyarech, keen otan shekkorin 625 belaaz uvaaravi 406. ulefi sheasuyin lechammem haregel keruyin shel zerev, leshon yezorvu nitzmatu (Iyov 6):
En bo mishshum kilayim. en choshshin shemma pishtim meorav bahem:
Amru lo. afillu echad omer lo achalta chelev vehu shotek veeno machchisho:
Mevi chattat. al piv:
Shenayim omrim lo achalta chelev. vaafillu mea. vehu machchisham veomer bari li shello achalti, eno mevi karban al pihem, dichtiv (Vayikra 4) o hoda elav chattato, velo sheyyodiuhu acherim:
Rabbi meir mechayyev. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Im heviuhu shenayim kulei. kegon im heidu alav sheharag et hannefesh:
Im yirtze lomar mezid hayiti. im haya rotze liftor atzmo besheker haya yachol lomar mezid hayiti, umezid patur mikkarban:
Nitgarsha vo vayyom. sheshshama haav, sheim avar hayyom shuv eno yachol lehafer:
Venitarsa. leacher, bo bayyom:
Aviha uvalah haacharon meferin nedareha. shennadra bifne haarus harishon, shehaarus mefer bakkodmin:
Kol zeman shello yatza lirshut atzmah. lo mechamat beger velo mechamat nissuin:
Perutiyyot. min peradot sheen adam yachol laamod [alehen] ulevarer al yede simanim eze mehem immo chamor veeze mehem immo sus, hilkach asurin ze im ze:
Veharammach muttar. shekkullam min echad veimmam sus, uvilshon aravi korin lesuseya nekeva 260, vedome lo (Ester 8) bene harammachim:

Adne hassade. chayya haggedela bassadot, uchemin chevel gadol yotze min haaretz sheggedela vo otah chayya, ushemah yadoa, vehu yidoni hakkatuv battora, umechubbar betabburo beoto chevel hayyotze min haaretz, vetzurato tzurat adam befartzuf veyadayim veraglayim veen kol beriyya rashshaa likrav elav ki hu horeg vetoref kol hakkarev elav. uchesherotzim latzud oto morim bechitztzim bachevel ad shennifsak, vetzoek bekol mar umet miyyad, veelav ramaz beiyyov (5) ki im avne hassade beritecha:
Metamme baohel kaadam. dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) vechol asher yigga al pene hassade, baadam sheggadel bassade:
Hakkuppad. sheretz sheggufo male kotzim, uchesheadam nogea bo kofel atzmo umachnis yadav veraglav bevitno venaase kechaddur, vekorin lo belaaz 307:
Chuldat hassenayim. chulda haggedela bassene:

Kazzayit bemassa. dimsappeka lehu im min chayya umetammea nivlato bechazzayit umetammea nammi tuma chamura bemassa letamme adam letamme vegadim kenivlat behema temea, o min sheretz hu umetamme bechaadasha aval eno metamme bemassa kenivlat behema ella bemagga kesheretz. veen halacha kerabbi yose lo veadne hassade velo vechuldat hassenaim:

Dam shechita. ben bivhema ben bechayya ben beofot, ben dam nechira ben dam ikkur shenneekru hassimanim, vechen dam hakkaza shehannefesh yotza bo, veezehu dam shehannefesh yotza bo, kol zeman shehu mekalleach, dehaynu haemtzai. yatza rishon shebbitchillat hahakkaza, veacharon leachar shekkala haddam venitmaet, shehu shotet besamuch veeno mekalleach merachok, sheen ze dam hannefesh:
Chayyavim alav. im achal mimmennu kazzayit chayyav karet:

Dam hallev. dam hannivla bivsar hallev, vehave kishar dam haevarim shehu belav, veen chayyavin alav karet. aval dam hannimtza bachalal hallev, mibbet hashshechita hu ba, shehabbehema shoefet beet shechita umachneset dam mibbet hashshechita bachalal hallev, vechayyavim alav karet im yesh bo kazzayit:
Dam betzim. it dimfarshe dam shebbevetze hazzachar beshor ayil vetayish. veli nire, dam hannimtza bevetzat tarnegolet:
Vedam hattamtzit. shemmitmatztze venischat veshotet kesheyyotze. leshon venimtza damo (Vayikra 1):

En chayyavim alav karet. sheen karet ella bedam hannefesh. dichtiv (sham 17) ki nefesh kol basar damo hiv kol ochlav yikkaret. ufesak hahalacha, dedam hattechol vehallev vehakkelayot vedam hattamtzit hare ellu beazhara vechol dam lo tochelu, velokin alehem veen bahem mishshum karet. vedam hannimtza bevetzim, asur middivre sofrim. vedam sheratzim, im achlu mimmennu kazzayit loke mishshum ochel sheretz, velo mishshum ochel dam. vedam dagim vachagavim tehorim, muttar lechattechilla, aval tzarich sheyyihye bedam dagim, kaskassim, sheyyochiach alav shehu dam dagim, mippene marit haayin. vedam haadam, asur middivre sofrim keshepperash min haadam, veen lokin alav:
Habba al shifcha charufa. deamar kera (Vayikra 19) vechipper alav hakkohen beel haasham [lifne Adonai] al chattato, vahadar ketiv (sham) venislach lo mechattato asher chata, lerabbot mezid keshogeg:

Venazir shennitma. dichtiv (Bamidbar 6) vechi yamut met alav befeta pitom, peta, ze shogeg, vechen hu omer (sham la) veim befeta belo eva. pitom, ze mezid, vechen hu omer (Mishlei 27) petayim avru veneenashu, vehayenu mezid, deen onesh ella al hammezid:
Veal shevuat haedut. karban ole veyored haamur bishvuat haedut, chiyyev hakkatuv al mezid kashshogeg, divchullan neemar venelam vechan lo neemar venelam:
Veal shevuat happikkadon. asham haamur bishvuat happikkadon chayyav bo mezid kashshogeg, deyalef techeta techeta ligzera shava mishshevuat haedut:
Behema im behema vechayya im chayya vechulei. af al gav delo tacharosh beshor uvachamor (Devarim 22) amar rachamana, yalfinan shor shor mishshabbat dehu haddin lechol behema chayya vaof:

Velimshoch ulehanhig. limshoch et sheddarko limshoch ulehanhig et sheddarko lehanehig, gamal archeh bimshicha vachamor archeh behanehaga. umihu ben begamal ben bachamor chayyav ben moshech ben manhig:
Ellu osrim. hammakom lizroa bo:
Velo mekaddeshim. sheim zara en hazzera taun serefa:

Motar charban hakkerem. kegon ha ditnan leel karachat hakkerem shesh esre amma, im lo hayu sham ella chamesh esre amma vezara sheva ammot lo kiddesh. vechen motar mechol hakkerem shetem esre amma, im lo hayu sham ella achat esre amma vehirchik arba ammot min hakkerem vezara et hammotar lo kiddesh:

Motar piske aris. ditnan befirkin dilel im yesh sham [shemone] ammot lo yavi zera lesham, veim hirchik shishsha tefachim mikkan veshishsha tefachim mikkan vezara et hammotar lo kiddesh. ufiske aris denakat lirvuta, veaf al pi sheyyesh aris mikkan vearis mikkan, vechol shekken bearis echad:
Motar appifyarot. ditnan bappirkin dilel lo yavi zera el tachat hammotar, im hevi lo kiddesh:
Aval tachat haggefen. kegon zemora shennimshecha chutz laavodat haggefen vezara tachteha:
Vaavodat haggefen. shishsha tefachim shehem avodat haggefen yechidit:
Vaavodat hakkerem. arba ammot:

Ad haggeshamim ad sheyyihyu geshamim. beeze lashon mishshete leshonot hallalu shehotzi mippiv, muttar kevan shehitchilu haggeshamim lered birvia sheniyya, shehi beshana hameucheret berosh chodesh kislev. hilkach hannoder ad haggeshamim asur ad rosh chodesh kislev, ella im ken yardu geshamim bitchillat zemannan shehu bashshana hamevakkeret beyz bemarcheshvan, uvashshana habbenonit bechg bo. vechen halacha. velo cherabban shimon ben gamliel sheomer ad sheyyaggia zemannah shel revia:
Rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyaavor happasach. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Shomeret yavam vechulei‏ rabbi eliezer omer yafer. kesheasa bah yevamah maamar mayre, disvira leh lerabbi eliezer maamar kone bivama kinyan gamur min hattora. veim hi naara veyesh lah av, aviha vivamah sheasa bah maamar mefirin nedareha:

Rabbi yehoshua omer leechad velo lishnayim. delo sevira leh lerabbi yehoshua maamar kone kinyan gamur, mihu sevira leh deyesh zika, vezika kichnusa, uchesheen sham ella yavam echad mefer, aval kesheyyesh shene yevamin en shum echad mehem mefer, sheen berera:
Rabbi akiva omer lo leechad velo lishnayim. desavar zika enah kichnusa, umaamar eno kone kinyan gamur min hattora:
Ishsha shekkana hu leatzmo. hayenu arusato:
Hare hu mefer nedareha. beshuttafut im aviha:
Ishsha shehiknu lo min hashshamayim. dehaynu yevimto:
Eno din sheyyafer nedareha. beshuttafut im aviha:
Sheyyesh laacherim reshut bah. sheggam hi zekuka lishar achim:
Ma atta meshiv al yavam echad. kelomar teshuvatcha tova al divre rabbi eliezer sheomer shemmefer afillu kesheyyesh shene yevamin, ma teshiveni al devaray sheani omer leechad velo lishnayim:
En hayevama gemura layyavam. lehitchayyev mita habba aleha keshem shehaarusa gemura leishah leinyan chiyyuv mita. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Sefek meilot. safek nehena min hahekdesh safek lo nehena:

Vachachamim potrim. divchattat ketiv mitzvot uveasham taluy ketiv mitzvot, kol shechayyavin al shiggato chattat, chayyavin al lo hoda shello asham taluy. venehene min hahekdesh sheen chayyavim al shiggato chattat ella asham vadday, en chayyavin al lo hoda shello asham taluy:
Sheeno mevi et meilato. en tzarich lehavi hammamon:
Shete ashamot. sheim hoda lo shechata achar shehevi asham taluy, tzarich lehavi asham vadday:
Yavi meila vechumshah. keren hammamon shennistappek lo im nehena mimmennu vechumsho:
Bishte selaim. ayil hannikkach bishte selaim, dichtiv (sham 8) beerkecha kesef shekalim:
Veim safek. hachi kaamar, veim bisfeko omed leolam yihye beasham taluy:
Shemmimmin shemmevi al hoda mevi al lo hoda. hilkach yachol lehavi ulehatnot. vahalacha kachachamim:

Chamishsha sefeke zivot. sefek ziva have kegon toa sheraata shelosha yamim veenah yodaat im bime niddatah im bime zivatah, mevia karban veeno neechol. usefek leda have kegon hippila veenah yodaat ma hippila. veim yesh aleha chamishsha sefekot shel ziva o chamishsha sefekot shel leda:
Mevia karban echad. chattat haof habba al hassafek:
Veochelet bazzevachim. shehare hakkarban hazze letohora ba, hare hu kitvila, sheim nitmet haishsha kamma tumot, tevila achat ola lechullam, af karban ze ken:
Veen hashshear aleha chova. lo hitzrichuha chachamim lahavian, sheaf haachat bekoshi hittiru lehakeriv sefek melikat chullin lammizbeach, ella sheim lo chen en lah takkana littaher bakkadashim:
Chamesh ledot vaddaot. o chamesh zivot vaddaot. mevia karban echad veochelet bazzevachim. kidfareshna:
Vehashshear aleha chova. detanya, yachol tavi al halleda shellifne melot veal halleda shelachar melot karban echad lishnehem, talmud lomar (Vayikra 12) zot torat hayyoledet:
Kinnin. shene kinnin. dehaynu arba torin:
Bedinre zahav. bishne [dinre] zehuvim, dinar zahav lechol ken:
Hammaon hazze. shevua hi:

Nichnas levet din velimmed kulei. af al pi shehekel beshel tora, velimmed davar sheeno kahalacha, mishshum et laasot laAdonai‏ asa ken. sheilmale ken lo yimtzeu, veyimmanu haaniyyot millehavi afillu echad, veyochlu kadashim betumat hagguf:
Berivatayim. shene kinnin bishne rive dinar kesef. vedinar zahav hu esrim vachamishsha dinre kesef:

Mochre chesut mochrim kedarkan. lovshim bigde chilayim lehareot lakkone middat arko verachbo, uvilvad shello yitkavvenu lahanaatan. veaf al gav deim mitkavven ikka issura deorayta, ki lo mitkavven share lechattechilla. vechen halacha:
Vehatztzenuim. hammachmirim al atzman:
Mafshilin bemakkel. notnim hammakkel al kitfehem vehakkilayim munnachim bekatzehu veen kitfehem nogot bakkilayim:
Im lo hayta farnasato ella mimmennu. shehu maamino ad sheyyarviach veyifra lo:

Hare ze yafer divre rabbi yose. rabbi yose letaameh disvira leh sheen habbaal mefer kol neder sheyyesh bo innuy nefesh, shehu mechallek ben innuy merubbe leinnuy muat uven innuy shel zeman merubbe lizman muat, vechol matnitin dehay pirka azla kevateh, veenah halacha. ella habbaal mefer kol neder sheyyesh bo innuy nefesh, ben shel yom echad vaafillu shaa achat, ben shel zeman merubbe, ben innuy gadol ben innuy katan. vechen mefer nedarim ushevuot bedavar shebbeno levenah af al pi sheen bahem innuy nefesh, kegon im nishbea o nadra shello tichchol o shello titkkashshet. vechen im nadra shello tochal mipperot medina zo, habbaal mefer, shettorach hu lo lehavi lah perot mimmedina acheret, vehave devarim shebbeno levenah. uma ben nedarim ushevuot shebbeno levenah lindarim ushevuot sheyyesh bahen innuy nefesh, nedarim ushevuot sheyyesh bahem innuy nefesh mefer leatzmo velaacherim, kegon im nadra shello tochal basar velo tishte yayin, mefer lah vehi mutteret leechol velishtot vaafillu leachar shettitalmen o titgaresh vetinnase leacher. unedarim ushevuot shebbeno levenah, kegon im asra aleha tashmish shel kol adam leolam o shello tichchol vetitkashshet leolam, mefer chelko, utehe meshammashto vechochelet umitkashshetet kol zeman shehi tachtav, ucheshettitalmen o titgaresh tihye asura betashmish kol adam velichchol ulehitkashshet. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Ad ematay chorshim bisde hailan. lekamman mefaresh ezehu sede ilan:
Erev sheviit. shetztzarich lehosif mishshana shishshit al hashsheviit beissur avodat haaretz, ulekamman yalfinan la mikkerae:
Kol zeman shehu yafe lapperi. kelomar shehacharisha yafa lapperi, have metakken hakkarka letzorech happeri shel shishshit velo letzorech sheviit:

Ad haatzeret. dead haatzeret yafe lapperi vetu lo, umin haatzeret veelach nire kimtakken letzorech sheviit. uvisde lavan sheen bo ilan ad happesach. umishna zo hi mishna rishona veenah halacha, derabban gamliel uvet dino nimnu al shene ferakim hallalu shehem pesach bisde lavan vaatzeret bisde ilan vehittirum, umuttar lacharosh ad rosh hashshana shel sheviit:
Hammappelet leor shemonim veechad. sheyyalda nekeva, velel shemonim veechad shehayta reuya lemachar lehavi kapparatah hippila:

Bet shammay potrim min hakkarban. milleda sheniyya. af al gav dilachar melot hu, hoil velayla hi velo yatzta shaa reuya lekarban, delayla mechussar zeman karban hi, dichtiv (Vayikra 7) beyom tzavvoto, hilkach leinyan karban ketoch melot dame:
May shena or lishmonim veechad miyyom shemonim veechad. devadday chayyevet karban al hannefel shehippila ledivre hakkol hoil veachar melot hippila:
Im shave lo lattuma. shehare attem modim shebbishkiat hachamma shel yom shemonim kalu yeme tohar shellah veim raata belel shemonim veechad temea:

Haddamim enam mochichim. vehaddam sheattem omrim im shave lo lattuma, eno reaya, shehare hammappelet toch melot damah tame mippene halleda, veenah chayyevet karban sheni, lefi shekkol shebba betoch melot nechshav keillu ba im havvalad harishon. uveha modu bet hillel:
Bogeret sheshshahata shenem asar chodesh. bogeret sheen aviha mefer nedareha, utevauha linnase veshahata shenem asar chodesh, shemmikkan veelach baalah chayyav bimzonoteha:
Vealmana. sheshshahata sheloshim yom mishshettevauha linnase, shehi ochelet mishshel baalah:
Rabbi eliezer omer hoil uvalah chayyav bimzonoteha. hu mefer et nedareha. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Zehu chevodi. sheafarnes banay mishshelli:

Hayu mesarvin bo laset et bat achoto. maftzirin bo sheyyissa et bat achoto mippene shehi bat gilo, veamrinan [yevamot sav:] hannose et bat achoto alav hakkatuv omer (yeshaya noach) umibbesarcha lo titallam az tikra vaAdonai‏ yaane:

Shello nitkavven ze ella leshem achila ushetiyya. umihu gam baachila ushetiyya muttar, hoil velo hotzi mippiv achila ushetiyya, devindarim bainan sheyyotzi bisfatav, kedichtiv (Bamidbar 30) kechol hayyotze mippiv yaase. velo dami laresha, deishut bichlal hanaot iteh:

Illu hayiti yodea shekken hu lo hayiti noder hare ze muttar. achar sheyyattirennu hechacham. vechol hammuddar hanaa mechavero, keshemmattirin lo en mattirin ella bifne chavero, dichtiv (Shemot 4) vayyomer Adonai‏ el moshe bemidyan lech shuv, amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe, bemidyan nadarta, bemidyan lech vehatter et nidrecha. lefi shennishba moshe lechotno shello yazuz mimmidyan belo reshuto, dichtiv (sham 2) vayyoel moshe lashevet et haish, vehitzricho hakkadosh baruch hu lalechet lehattir nidro befanav:
Lele hatztzom. lel tzom kippur, shemmitzva leharebot bisuda beerev tzom kippur:

Konam shum sheeni toem vechulei. sheezra tikken sheyyehu ochlim shum belele shabbat mippene shemmarbe hazzera. veen halacha lo kerabbi yehuda velo kerabbi yose beno, ella kidamrinan leel bematnitin, kol shezzemanno kavua, amar ad sheyyaggia, asur ad sheyyaggia. ad sheyyehe, asur ad sheyyetze:

Habba al shifcha charufa biot harebe. dichtiv (Vayikra 19) vechipper alav hakkohen beel haasham vegomer‏ al chattato asher chata, vahava matze lemichtav al chattato velishtok, may asher chata, lerabbot chattaim harebe. vehane mille keshebba biot harebe al shifcha achat, aval ba al shefachot harebe vaafillu behelem echad, chayyav al kol shifcha veshifcha, dichtiv vehi shifcha, lechayyev al kol shifcha veshifcha:

Venazir shennitma tumot harebe. keshennitma betoch shivat yeme tumato lo tzericha lememar deeno mevi ella karban echad, detuma arichta hi. ki tzericha lenitma bayyom hashshevii shehu yom tiglachto. vesavar hay tanna dikra dichtiv (Bamidbar 6) vekiddash et rosho bayyom hahu, beyom shevii shehu yom tiglachto kaamar, shennezirut tohora chala alav beoto yom, vehasheta salka datach amena ki nitma tere zimne bashshevii havu lehu tumot harebe, deha hitchila nezirut detohora, velichayyav shete karbanot, kamashma lan dilinyan karban lo michayyav ella chad, delo ata ze lashshaa haruya lekarban, deaf al gav dinzirut tohora atchala la miyyom hashshevii, shaa haruya lekarban enah ella miyyom hashshemini:
Hamekanne leishto al yede anashim harebe. dichtiv (Bamidbar 5) zot torat hakkenaot, tora achat liknaot harebe:

Umetzora shennitnagga negaim harebe. kegon shennitnagga venitrappa nitnagga venitrappa peamim harebe, eno mevi ella karban echad al kullam, dichtiv (Vayikra 14) zot tihye torat hammetzora, tora achat lammetzora peamim harebe:

Hevi tzipporim venitnagga. baggemara mefaresh dehachi katane, lo alu tzipporim lehikkava baaniyyut uvaashirut. sheim haya ani bishat [havaat] tzipporim veheeshir kodem sheyyavi chattato, tzarich lehavi karban ashir. veim haya ashir veheeni, mevi karban dallut ad sheyyavi chattato. devatar chattat azlinan, ben baaniyyut ben baashirut, dichtiv (sham) asher lo tassig yado betohorato, keshello tassig yado bishat tohorato yavi bedallut veaf al pi sheheeshir achar ken, vehay tohorato hayenu chattat shehu kapparato:
Ad sheyyavi ashamo. divtohorato, ashamo mashma, shennoten middamo al behonotav umachshiro leechol bakkadashim. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Safek achal chelev safek lo achal. vehechi dame, kegon chelev veshumman lefanav veachal et achad mehen, kidtane besefa. ufaroshe kamfaresh, safek achal chelev safek lo achal ketzad, kegon shehaya chelev veshumman lefanav veyesh kan issur kavua. aval im hayta lefanav chaticha achat, safek shehi chelev safek shehi shumman, vaachalah, patur, delo ikkeva issura:
Vaafillu achal. vadday chelev, safek yesh bo kazzayit. uchegon shebbeshaa sheachalo savur shumman hu veachar kach noda lo shehu chelev, vesafek yesh bo kazzayit safek en bo:

Achal et achad mehen. uchesavur shumman hu, veachar kach noda shehaechad haya chelev, veze eno yodea ezo achal, mevi asham taluy. aval im bishat achila hayta lo safek vehezid vaachalah missafek, have mezid ufatur:
Shagag beachat mehen. kesavur zo ishto, veachar kach nistappek ezo mehen hayta, mevi asham taluy:

Rabbi eliezer omer potchin laadam bichvod aviv veimmo. kegon sheyyomru lo illu hayita yodea sheyyomru haolam leavicha uleimmecha reu giddulim sheggiddaltem, kamma binchem kal bindarim, venimtzeta mezalzel bichvodam, kelum hayita noder:

Vachachamim osrin. dechayshinan shemma meshakker, ki hu bosh lomar shello haya manniach milliddor bishvil kevodam, venimtza shechacham mattir neder ze belo charata. umayre shehu eno mitcharet meikkara meatzmo, dekayma lan potchin bacharata veen tzarich limtzo lo petach beshaa shehu mitcharet meatzmo meikkara:

Yiftechu lo vichvod hammakom. al milleteh derabbi eliezer ka parech, ki hechi defotchin bichvod aviv veimmo velo chayshinan shemma yeshakker, yiftechu lo nammi bichvod hammakom veyomru lo illu hayita yodea shettikkare ra lifne hammakom kelum hayita noder. veamru lo chachamim derabbi eliezer, meha lo tesayyean, deaf rabbi eliezer mode veha, devadday yeshakker, delo chatzif eynash kulle hay deyomar shello haya manniach bishvil kevod hammakom, velo dami lerabban shimon ben gamliel defatach lehahu gavra yesh bote kemadkerot cherev kulei, dehatam omer lo min happesukim kehach ditnan bematnitin sheover al lo tisna velo tikkom velo tittor. aval keshemmazkirin lo kevod hammakom az vadday meshakker. vahalacha kachachamim:
Shebbeno leven aviv veimmo. kegon shehiddir et aviv minnechasav:
Ad hakkatzir. shel chittim useorim:
Ad habbatzir. shel anavim:
Ad hammasik. shel zetim:

Eno asur ella ad sheyyaggia. hoil veen lekatzir uvatzir zeman kavua, kedimfaresh veazel, lo shena amar ad sheyyehe lo shena amar ad sheyyaggia, eno asur ella ad sheyyaggia, shekkol davar sheen zemanno katzuv en bedaat hannoder lehachenis atzmo veissur zeman sheen yadua lo, ulefichach amrinan devadday ad sheyyaggia kaamar:
Met haav lo nitrokna reshut labbaal. sheen habbaal mefer nidre ishto ad shettinnase:
Met habbaal nitrokna reshut laav. umefer kol yeme naarutah, dichtiv (Bamidbar 30) binureha bet aviha:
Vehaav eno mefer bevager. kedichtiv (sham) bevet aviha binureha:

Bitto vaachoto. kegon shebba al immo veholid mimmenna bat vahare hi bitto vaachoto meimmo, veeshet achiv shennisset lo kodem lachen umet, uleachar mitato nesaah achi aviv uva ze aviha aleha beniddatah, vehasheta issur bitto vaachoto bain keachat. veaf al pi shehi mamzeret vaasura lavo bakkahal, keshennisset laachi aviha kiddushin tofsin bah, lefi shekkiddushin tofsin bechayyave lavin. i nammi, im hayu ache aviha mamzerim muttarim lissa otah lechattechilla, veneesra al aviha mishshum eshet achiv lefi shehu issur mosif, shemmittechilla hayta mutteret laache aviha kullan, ucheshennisset leechad mehen neesra al kol haachin, umittoch shechal aleha shem eshet ach legabbe shear haachim shehayta mutteret lahen, chal aleha nammi shem eshet ach legabbe aviha lehitchayyev aleha nammi mishshum eshet achiv. met achiv venisset laachi avi aviha, miggo deittosaf bah issura legabbe shear ache aviv, ittosaf bah issura nammi legabbe dideh. haveya la eshet ish, miggo deittosaf issura legabbe alma, ittosaf issura legabbe dideh. persa nidda, miggo deittosaf issura legabbe balah. ittosaf issura nammi legabbe dideh:
Chayyav aleha mishshum bat bitto vechallato. kegon shennesaah beno:
Vaachot ishto. shehaya nasuy et bat chatano shehi achot bat bitto min haav:
Veeshet achiv. shemmet beno unesaah achiv shel ze:
Veeshet achi aviv. shemmet achiv unesaah achi aviv:

Im avar hazzaken. aviv shel ze, unesaah, veachar kach ba aleha ze, chayyav af al eshet haav. veaf al gav deeshet achiv hi, deha mechayyevinan leh livreh mishshum eshet achi aviv, alma asura leh leaviv mishshum eshet ach veen (la) [lo] ishut bah, hacha bemay askinan kegon shennafla lefanav leyibbum meachiv, shemmet belo banim veyibbemah hu unesaah, vehay avar hazzaken ditnan, hayenu mishshum shehi lo beissur sheniyya bilvad, mishshum bat bat beno umishshum kallat beno dishtehen sheniyyot middivre sofrim. veim tomar, kallato hi, deha mechayyevinan leh livreh mishshum eshet ach. lav pircha hi, deikka leokme deeshet achiv shel beno meimmo hi, velo kallato shel av hi, ella eshet chorgo umutteret lo. veim tomar, umay issur mosif ikka bevat bitto kesheavar aviv unesaah deka mechayyevat leh nammi mishshum eshet av. ha milleta bau la baggemara, vetertzu, kegon deikka bera lesabba veachiv shel ze hu, demiggo deittosaf bah issura gabbe hahu bera mishshum eshet av, ittosaf nammi gabbe dideh:
Vechen habba al bat ishto. chayyav aleha mishshum kol ellu shechayyav bevitto:

Veal bat bat ishto. chayyav mishshum kol ellu shechayyav al bat bitto. uvat ishto shehi achoto mashkachat la, kegon sheaviv anas o pitta ishsha veholid mimmenna bat, veachar kach nasa hu anusat aviv o mefuttat aviv shehi mutteret lo, hare otah habbat achoto uvat ishto. uvat bat ishto vaachot ishto mashkachat la, kegon shebba avi ishto al bat ishto veholid mimmenna bat, otah habbat hi bat bat ishto vaachot ishto:

Potchin beyamim tovim uveshabbatot. im nadar lehitannot, o shello leechol basar lizman katzuv, omrim lo illu samta el libbecha leshabbatot veyamim tovim shebbetoch zeman ze kelum hayita noder. veen ze poteach bichvod hammakom:
Otan hayyamim. shemmatza lahem petach lehitcharet:
Muttarim. shehechacham mattiran:
Ushear hayyamim. sheen alehem charata, nisharin beissuran:
Shenneder shehuttar miktzato huttar kullo. af al pi shello matza petach al kullo. delo nadar meikkara ella al daat sheyyitkayyem kullo, nimtza hattarat miktzato petach lechullo:
Haruach sheilala. shessiara. ruach seara metargeminan ruach alola:
Yigdor. kemo goder bitmarim, kelomar yachtoch veyilkot:
Vechen bayyarak. [hannote] tachat haggefen:
Yachazir. hattevua vehayyarak limkoman:

Veeno mekaddesh. im lo hechezir eno mekaddesh, deha ditnan leel tachat haggefen oser umekaddesh hayenu kesheikkar hattevua tachat haggefen, aval kesheikkar hattevua omedet chutz laggefen venota tachat haggefen eno mekaddesh:

Mishshettashrish. mishshaa sheyyitpashshetu sharashim bakkarka. veit degarse mishshettashlish kelomar mishshettavi shelish, derachamana amar (Devarim 22) utevuat hakkerem, ufachot mishshelish lo mikre tevua:

Vaanavim mishsheyyeasu kefol hallavan. sheim zara tevua o yarak becherem shello higgiu anavav lihyot kefol hallavan veakar hazzera kodem sheyyaggiu haanavim lihyot kefol hallavan, hare ze lo kiddesh. vechen anavim shennaasu kefol hallavan vezara betziddan tevua o yarak velikket hazzera kodem sheyyashrish, o kodem sheyyavi shelish leman degares mishshettashlish, hare ze lo kiddesh:

Tevua sheyyavsha kol tzarkah vaanavim shebbashlu kol tzarkan. venata gefen betzad hattevua sheyyavsha kol tzarkah o zara betzad [haanavim shebbashlu] kol tzarkan, enan mekaddeshot, deamar kera (Devarim 22) pen tikdash hammelea hazzera asher tizra utevuat hakkerem, eno mekaddesh ad sheyyihye sham meleat zera utevuat kerem, utevua veyarak shello hishrishu o shello heviu shelish lo higgiu lichlal meleat zera, vechen leachar sheyyavshu shuv enan keruyin meleat zera, vaanavim kodem sheyyaggiu lihyot kefol hallavan o leachar shebbashlu kol tzarkan enan keruyin tevuat kerem:

Naara hameorasa. bat shetem esre shana veyom echad vehevia shete searot keruya naara, ad shishsha chodashim. uvat achat esre shana veyom echad, nedareha nivdakim, im yada leshem mi nadra uleshem mi hikdisha, nidrah neder, veaf hi aviha uvaalah meferin nedareha:

Hefer haav velo hefer habbaal. mishshum dahava efshar lemite ulefaresh aviha uvaalah meferin nedareha, o aviha o baalah, tana hefer haav velo hefer habbaal vechulei, leashmoinan detarvayhu tzerichin lehafer:

Veen tzarich lomar shekkiyyem echad mehem. sheim kiyyem echad mehem en hashsheni yachol lehafer. veha kamashma lan sheaf al pi shennishal haechad mehem shekkiyyem al hakamato, kidkayma lan nishalim al hahekem, en ze shennishal al hahekem yachol lehafer yoter, hoil velo hayu yecholim shenehem lehafer bevat achat:
Yesh devarim shehem kenolad. nirin kenolad:
Veenan kenolad. ufotchin bahem:

Amru lo met vechulei. veaf al gav demita nolad have, hoil uferesh bishat nidro baavur ma haya noder, naase ketole nidro baddavar, keillu peresh kol zeman sheaviha kayyam, hilkach lo have nolad. aval tenay gamur lo have, hilkach tzarich hattara. uvayrushalmi mochach sheen tzarich hattara. vechen peresh rambam:
Baitlis. shuk shemmochrim sham basar:
Shel emmaom. shem hair:

Habba al achoto vechulei. hachi kaamar, habba al achoto shehi achot aviv vaachot immo. umashkachat la, kegon shebba reuven al immo veholid mimmenna shete banot vechazar uva al achat mibbenotav ellu veholid mimmenna ben, uva habben al achoto shehi achot aviv vaachot immo:

Shehaddevarim kal vachomer. uma habba al chamesh nashav niddot shehem shem echad, lenidda lo tikrav, chayyav al kol achat veachat, habba al achoto shehi achot aviv vaachot immo shehen shelosha shemot, kelomar shelosha lavin mechullakin, eno din sheyyehe chayyav al kol achat veachat. vehay kal vachomer pericha hu, dema lechamesh nashim niddot shehen gufim mechullakim. ella taama, mishshum deamar kera (Vayikra 20) ervat achoto gilla vegomer, ukera yetera hu, divresheh dikra ketiv veish asher yikkach et achoto veraa et ervatah vegomer, lamma li lemihdar tu ervat achoto gilla, ella lelammed al achoto shehi achot aviv vaachot immo shechayyav al kol achat veachat:
Ellu nedarim. baggemara mefaresh dindarim ushevuot katane, devilshon chachamim shevuot bichlal nedarim hem:

Im erchatz veim lo erchatz. hachi kaamar, hanaat rechitza asura alay leolam im erchatz hayyom, hare neder. im lo erchatz, shevua shello erchatz, hare shevua. vechen im etkashshet, hanaat kishshut asura alay leolam im etkashshet hayyom, im lo etkashshet, shevua shello etkashshet:

Amar rabbi yose en ellu nidre innuy nefesh. anneder bilvad paleg rabbi yose al tanna kamma, veamar dahanaat rechitza asura alay leolam im erchatz hayyom, en ze neder shel innuy nefesh, shehare efshar lah shello tirchatz hayyom velo tihye hanaat rechitza asura aleha leolam, umeniat yom echad merchitza eno innuy nefesh, deniuul shel yom echad lo have niuul. veen halacha kerabbi yose. uven haav uven habbaal nidre innuy nefesh hu dimferin, dichtiv (Bamidbar 30) ben ish leishto ben av levitto, makkish av labbaal, ma baal eno mefer ella nidre innuy nefesh, af av eno mefer ella nidre innuy nefesh. verambam pasak shehaav mefer kol nedarim ushevuot, afillu otan sheenan shel innuy nefesh, shenneemar (sham) kol nedareha veesareha:

Chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin. hameoreset leeved ivri, shehu muttar beshifcha umuttar bevat chorin. aval lo leeved kenaani, shehare hu asur bah mippene tzad cherut shebbah. veillu lo hayta chetzyah shifcha hayu hakkiddushin tofsin bah, ushenehen neheragin, aval achshav kiddushin tofsin bah ketzat mippene tzad cherut shebbah, veen tofsin bah legamre mippene tzad avdut shebbah, vehayenu dichtiv (Vayikra 19) lo yumetu ki lo chuppasha, ha chuppasha chayyavim:
Vehafde lo nifdata. mashma peduya ketzat veenah peduya legamre:
Zo hi shifcha vaddait. kelomar shifcha gemura. vehay dichtiv vehafde lo nifdata, dibbera tora kilshon bene adam:

Kol haarayot meforashot. shehen benot chorin, veshiyyur en lanu, vezo vadday meshunna hi chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin. verabbi elazar ben azarya hayenu rabbi akiva, ella deamar leh lerabbi yishmael ana bealma kevatach sevira li dedibbera tora kilshon bene adam, mihu hacha shane, middichtiv ki lo chuppasha, vehafde lo nifdata lamma li. shema minna lechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Laze velaze. kegon sheasar harishon alav bekonam, veamar al hashsheni hare ze karishon veal hashshelishi hare ze kashsheni, vechen kullam. huttar harishon hutteru kullam, shekkullam teluyin bo:

Laze karban velaze karban. ha matnitin rabbi shimon hi deamar gabbe shevuat happikkadon im hayu chamishsha tovim oto vechafar venishba vehoda sheeno chayyav karban al kol echad ad sheyyomar shevua lechol echad veechad, vehacha nammi tzarich sheyyomar laze karban velaze karban. aval chachamim omrim im amar shevua sheeni chayyav lecha velo lecha velo lecha, chayyav al kol echad veechad, vehacha nammi im amar lo laze velo laze velo laze, af al pi shello hizkir karban al kol echad, have kol echad neder bifne atzmo. vechen halacha:

En koshrin sus betzidde hakkaron. keshehabbakar moshchot bakkaron en koshrin sus betziddo o acharav shel karon kede sheyyilmad limshoch, lefi sheppeamim hassus sheachar hakkaron dochef et hakkaron umanhigo begufo:
Luvdekim. chamor shel lud, vehu gadol vearitz mishshear chamorim vedome legamal:

Af al pi sheavihen chamor muttarin ze im ze. sheaviv shel ze chamor veaviv shel ze chamor. veka mashma lan delo amrinan ate tzad sus umishtammesh betzad chamor vetzad chamor mishtammesh betzad sus, dechevan deimmotehen shavot en choshshin lezera haav:

Aval hannoladim min hachamor im hannoladim min hassus asurim ze im ze. kevan sheimmo shel ze mimmin hachamorim veimmo shel ze mimmin hassusim, devatar zera haem azlinan vahare hen shene minim. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Veen yadua ma hippila. im tzurat adam vechayyevet, im dagim vachagavim ufetura. mevia karban shete torim echad leola veechad lechattat. al shel ola matna veomeret, im min chova yaladti, tehe lechovati, veim lav, tehe olat nedava. aval chattat, lo matzya leatnoye, deen chattat nedava, umayta besafek, veeno neechol, deshemma lav bat karban hi, umelikatah kinvela bealma. umishshum chullin baazara, lo ichpat lan, dechevan deen lammizbeach ella damah la chashiv achila:
Vechen shete nashim shehippilu. bemachavo:
Achat min petur. kemin dagim vachagavim:
Veachat min chova. sandal o shilya. veen yadua ezo hippila min chova. meviim kol achat shete torim veeno neechol:
Ematay. eno neechol:

Bizman shehalchu. sheheviu kinnehen lakkohen vehalchu ledarkan veen yecholim lehatenot. aval im shetehen omdot keachat, meviot chattat achat umatnot benehen, im ani hachayyevet, hare hu shelli [vechelkech machul li]. veim at hachayyevet, hare hu shellach [vechelki machul lach], veoto chattat karev veneechol. dedavka chattat shebba al chet en tenay moil bo, dichtiv (Vayikra 4) o hoda elav chattato, aval hacha dechi ka maytin nashim karban leishteroye baachilat kadashim hu, maytin umatneyan. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Kemin behema chayya vaof. hoil veneemra bahen yetzira kaadam. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Sandal. valad hu, ella shennifchata tzurato. uleshon sandal, sanuy vedal. kach matzati. verabbotay pershu shehi chatichat basar asuya ketzurat sandal uregila lavo im valad:
Shilya. sheen shilya belo valad:
Shafir merukkam. or shehavvalad merukkam bo sheyyesh betocho tzurat evarim ketannim. ulefi sheasuy kishfoferet shel betza karuy shafir:

Vechen shifcha shehippila. desalka datach amena ki kaamrinan kol mitzvot shehaishsha chayyevet bah eved chayyav bah, hane mile mitzvot hashshavot baish uvaishsha, aval yoledet devannashim ita uvaanashim leta emar lo tichayyav shifcha, lehachi tane vechen shifcha shehippila:

Kach al lo hoda shellahen. kegon achal shete chatichot kesavur sheshshetehen shumman hen veachar kach noda shekkol achat mehen safek, eno mevi ella asham taluy echad, hoil velo noda lo ben achila laachila shessefek chelev achal:
Veim hayta yedia ventayim. yediat safek:
Keshem shehu mevi chattat al kol achat veachat. im hayta yediat vadday bentayim, kach bidiat safek mevi shene ashamot teluyin:
Chelev venotar lefanav. vesavar dishnehen shumman shel hetter:
Ishto nidda vaachoto immo vabbayit. ba al achat mehen, kesavur lavo al ishto tehora, venimtza sheishto hayta nidda, veod safek al ezo mehen ba:
Veasa melacha ben hashshemashot. kesavur chol hu:
Rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat. mimma nafshach, im chelev achal chayyav, im notar achal chayyav, vechen kullam:

Verabbi yehoshua poter. degabbe chattat ketiv (Vayikra 4) asher chata bah, ad sheyyivvada lo bamme chata. verabbi eliezer, hay asher chata bah mibbae leh perat lemitassek bimlechet shabbat, kegon nitkavven lachtoch et hattalush vechatach et hamechubbar, shehu patur, kevan delo nitkavven lachaticha deissura. vedavka mitassek bimlechet shabbat hu defatur, dimlechet machshevet asra tora. aval mitassek bachalavim uvaarayot, kegon sheachal chelev o ba al haerva shello bemitkavven, chayyav lechulle alma, shehare nehena:
Lo nechleku. rabbi eliezer deamar lo bainan sheyyeda bamme chata lo nechelak al rabbi yehoshua, umode lo beose melacha ben hashshemashot shebben shabbat veyom hakkippurim shehu patur:
Sheani omer. chatzi shiur hammelacha naaset beshabbat vachatzi shiur beyom hakkippurim, veen kan chiyyuv chattat:
Meen ezo melacha asa. im charash o zara:

Potro haya rabbi yehoshua af measham taluy. degabbe asham taluy ketiv (Vayikra 5) ki techeta velo yada, perat laze sheyyada shechata ella sheen hachet mesuyyam. vechattat nammi lo michayyav, sheaf al pi sheyyada shechata mimma nafshach, mikkol makom lo huvrar lo bamme chata. ufesak hahalacha, shehu chayyav beasham taluy ben bechelev venotar lefanav sheefshar sheyyuvrar haddavar, ben beose melacha ben hashshemashot shebben shabbat veyom hakkippurim shei efshar sheyyuvrar haddavar, vechen beishto nidda vaachoto immo babbayit veshagag beachat mehen, bechol ellu mevi asham taluy:
Levet sea. karka shehi chamishshim amma al chamishshim amma:
Kikkar devela. hatteenim hayeveshim asuyin bemaaggela keen kikkar lechem keruyim kikkar devela:
Baitalki. bemane shel italya shel yavan, ulefi shehaya kach bime moshe meshaarim bo, vehammane mea dinarim vehaddinar shesh maot umishkal kol maa shesh esre seorot benoniyyot:
Pachot mikkan. mikkikkar shel shishshim mane en chorshim kol bet sea, ella tachat hailan levad vechutza lo:

Kimlo ore vesallo. hammelakket teenim karuy ore kemo goder bitmarim uvotzer baanavim. vesallo, hassal shennoten bo ma shehu loket. ushear hassade chashuv sede hallavan veen chorshin oto ella ad happesach:
Potchin laadam bichvod atzmo uvichvod banav. im nadar legaresh et ishto:
Ma raata imman lehitgaresh. im lo shennimtza vah ervat davar, venimtza pogem et banav. velo chayshinan shemma yeshakker shehu eno mitcharet ella shehu bosh lomar sheeno choshesh lichvod banav:

Haishsha sheyyalda veladot harebe. vekaazel umefaresh ketzad, kegon hippila betoch shemonim shel nekeva, shettavla leachar shevuayim detuma veshimmesha venitabbera, vehippila nekeva leachar arbaim shel yetzira, dehaynu chamishshim vearba lalleda harishona, vechazra vehippila lesof chamishshim vearba shel zo. ulehachi nakat nekeva, devizcharim lekka lememar hachi, dei hippila betoch arbaim dezachar, hay sheni mayya bealma hu, deen havvalad notzar ad arbaim yom:

Vehammappelet teomim. afillu zecharim. kegon nitabbera shelosha, vehippila echad leachar arbaim, vehashsheni nishtaha veyatza toch yeme tohar harishon, ushelishi betoch yeme tohar desheni. kol ellu en meviot ella karban echad, dichtiv (Vayikra 12) zot torat hayyoledet, melammed shemmevia karban echad al veladot harebe. yachol al halleda shellifne melot veshel achar melot nammi enah mevia ella karban echad, talmud lomar zot:

Rabbi yehuda omer mevia al harishon veenah mevia al hashsheni. rabbi yehuda paleg ben avveladot ben atteomim, veomer mevia al havvalad harishon, velo al hashsheni shennolad betoch melot shel rishon. umevia al hashshelishi, mishshum dehu lo nolad toch melot, delo chashvinan melot lashsheni, dichman deleteh dame hoil venolad toch melot shel rishon, ushelishi have techillat leda. veenah mevia al harvii, hoil venolad toch melot dishlishi, aval shelishi lo nolad toch melot derishon deha avru yeme tumato derishon. vegabbe teomim nammi paleg rabbi yehuda. veaf al gav deibburan keachat, lo amrinan chada leda arichta hi veit leh melot nammi lashsheni, ushelishi lav bar karban hu, ella im nolad shelishi leachar melot derishon savar rabbi yehuda dimvia karban al hashshelishi, veal melot desheni lo ichpat lan dichman deleteh dame. vechi kaamar rabbi yehuda valad sheni keman deleteh dame, leinyan karban, hoil uvetoch zemanno shel karban rishon nolad, aval leinyan tuma mode dime tuma it lah [vechol zeman shehi mappelet zachar yoshevet alav shivat yeme tuma usheloshim veshalosh dedam tohar], vechol zeman shehi mappelet nekeva yoshevet aleha shevuayim detuma veshishshim vashesh dedam tohar. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Ole veyored. ole leashir, veyored leani. sheim hu ashir mevi kisba o seira, veim ani torim uvene yona, uvedalle dallut asirit haefa solet:
Shemiat hakkol. veshama kol ala, vetumat mikdash vekadashav beshogeg, ushevuat bittuy, shelashtan ketuvim behedya befarashat vayyikra shemmeviin bedallut uvedalle dallut:

Vehayyoledet. baashirut, keves leola uven yona o tor lechattat. bedallut, shete torim dehaynu perida deof tachat keves. vedalle dallut lo neemar beyoledet. vechen metzora, baashirut shene kevasim, bedallut shete torim tachat shene kevasim, vedalle dallut en bo:

Shavin bammakkot uvakkarban. im mezidin shenehem lokin, kidkayma lan ish o ishsha ki yaasu mikkol chattot haadam (Bamidbar 8), hishva hakkatuv ishsha laish lechol onashin shebbattora. veim shoggin shenehem meviim karban, divtarvayhu ketiv karet bemezid, dichtiv (Vayikra 18) venichretu hannefashot haosot, vechol shezzedono karet shiggato chattat:

Uvashshifcha lo hishva. shehaishsha loka kedichtiv (sham 19) bikkoret tihye, hi bemalkot vehu bekarban el asham. uleshon bikkoret, bikria, lefi shekkorin al halloke im lo tishmor laasot vehifla Adonai‏ vegomer. i nammi, bikkoret leshon bikkur, shebbet din mevakkerim veomdim et halloke kamma makkot yachol lekabbel:
Asa vahen hameare. hammachnis atara bilvad:
Kaggomer biato. vechayyav al shello kedarkah kemo kedarkah, demishkeve ishsha ketiv. uvashshifcha eno chayyav ella al gemar bia kedarkah, deshichvat zera ketiv bah, sheruya lehazeria:
Vechol haarayot chayyav al kol bia uvia. uvashshifcha amaran leel befirkin [daf 9] shemmevi karban echad al biot harebe:

Sheasa vah et hammezid kashshogeg. im shenehen mezidin o hu shogeg vehi mezida, hi bemalkot vehu bekarban. aval im hi shogeget, ben shehu shogeg ben shehu mezid, shenehen peturim, dichtiv bikkoret tihye, vahadar vehevi et ashamo. bizman shehaishsha loka, ish mevi karban. en haishsha loka, en haish mevi karban:
Ella shehanneder taut. meikkaro, shebbishat hanneder hayta levana, veeno tzarich sheela lechacham:

Maase veechad shennadar vechulei. baggemara mefaresh dechassore michassera vehachi katane, rabbi yishmael omer afillu keura venaaset yafa, shechora venaaset levana, umaase nammi vechulei. detanna kamma lo share ella bizman shehaya hanneder taut meikkaro, kegon shehayta yafa bishat hanneder, verabbi yishmael savar sheaf al pi shello naaset yafa ella leachar hanneder, hanneder muttar, dechevan sheyyecholin leyappotah lo hayta cheura meikkara. veen halacha kerabbi yishmael:

Velo vamyushshan bilvad huttar ella vechol hayyayin. vedavka sheamar illu yadati chen lo hayiti noder kelal o hayiti omer yashan muttar vechadash asur. aval amar illu hayiti yodea hayiti omer kol yayin asur alay chutz min hayyashan, hare ze en muttar lo ella hayyashan bilvad, vechol shear yayin asur:
Hafarat nedarim. sheamra tora (Bamidbar 30) veim beyom shemoa ishah yani otah:

Kol hayyom. ad shettechshach, shenneemar beyom shamo. veha dichtiv miyyom el yom, tzericha, delo tema bimama in belelya lo, ka mashma lan miyyom el yom, dezimnin sheyyesh lo zeman lehafer meet leet, kegon im nadra bitchillat hallayla:
Veyesh baddavar lehakel ulehachamir. kelomar peamim sheyyesh lahafara zeman muat ufeamim zeman merubbe:

Nadra belele shabbat. hay denakat belele shabbat leashmoinan shemmefirin nedarim beshabbat vaafillu shello letzorech hashshabbat. vehechacham eno mattir beshabbat ella nedarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat, veaf al pi shehaya lo penay mibbeod yom yachol lehattir letzorech hashshabbat:

Sheim lo hefer vechashcha eno yachol lehafer. sheen hafarat nedarim meet leet ella im ken nadra mittechillat hallayla. uleinyan hafara eno moil ad sheyyomar mufar lach kelishana dikra, dahafarat habbaal hu mikkan ulehabba belo taam, kemo et beriti hefar (Bereshit 17). vechacham hu sheomer muttar lach en kan neder veen kan shevua, shehu oker hanneder meikkaro. veim amar hechacham bilshon hafara vehabbaal bilshon hattara, eno muttar veeno mufar. veim amar im lo nadart maddirech ani, devarav kayyamim, veen tzarich sheyyomar kayyam lichi, hoil vaafillu shatak kol oto hayyom hanneder kayyam, bedibbur kol dehu nammi have kiyyum. uveshabbat yomar teli ichli teli sheti, velo yafer kederech sheyyomar bechol, vehanneder batel meelav. veim eno yachol lehacherichah, mevattel belibbo veen tzarich lehotzi bisfatav. vedavka bittul kegon teli ichli shehu machrichah laavor al nidrah hu shemmoil im chashav belibbo af al pi shello hotzi bisfatav, aval hafara sheeno machrichah laavor al hanneder tzarich lehotzi bisfatav velo saggi im hefer belibbo:
Hare hen kayyamin lo amar kelum. dahava leh kiyyum betaut, lefi sheyyesh nedarim shello yachpotz bekiyyuman:
Hare hen mufarin rabbi eliezer omer mufar. demissetama en adam rotze benidre ishto:
Nedarim shebbau lichlal issur. leachar shennadra asura bahem im lo yafer lah habbaal:
Shebbau lichlal hakem. nedarim shechalu kevar:
