Konam sheeni nehenet labberiyyot eno yachol lehafer. sheen ze minnidre innuy nefesh, shehare yechola lehitparnes mishshel baal, devaal lav bichlal beriyyot hu. veha matnitin nammi rabbi yose hi, veen ken halacha kidfarishna leel. velo mibbaya i amra konam sheeni nehenet labberiyyot sheasra hanaat kol habberiyyot aleha, shehu mefer mishshum nidre innuy nefesh allibba dachachamim, ella afillu amra konam sheeni nehenet lifloni, shello asra aleha ella hanaat oto peloni bilvad, habbaal mefer mishshum devarim shebbeno levenah, shettorach hu lo keshello tehane meoto peloni, vehattora amra ben ish leishto, kol davar shebben ish leishto habbaal mefer:

Vichola lehanot beleket shichcha ufea. hachi kaamar, veod tama acharina shekkonam sheeni nehenet labberiyyot en habbaal mefer, shehare yechola lehanot milleket shichcha ufea, sheenah nehenet min habberiyyot, demattenot aniyyim ninhu, venimtza sheen kan innuy nefesh:
Konam kohanim uleviyyim nehenim li. ki hechi dekonam sheeni nehenet labberiyyot mutteret bemattenot aniyyim, hachi nammi hammaddir kohanim uleviyyim minnechasav muttarim bemattenot kehunna uleviyya:
Arbaa mechussere chappara. shemmeviin kappara velo al chet ella leechol bakkadashim:

Vehametzora. veha dela chashiv nammi vehametzoraat ki hechi dachashiv zav vezava, lefi shezzav vezava ikkar tumatan chaluka, shezzav metamme biriyyot, vaafillu raa shalosh reiyyot beyom echad, tame umevi karban, vezava enah mevia karban ad shettire bishlosha yamim ze achar ze, hilkach chashvinhu letarte, aval metzora umetzoraat en ikkar tumatan chaluka, dishnehem shiur tumatan bechaggeris:
Ger mechussar kappara. vetanna kamma savar, ger kevan shemmal vetaval muttar leechol bakkadashim, veen karban meakkevo ella millavo bakkahal, hilkach la chashiv leh bichlal mechussere kappara:
Ad sheyyizzarek alav haddam. im hevi karban behema. veim olat haof hevi, ad sheyyitmatztze damo al kir hammizbeach:

Venazir leyeno uletiglachto. karban nazir mattir lo lishtot yayin uletiglachat ulehittame lemetim, sheaf al pi sheshshalmu yeme nizro eno muttar beyayin uvetiglachat ulehittame lemetim ad sheyyavi karban. vetanna kamma la chashiv nazir, delo tane ella hanach dilishteroye bakkadashim, venazir demayte karban, leishteroye beyayin dechullin hu:
Shua tavuy vanuz. shua saruk bammasrek veshua chalak. ish chalak metargeminan gevar sheia:

Nuz. shazur, dehaynu shene chutin shezurin yachad. veikkar kilayim min hattora sheyyihye hatztzemer saruk vetavuy veshazur levaddo, vechen happishtan saruk vetavuy veshazur levaddo, veachar kach yihyu arugim yachdav o mechubbarim yachad bishte techifot, dahavu kearig. umishshum hachi itzterich kera lemishre kilayim betzitzit, lefi shechute techelet shezurim hem dichtiv petil techelet, tavuy veshazur, vechen chut lavan, ucheshemmechabberan yachad bishte techifot havu kilayim gemurim deorayta. veha ditnan hacha en asur mishshum kilayim ella tavuy vearug shenneemar (Devarim 22) lo tilbash shaatnez, lav lemidrash arig mishshaatnez, dearig miyyachdav nafka, dedarshinan minneh deaf shete techifot have chibbur, velo mayte shaatnez ella mishshum tavuy. veraiti leechad merabbotenu shepperesh shua tavuy hatztzemer levad vehappishtim levad, vanuz kelomar veachar kach nuz dehaynu shenehem arugim yachad, vehachi mityashshev lishna dematnitin shappir tefe, vehachi mashma bayrushalmi. uferushim harebe matzati lerabbotay beferush shua tavuy vanuz, vechulehu it lehu pircha levad mehay delet leh pircha:
Naloz umelliz. akom umeakkem darche aviv shebbashshamayim alav. leshon al yalizu meenecha (Mishlei 3):
Tachriche hammet. shehammet nikbar bahem, en bahen mishshum kilayim, dichtiv (tehillim pach) bammetim chafshi, kevan shemmet adam naase chafshi min hammitzvot:

Umardaat chamor. hi kasha yoter mikkarim uchesatot, hilkach afillu besaro nogea lo chayshinan shemma tikkarech nima al besaro. vedavka keshehakkilayim nikkarim venirim bah, aval beged sheavad bo kilayim lo yaasennu mardaat lachamor, dechayshinan shemma yikkach mimmennu telay levigdo, hoil veen hakkilayim nikkarim:
Atzitz nakuv. sheyyesh bo nekev kede shoresh katan, vezara betocho:
Mekaddesh bakkerem. im hinnicho bakkerem o vearba ammot shel avodat hakkerem mekaddesh keillu nizra baaretz:
Asurin velo mekaddeshin. lo yavi zera letocho lechattechilla, veim hevi lo kiddesh, delo have kezorea baaretz. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Hammaavir atzitz nakuv bakkerem. atzitz nakuv sheyyesh bo tevua shehevia shelish, veheeviro becherem sheyyesh bo anavim kefol hallavan, velo hinnicho vaaretz ella heeviro tachat haggefanim bilvad, im hosifu hazzeraim bederech haavarato chelek mimmatayim al ma shehayu techilla, asur hazzera shebbeatzitz, aval haggefanim lo kadshu kevan shello hinnicho bakkarka. uleel beferek kerem shecharav perashnu ketzad roin im hosif echad mimmatayim:

Otot haggardiyyim. derech haorgim vehakkovsim lirshom shem habbealim al habbeged bemaase rokem kede shello yitchallefu shel echad beshel chavero. veim habbeged shel tzemer veotot shel pishtan o ippecha, asur mishshum kilayim:
Techifa achat. techiva achat shettachav hammachat babbeged paam achat bilvad:
Eno chibbur. letuma uletohora, veim nitma echad mehem lo nitma chavero, veim hizza al echad mehem lo hizza al chavero:
Veen bah mishshum kilayim. im echad shel tzemer veechad pishtim vechibberam bitchifa achat:
Vehashshomtah beshabbat. al menat lachazor velitpor patur, velo have kekorea al menat litpor shete tefirot dechayyav:

Asa shene rasheha letzad echad. kegon sheheevir hammachat paam achat velo heevir kol hachut, veheevir hammachat paam shenit venimtzeu shene rasheha letzad echad ukesharan, deim lo kashar shene rashe hachut yachad eno mitkayyem:
Ad sheyyeshallesh. sheyyachnis veyotzi veyachazor veyachnis shelosha feamim. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Hassak vehakkuppa mitztarfin lechilayim. im chatichat beged tzemer mechubberet lassak vachatichat beged pishtim mechubberet lakkuppa, vechibberan yachad bishte techifot, mitztarfot af al pi shehen mechubbarot lishne chelim, velo amrinan hay lechudeh kae vehay lechudeh kae veenan chibbur. vehu haddin im mechubbarim lishar kelim dahave dinan kemo sak vekuppa:
Vechayyav beacharayuto. leshallem lo et tevuato, vaafillu leman delo dain dina degarme, shane hacha deka avid maase beyadayim:

En adam mekaddesh davar sheeno shello. velo dome lishar issurim shebbattora kegon hannoten chelev vedam bikderat chavero o bishshel basar bechalav shel chavero deosran, deshane kilayim dichtiv behu (Devarim 22) lo tizra karmecha kilayim demashma karmecha velo cherem acher. verabbanan amre lo tizra karmecha, en li ella karmecha kerem acher minnayin, talmud lomar kilayim mikkol makom. veen halacha kerabbi yose [velo cherabbi shimon] velo cherabbi akiva:
